bluejetty:00166068:ios.description:
Napper is the game-changing, award-winning app that uses data, science, and a little bit of algorithmic magic to predict your baby’s naps and bedtime - with almost uncanny accuracy.
Originally built by a dad on parental leave (still with us btw!) for him and his not-so-sleepy baby girl, Napper has now grown to help more than 100,000 families sleep better. So whatever issue you might be facing - short naps, frequent night-wakings, never-ending bedtime routines - there’s a good chance we can help you too.
→ Napper’s main features include…
• A personalized sleep schedule for your baby based on their natural sleep rhythms and research on infant sleep. The schedule adjusts as your baby's sleep needs change to promote healthy sleep habits and provide them with the restful sleep they need to grow and develop.
• User-friendly, straight-forward baby tracker to help you keep track of nursings, formula feedings, diaper changes and much more. You can also share your baby (and subscription) with as many caregivers as needed so everyone is on the same page.
• A large variety of sleep sounds, such as white noise, lullabies, and sounds of nature, that can be played in the background during naptime and bedtime. The sounds are carefully chosen to be gentle and calming, helping to create a peaceful and relaxing environment for your baby to sleep in.
• A comprehensive, science-based article series designed to help you establish healthy sleep habits for your baby. The course covers a wide range of topics, including the basic biological components of sleep, how to create a sleep-friendly environment and strategies for settling and soothing a fussy baby.
• Trends & statistics presented in easy-to-read charts that give you useful insights, such as the average amount of time your baby spends asleep, the number of night wakings, and the duration of feedings. Easily spot and identify patterns and trends in your baby's sleep, which allows you to make adjustments to their sleep routine as needed.
—
All in all, we’d really like to think that Napper is the most complete baby sleep app out there. But don't just take our word for it though - here’s what other parents have to say about it:
"Great app, helped me work out when nap times should be and helped set a bedtime routine! Definitely recommend."
"This is one of the apps which every mom or another caregiver should download straight away. Thanks to Napper I could develop a deeper understanding of my 4-months old sleep patterns. And now he falls asleep fast and without cries. Thank you!"
"I love Napper! I've used 4 other sleep tracking apps (paid for) and Napper has to be my favorite! I love the aesthetic of the layout and how accurate it is."
"This app is amazing!! Very accurate for my son and has been for months. Great features to select number of naps and set bed time if trying to create a routine too."
"My baby is 11 months and I use it all day every day. Keeps us on schedule"
"This app is really great, it's like a baby manual that comes with your child! I really love it."
"Really useful, I'm sleep deprived and can't remember exactly what time everything happens! The predictive sleep feature is great. Developers very responsive to feedback"
"I LOVE Napper! I have used lots of baby trackers over my 4 kids and this one is hands down my favorite."
"The app is pretty great but the customer service is even better! I thought I was locked out of my account and they contacted me and got me back in within minutes! This app has revolutionized how we care for our newborn."
"This is the app that got us through the 4 months sleep regression! And I love that multiple caretakers can add track baby's sleep. Such a great help!"
So don't let sleepless nights and exhausted days be the norm - try Napper (yes, today!!) and give your baby the gift of restful, peaceful sleep!
—

bluejetty:00131515:ios.name: Gratitude: Self-Care Journal
bluejetty:00131515:ios.summary:
The Gratitude app is a carefully-designed self-care tool to help you focus on your mental health.
With a gratitude journal, affirmations, vision board, and daily motivation content, Gratitude provides you with all the tools and reminders y
bluejetty:00131515:ios.description:
The Gratitude app is a carefully-designed self-care tool to help you focus on your mental health.
With a gratitude journal, affirmations, vision board, and daily motivation content, Gratitude provides you with all the tools and reminders you need to gain motivation and develop a healthy self-love routine in your life. 
To live a happy and fulfilling life, it is important for us to have good mental health and a strong sense of self-love.
And, as the app is completely private, you can always be assured that your precious journal entries, affirmations, and vision board are for your eyes only.
Here are the tools that you will find in the Gratitude app:
1. GRATITUDE JOURNAL
A gratitude journal or diary opens up your eyes to reflect on all the little blessings in your life.
In daily life, we can lose sight of what we are fortunate to have and by keeping a journal you can slowly and steadily shift your perspective to focus on what is good in your life.
The Gratitude app will send you reminders with prompts to help you build the habit of journaling.
You can also add photos to your journal entries and can record journals in your voice, build a gratitude journal streak, and access hundreds of journal prompts. 
2. POSITIVE AFFIRMATIONS
If you’ve heard about manifestation or the law of attraction, you’ve probably heard about affirmations.
Positive daily affirmations change our self-talk to focus on more loving and kind thoughts towards ourselves.
They give us the motivation we need to keep moving forward and believe in ourselves.
The Gratitude app has hundreds of affirmations that you can listen to or read, as per your need.
You can also write your own affirmations, add music, and record your voice to them.
Positive affirmations are a dearly loved tool and with this affirmations app, it is very easy for you to practice them.
3. CREATE VISION BOARDS
Another super popular manifestation tool is a vision board, also called a dream board. The vision board serves as a collage of your dreams and goals in the form of photos, quotes, and affirmations.
In the Gratitude app, we’ll help you make a great vision board using sections, goal ideas, and create a video of all your goals together with music. You can also make multiple vision boards!
4. DAILY ZEN
We understand the need for motivation and inspiration as you build a healthy routine with these self-help tools, which is why Daily Zen is an important part of the app.
Here, you will find gratitude quotes, motivation quotes, thought switch ideas, thank you cards, affirmations, blog articles, and real-life stories of people who changed their mindset with gratitude.
5. MINDFUL MINUTES
We define the Mindful minutes as the time that you spend in the Gratitude app. You can view the mindful minutes under 'All Health Data' section in the Health app provided by Apple. Currently, the app does not read any data from the health app. We don't write any data in the health app without your consent. You can turn on the mindful minutes from the profile & settings in the Gratitude app.

Terms of Use: https://medium.com/@priteshsankhe/terms-and-conditions-c7a676f5d884

bluejetty:00136596:ios.name: Divineko - Magic Cat
bluejetty:00136596:ios.summary:
You play as a cat who casts spells by drawing increasingly complex shapes that match incoming enemies.
Throughout your journey, you will meet a wide range of enemy archetypes with unique gameplay mechanics, challenging bosses, and you will
bluejetty:00136596:ios.description:
You play as a cat who casts spells by drawing increasingly complex shapes that match incoming enemies.
Throughout your journey, you will meet a wide range of enemy archetypes with unique gameplay mechanics, challenging bosses, and you will acquire divine abilities along the way (e.g. block attacks, slow down time, hit all enemies on screen). These abilities will help you become more efficient and progress through the different levels. Ultimately, you will rise to the top of the leaderboard in the Endless mode and achieve your end goal: establish your authority as the god of cats, the Divineko!
Divineko is an arcade game that is designed for players of all ages who like fast action, light strategy and drawing simple to complex shapes. It also appeals to all cat lovers!
Gameplay features
- Draw various Shapes to cast Spells and defeat incoming enemies before they hit you
- Use your Shield to block enemy attacks. Depletes when used, can be refilled
- Use your Hourglass to slow time down. Has a short cooldown
- Use your Bomb to hit all enemies on screen. Has a longer cooldown
- And more abilities that will be unveiled during your journey!
- Perfect your strategies by hitting enemies in a smart order and using your abilities wisely
Game Structure
- The game is split into chapters: each contains carefully crafted waves of enemies, and you will frequently meet bosses that will test your skills
- Each boss defeated grants you a new special ability
- Eventually you will unlock the Endless mode, in which you will compete against other players for the first rank in the leaderboard
- Gaming sessions are short, usually from 1 to 5 minutes
- Runs on low-end devices. Small download size.

Whether you enjoy puzzle games, tetris, or challenging blocks, this game is a must-have addition to your collection. Let's delve into the thrilling features that make Playdoku: Block Puzzle Games the ultimate puzzle experience!
Unleash your skills in solving block games:
Are you ready to test your tetris blitz solving skills? Playdoku: Block Puzzle Games offers engaging gameplay that will challenge your strategic thinking. With a wide variety of block shapes, you'll need to place them strategically on the board to create complete rows or columns. Blast away those blocks in an epic block blast and earn points as you go!
Multiple modes for non-stop fun:
Classic Mode:
— Enjoy a relaxing and enjoyable block games session.
— Solve tetris blitz at your own pace without time pressure.
— Strategically place blocks to create complete rows or columns and earn points.
Challenging Mode:
— Take on thrilling block games as difficulty levels increase progressively.
— Test your strategic thinking and tetris blitz abilities to overcome tougher block blast puzzles.
— Push your limits and strive for higher scores with each level.
Journey Mode:
— Level-based mode with a progressive difficulty curve.
— Embark on a captivating journey through a variety of tetris blitz, block blast & block games challenging levels.
— A large number of levels available, ensuring endless gameplay.
— Every level counts, as you cannot replay previous levels to improve your score.
— Requires strategic thinking and careful decision-making to progress.
How to master Playdoku: Block Puzzle Game?
— Take your time: There's no time limit in this block puzzle games, so no need to rush. Take a moment to think ahead before making a move.
— Strategic placement: Aim to build blocks on the puzzle board in a way that allows you to destroy lines or 3x3 squares with each move.
— Find your balance: Achieve equilibrium between clearing blocks and maximizing combos and streaks.
— Practice makes perfect: Like any skill, mastering Playdoku: Block Puzzle Games requires practice. The more you play, the better you'll become at recognizing patterns, making strategic decisions, and achieving higher scores.
Experience the Delight of Sleek Design:
Prepare to be mesmerized by Playdoku's clean and minimalist design. The user-friendly interface and pleasing color scheme create a visually stunning and immersive experience. Say goodbye to distractions and get lost in the addictive gameplay of block games. Get ready for hours of pure Block Puzzle games bliss!
Train Your Brain & Achieve Greatness:
Playdoku: Block Puzzle Game is not just a game; it's a brain-training activity. Test your abilities and push your limits in these block games with block blast & tetris blitz levels. Each decision counts, and it's up to you to rise to the challenge. Keep pushing your limits, earn higher brain levels. You have what it takes to become a true Block Puzzle master!
Track Your Progress & Challenge Friends:
Want to know how you stack up against other players? Playdoku: Block Puzzle Game features rating tables to track your progress and see how you rank. Challenge your friends, set records, and strive for the top spot. With progress saved, you can pick up right where you left off.

With its captivating gameplay, multiple modes, sleek design, and brain-teasing challenges, these puzzle games will become your go-to source of entertainment. Experience the addictive charm of Playdoku: Block Puzzle Game. Download now and indulge in endless puzzle fun!

bluejetty:00015444:ios.name: Math Games for Kids: Addition
bluejetty:00015444:ios.summary: Math Land is an educational video game for children and adults. With it they will learn and obtain reinforcement for the main mathematical operations—addition, subtraction, multiplication, sorting from higher to lower, division, and negativ
bluejetty:00015444:ios.description:
Math Land is an educational video game for children and adults. With it they will learn and obtain reinforcement for the main mathematical operations—addition, subtraction, multiplication, sorting from higher to lower, division, and negative numbers.
It is not just a math app—it's a real educational adventure!
GAME PLOT
An evil pirate, Max, has stolen the sacred gems and has cursed the islands filling them with obstacles and traps. Help Ray, our pirate, find the gems and restore the natural order of things. Navigate your ship through the seas to get them, but remember: you will need a spyglass to discover new islands.
Solve fun math games to get them: addition, subtraction, numbering, multiplication tables, and division. The islanders need you!
EVERY ISLAND IS AN ADVENTURE
Have fun with over 25 levels and negotiate all kinds of obstacles in order to get to the chest that holds the gem. It will be a real adventure—you'll have to deal with quicksand, bewitched parrots, volcanoes with lava, puzzle games, magic doors, funny carnivorous plants, etc. It will surprise you!
EDUCATIONAL CONTENT
For children aged 5-6:
* Learning to add and subtract with very small numbers and amounts (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 10).
* Reinforcing mental arithmetic with already learned additions and subtractions.
For children aged 7-8:
* Learning to add and subtract with larger numbers and amounts (1 to 20).
* Getting started on learning multiplication tables (the learning of multiplication tables will be done gradually in order to track the children's progress).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 50).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 50).
* Developing mental arithmetic with educational games based on addition, subtraction, and multiplication tables.
For children aged 9+ and adults:
* More complex additions and subtractions, teaching mental association of numbers with different arithmetic strategies (adding and subtracting).
* Reinforcing the learning of all multiplication tables (multiplications).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower and vice versa, including negative numbers.
* Learning mathematical operations with negative numbers.
* Mental division.
* Developing advanced mental arithmetic with additions, subtractions, multiplications, and divisions.
WE ARE DIDACTOONS
Our development studio, Didactoons, has extensive experience in developing educational apps and games that combine learning and fun. Proof of this is the success of our other three apps and their—at the moment—over three million downloads worldwide:
* Dino Tim: An educational video game for learning shapes, numbers, and getting started on addition and subtraction.
* Monster Numbers: A real educational adventure that blends pure arcade fun and learning mathematics.
So don't miss it—download the free educational game Math Land!
SOCIAL MEDIA
Web: http://mathlandgame.com/
Google Plus: https://plus.google.com/+MathLandApp
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mathlandgame.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/MathLandGame
OVERVIEW
Company: Didactoons
Educational video game: Math Land
Recommended age: children aged 5+ and adults

EDUCATIONAL CONTENT

For children aged 5-6:
* Learning to add and subtract with very small numbers and amounts (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 10).
* Reinforcing mental arithmetic with already learned additions and subtractions.

For children aged 7-8:
* Learning to add and subtract with larger numbers and amounts (1 to 20).
* Getting started on learning multiplication tables (the learning of multiplication tables will be done gradually in order to track the children's progress).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 50).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 50).
* Developing mental arithmetic with educational games based on addition, subtraction, and multiplication tables.

For children aged 9+ and adults:
* More complex additions and subtractions, teaching mental association of numbers with different arithmetic strategies (adding and subtracting).
* Reinforcing the learning of all multiplication tables (multiplications).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower and vice versa, including negative numbers.
* Learning mathematical operations with negative numbers.
* Mental division.
* Developing advanced mental arithmetic with additions, subtractions, multiplications, and divisions.

WE ARE DIDACTOONS

Our development studio, Didactoons, has extensive experience in developing educational apps and games that combine learning and fun. Proof of this is the success of our other three apps and their—at the moment—over three million downloads worldwide:

* Dino Tim: An educational video game for learning shapes, numbers, and getting started on addition and subtraction.

* Monster Numbers: A real educational adventure that blends pure arcade fun and learning mathematics.

So don't miss it—download the free educational game Math Land!

Twitter: https://twitter.com/MathLandGame

We’ve made ordering even easier! Download the new official Papa Johns pizza app and order your favorite pizza, sides, and drinks for delivery or takeaway. Want to dine in? No problem! Order online and eat at one of our pizza restaurants in the UAE.
Enjoy exclusive in-app deals, earn Papa Points when you order – even when you eat in one of our restaurants – and redeem them for free pizza and sides.
Papa Johns pizza app – bringing a slice of happiness to the United Arab Emirates 
EASY SIGN-IN 
Sign up with Facebook or email. Just remember that by signing up, you agree to our Terms of Use.
FIND YOUR ADDRESS 
Select your exact address on a map, so we can deliver your pizza as quickly as possible.
DELIVERY OR TAKEAWAY 
Choose your order for pizza delivery or takeaway, either way it’s fast and delicious.
EASY ORDERING 
Log in, choose your favourite pizza and order. It’s as simple as that!
REPEAT ORDER IN 1 CLICK 
Want the same as last time? Just click on your last order and check out.
FIND YOUR LOCAL RESTAURANT 
Find your nearest Papa Johns pizza restaurant.
ORDER AND EARN PAPA POINTS 
Earn points with every order, then redeem them for free pizza, sides, pasta and salads. 
SHARE AND EARN PAPA POINTS 
Recommend us to your friends and earn points, then redeem them for free pizza, sides, pasta and salads.
SECURE IN-APP PAYMENT AND CHECKOUT MESSAGES 
Leave a message for your local store, then pay by debit or credit card.
ORDER STATUS 
Check where your order is – in preparation, cooking or out for delivery.
ABOUT PAPA JOHNS
Driven to be the best. Better Ingredients. Better Pizza. Better Get You some!
The secret to success is much like the secret to making a better pizza − the more you put into it, the more you get out of it. We’re as hungry for perfection today as we were when we first opened our doors more than 30 years ago. And we’re driven to be the best at making innovative new products and recipes. 
Quality is at our core. It’s the foundation we started with, from the first Papa Johns pizza that was made in a broom closet in Jeffersonville, IN, to now more than 5000 stores in 48 countries around the world.
Whether it’s our signature sauce, toppings, our original fresh dough, or even the box itself, we invest in our ingredients to ensure that we always give you the finest quality pizza.
For you, it’s not just a better pizza. It’s a family gathering, memorable birthday, work celebration or simply a great meal. It’s our goal to make sure you always have the best ingredients for every occasion.

Features you
bluejetty:00130670:ios.description:
It's not just an app, it's a player!
Ever wanted to listen to your favorite songs anytime, anywhere, without needing the internet?
You can easily bring in tracks from your files or cloud and enjoy your music whenever you want!
Features you'll love:
● Listen offline: Enjoy your songs anywhere, even in airplane mode.
● Files & Music Library: import songs from Files, iCloud Drive, and Apple Music.
● Cloud Services: Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, MEGA, pCloud, Box, HiDrive, and Koofr.
● Network Storage: SMB, WebDAV, and SFTP connections to your computer, NAS, or server.
● Media Servers: Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Navidrome, Subsonic, Koel, Nextcloud Music, Ampache, gonic, Songloft, LMS, and DaoLiYu.
● Wireless transfer: Drag & drop your music wirelessly from your Mac or PC via Wi-Fi.
● Last.fm integration: Automatically scrobble your tracks and keep your listening history up to date.
● Edit tags: Modify song title, artist, album, and other metadata.
● Song lyrics: View, import, edit, and export synced or plain lyrics.
● Equalizer: Customize your sound with an adjustable equalizer.
● Bass Booster: Enhance your music with deep, powerful bass.

• Card and card reader 
If you don’t have an account with us yet, you can apply via the app if:

• You’re a UK resident

• Your business has an annual turnover of £25m or less

bluejetty:00170976:ios.description:
Looking for a fun and challenging brain game? Look no further than Q-Less Crossword Solitaire, the ultimate word puzzle game! 
Invented by 80-year-old game inventor Tom Sturdevant from Nashville, Tennessee, Q-Less Crossword Solitaire challenges you to test your vocabulary and word-finding skills as you connect letters and solve anagrams.
With addictive gameplay, a strategic focus, and stunning dice animation, Q-Less Crossword Solitaire offers hours of entertainment and brain-teasing fun. The soothing sounds and immersive graphics create a relaxing and engaging daily gaming experience.
Q-Less Crossword Solitaire is not just a word game, it also challenges your pattern recognition skills as you roll the dice and strategize your next move. Check out Tom on Tik-Tok to see examples and learn from Tom Sturdevant himself, who posts video solutions every day.
The rules of the game are simple: there are 12 dice, and you must make words that connect like in a crossword. You will always get at least 2 vowels and at most 3. To win, you simply have to use all the letters. No proper nouns are allowed, and words must be longer than 2 letters. The game is called Q-Less because there is no Q in the dice.
Q-Less Crossword Solitaire offers the following features:
1. Endless word-finding possibilities
12 Dice offer endless word-finding solutions.
2. Simple and intuitive gameplay
Simple rules and addictive gameplay that challenges your pattern recognition and strategic skills
3. Stunning Graphics
Stunning dice animation and immersive graphics help you feel like you’re playing the real dice game every morning on your coffee table.
4. Relaxing and Engaging
Soothing dice roll and placement sounds make for a truly engaging experience.
5. Suitable for Everyone
Suitable for both casual gamers and hardcore puzzle enthusiasts ages 8 and above.
6. Share Your Solution With Friends
The easy screenshot feature allows you to quickly share your solutions with your friends.
7. Play For Free
You can play once per day for free.
8. Track Your Progress
Q-Less will keep track of your games played and games solved to give you an overall score. Reset your score whenever you like.
With an intuitive interface and easy-to-learn gameplay, Q-Less Crossword Solitaire is suitable for both casual gamers and hardcore puzzle enthusiasts. Challenge yourself and improve your vocabulary with each game you play. Download Q-Less Crossword Solitaire now and discover why it's the most addicting and fun word game available!
Tik-Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@qlessgame
Website: https://q-lessgame.com

bluejetty:00172129:android.description:
Monsterra is one of the few GameFi projects surviving the tough time of 2022 blockchain era. This hot multi-chain crypto game has successfully attracted more than 300,000 players after 6 months of launching and become one of the top NFT Game projects on BNB (by DappRadar) and Avalanche at the moment.
Taking inspiration from the popular Clash of Clans, Monsterra has created a fictional gaming world that revolves around farming, property building, and battling with other lands with the magical creatures named Mongen. Featuring a vibrant interface, eye-catching graphics, exciting quests, and an innovative in-game tokenomic model, Monsterra has become a huge magnet for not only active gamers but also crypto lovers. 
Unlike other NFT games, Monsterra eliminates the entry barrier by providing a free-to-play-and-earn to the large community since the beginning. Players are granted a free package of NFT items to experience endless fun at signing up for this hot blockchain games. 
In Monsterra world, players play the role of not only hardworking farmers but also mighty warriors to fight and build up their own kingdoms. Coming to Monsterra town and all the following lucrative treats will find you:
- Unique Breeding mechanism to create a one & only Mongen squad of your own. 
- Special land-shaping mechanics for creating the kingdom
- 4 in-game fierce battle modes named Adventure, Boss Challenge, BattleFront and Arena come along with huge rewards pools
- An innovative earning and burning mechanism for NFTs and in-game tokens (MSTR and MAG) to balance the economy in the long-run
- Diverse ecosystem covering 8 components with several earning streams
- Smart NFT staking mechanism to help maximize players's long-term benefits
- Full support on multi-devices: Web, PC, Mobile App (Android, iOS)

bluejetty:00177753:ios.description:
Known as the best mobile app for Athan and prayer times, our app is used by millions of Muslims around the world. Athan brings you the most accurate prayer times and many other features such as Quran, Tasbeeh, Islamic Calendar, Compass to locate the Qiblah, Ramadan 2027.
+ You can now visualize the Qibla using Augmented Reality. We are hamdolilah the first Islamic application to offer this feature to our users 
+ Full Athan: Athan Pro is the only app on the store to offer this important and unique feature
Use Athan Pro to:
- View your daily dashboard for Ramadan 2025: Contains all the prayer times for the day in addition to the remaining time for each of them.
- Accurate time such as Suhur, Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Iftar, Maghrib and Isha.
- Listen to the Holy Quran
- Qibla: Either you’re at home or traveling this feature will help you locating the Qibla direction with less effort. Thanks to the integrated compass. See the distance between your location and the Kaaba. You can also now use Qibla with ARKit and a choice of different prayer mats.
- Dynamic wallpapers that change according to the time of the next prayer.
- Wallpapers: We selected stunning backgrounds (Mosque, Minaret, Gradient colors, Sunset etc.) to apply to the app or to save to your photo album. Each picture has been selected to deliver a high-quality res to fit all your devices. 
- Azan sounds: Listen to the most beautiful azan from all around the world. 
- Today’s Extension (Widget): Designed to give you an overall view of your daily prayers without having to open the app constantly.
- Apple Watch: Install the Apple watch version & enjoy having the prayer times on your wrist.
- Use 3D touch shortcuts to quickly accomplish tasks such as accessing your daily prayers dashboard or locating the Qibla direction
- Iftar and tarawih time (Iqama)
- Hadith & Picture of the Day
- Calendar with of religious holidays
- Islamic greeting cards
- Monthly schedule (imsakiye) for prayer time
- Send funny Halal Muslim Emojis (Hijab etc.) to your friends & family.
- Tasbeeh with phonetic support, French & English 
- Azkar before, during & after the prayer 
- Display of 99 names of Allah.
- Mosque and Halal places
Please send us your feedback/remarks by email to our support. You will find the email in the app.

bluejetty:00100659:ios.description:
iNet – Know Your Network.
See at a glance what’s happening on your network.
Which devices are connected to your Wi-Fi? Are there any unknown devices? Which services are active? iNet gives you a clear overview of what’s happening on your local network – and provides the right tools for a closer analysis.
Whether at home or as a network professional, iNet lets you scan your network, identify connected devices, find active services and open ports, and wake Macs, PCs, and other devices remotely.
Give your devices custom names and icons so you can recognize them instantly the next time you scan your network.
Network Scanner
• Find all devices on your network
• View IP and MAC addresses and other device information
• Assign custom names and icons to your devices
• Set IP scan ranges and network interfaces
• Export scan results as CSV or PDF
• Connect directly via SSH, VNC, HTTP, and other services
Bonjour Monitor
• Monitor Bonjour services in real time
• See which services are available on individual devices
• View detailed information about services and domains
Port Scanner
• Find open ports on all devices
• Use predefined port scan lists
Wake on LAN
• Wake Macs, PCs, and other compatible devices over LAN or the Internet
• Put Macs to sleep, shut them down, or restart them remotely
• Execute SSH commands
• Save frequently used devices as favorites
Help & Documentation
• Built-in help in German and English
Privacy Included. Your network data stays with you.
iNet collects no user data and requires no account or sign-in.
There are no subscriptions or recurring fees. Buy iNet once – future updates are included.
Developed and maintained in Germany since 2010.
iNet is also available as a native Mac and iPad version.

bluejetty:00142581:ios.name: Skiresort.info: ski & weather
bluejetty:00142581:ios.summary: The most extensive ski app available: 6,000 ski resorts worldwide, piste maps, test reports, snow reports/snow depths, ski weather/mountain weather, webcams, live streams, ski info (slopes, ski lifts, ski passes), accommodation, ski rental,
bluejetty:00142581:ios.description:
The most extensive ski app available: 6,000 ski resorts worldwide, piste maps, test reports, snow reports/snow depths, ski weather/mountain weather, webcams, live streams, ski info (slopes, ski lifts, ski passes), accommodation, ski rental, ski lessons for ski holidays and much more! THE ski guide for skiing and snowboarding!
No other app has more ski resort information! Skiresort is the world market leader in the snow report and ski resort data market. Known through the web portal www.skiresort.info.
Detailed information on 6,000 ski resorts worldwide
 • Information on slopes, lifts, ski pass prices and opening times
 • 3,500 piste maps in high resolution
 • 500 test reports (world’s largest test portal for ski resorts)
 • 900 current snow reports/snow depths – updated daily
 • 5,300 weather reports (ski weather/weather on the mountain and at the base station, updated 4 times daily)
 • 5,900 webcams/live streams
 • Route planner to 5,300 ski resorts
 • Holiday accommodation at over 5,300 ski resorts
 • Book online: ski rental and ski lessons
 • Photos and videos
 • Data is continuously checked and expanded
Save your favourites
 • Save your favourite ski resorts: quickly access snow reports, weather and webcams
 • Access your favourite ski resorts offline: e.g., view the piste map out in the ski resort
 • Save your favourite regions/countries: e.g., for all open slopes in Austria
Ski resorts can be displayed according to 2,200 countries/regions:
 • All ski resorts worldwide
 • Continents (for example, all ski resorts in Europe)
 • Countries (for example, all ski resorts in Austria)
 • Mountain ranges (for example, all ski resorts in the Alps)
 • Regions (for example, all ski resorts in Tyrol)
 • Holiday regions (for example, all ski resorts in the Zillertal)
Ski resorts can be sorted according to the following criteria in all 2,200 countries/regions:
Biggest ski resorts, Highest ski resorts, Best ski resorts, Open slopes, Snow depth and Best weather
Ski resorts nearby
Your current location is determined. All nearby ski resorts are shown on a map and over 6,600 entry points for 5,300 ski resorts worldwide are visible. In addition, ski resorts around any location can be displayed in a list.
Shake it - Tips for your ski holiday
Where to for your next ski holiday? Under “Shake it”, you can shake out your dream ski destination or find attractive ski resorts under “Tips”. 
About the company
Skiresort Service International is the world’s largest snow report supplier and the leading provider of comprehensive ski resort and ski weather data.

UNDERSTAND YOUR HEALTH WITH DATA-DRIVEN TRACKING
Effecto is a health and mood tracking app that reveals how daily actions affect your well-being. Get personalized insights showing how habits, symptoms, and lifestyle correlate – helping you identify triggers, optimize routines, and control your health.
1. COMPREHENSIVE TRACKING TAILORED TO YOU
Whether you want to manage chronic conditions, track mental health, or simply understand what affects your mood, Effecto adapts to your unique needs.
Track everything that matters in one simple app with quick daily logging designed for real-life use. Effecto helps you:
Discover patterns between symptoms and daily factors
Identify triggers that impact your mood and health
See correlations between medications, sleep, diet, and well-being
Share accurate health data with doctors and therapists
2. DATA-DRIVEN INSIGHTS THAT EMPOWER
Effecto's smart analytics reveal connections you might miss on your own:
Visual reports showing how factors affect each other
Correlation tracking between symptoms, moods, and habits
Pattern recognition over weeks and months
Actionable insights to improve your daily routine
Do this for a few weeks, and you'll know exactly what to do and what to avoid to improve your health – for good.
3. TRACK EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS
Mental wellness practice anywhere – no equipment needed. 
Short lessons that fit busy schedules 
Beginner-friendly with advanced progressions 
Audio lessons: meditations, affirmations, breathing exercises 
80+ expert lessons with unlimited customization to track any health factor.
4. DESIGNED FOR CHRONIC CONDITIONS
Effecto is designed to support 200+ health conditions and is perfect for:
Managing chronic pain and inflammation
ADHD symptom and medication tracking
Bipolar disorder mood monitoring
Anxiety and depression patterns
Autoimmune condition management
Sleep disorder analysis
Digestive health tracking
Any condition requiring detailed symptom logs
5. SMART FEATURES FOR BETTER HEALTH
Effecto offers tools to support your wellness journey:
Medication & supplement reminders so you never miss a dose
Gratitude journal for mental wellness
Daily photo diary to track physical changes
Health notes and diary entries
Export reports to share with healthcare providers
Toxic habit identification and avoidance tracking
WHY PEOPLE LOVE EFFECTO
Reveals what affects your health 
Simple daily logging 
Data-driven insights and correlations 
Supports 200+ conditions 
Medication reminders with tracking 
Comprehensive customization 
Export reports for doctors 
Identifies triggers and patterns
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Effecto offers flexible auto-renewing plans. Your personal health data is encrypted and protected. You can delete your account and all data anytime directly from within the app.
PAYMENT & RENEWAL
You can download and use the app for free. Continued access to all features requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in account settings. Prices apply to U.S. customers; international pricing may vary by currency.
For support or questions, contact us at help@effecto.app
Privacy Policy: https://effecto.app/privacy
 Terms of Use: https://effecto.app/terms

Download Effecto and discover how tracking symptoms, moods, and daily habits can help you understand your health, identify triggers, and make informed decisions – all backed by your own data.

bluejetty:00073713:ios.name: mLite: Find my Friends Phone
bluejetty:00073713:ios.summary:
mLite Phone Family Tracker is a leading monitoring app designed to help families stay connected and informed about each other's location and device activity.
All tracking features are used only with the explicit consent of the person being
bluejetty:00073713:ios.description:
mLite Phone Family Tracker is a leading monitoring app designed to help families stay connected and informed about each other's location and device activity.
All tracking features are used only with the explicit consent of the person being monitored.
If you want to stay aware of your family's location and device activity, this app can support you in that.
mLite tracking app offers the following functionality:
*** When the tracked cell phone is the iPhone
• REAL-TIME CELL PHONE GPS TRACKER
Check the real-time GPS location of a family member when needed. The location is updated every 20 minutes.
Stay informed about their current location in a convenient way.
• LOCATION HISTORY
Review where the device has been throughout the day. Access up to 3 months of historical location data.
Useful for understanding daily routes and routines.
• LOCATION SAFETY ZONES (Geo-Fencing)
Create virtual areas (like "Home" or "School") and receive a notification when the tracked phone enters or exits them.
This feature helps with day-to-day coordination and planning.
• CONTACT LIST MONITORING
This feature allows parents, with consent, to view the contact list of the tracked device.
Helps to stay aware of new or unknown contacts added to the phone.
• PANIC BUTTON
Add a button to the tracked device that can send a location alert in case of emergency.
When pressed, a notification is sent with the device’s current location.
Designed to facilitate quick communication if immediate attention is required.
• APP USAGE STATISTICS
View how apps are being used on the monitored device to better understand digital habits.
Supports conscious screen time use and communication about digital well-being.
Data Collection Transparency:
All data is collected only with the user's explicit consent and is processed according to our Privacy Policy.
Prices
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
– Subscriptions may be managed by you and you may turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Installation
mLite iPhone phone tracker does not require any technical skills to enable tracking.
Installation requires the consent and involvement of both the parent and the person whose device will be tracked.
Before you get started with mLite:
Please be aware that mLite appears as a visible icon on the tracked device.
GPS tracking may reduce battery life on the tracked device.
Our development team is constantly working on improving the app.
If you have any questions or suggestions, contact us: support@mliteapp.com
Privacy Policy: https://mliteapp.com/privacy/
Legal Info: https://mliteapp.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00146815:ios.description:
Rule the Prehistoric Survival World in Dino King: Jurassic Hunt!
Step into a vast prehistoric world where survival is everything. In Dino King: Jurassic Hunt, you don’t just play a game—you build, explore, and fight to rule the land as the ultimate Dino King. Gather resources, collect rare items, and lead your dinosaurs on an unforgettable adventure.
As the chosen king, you must survive against fierce enemies like the Tyrannosaurus and its powerful minions. Find, hatch, and upgrade your dinosaurs, build your squad, and conquer the wild Jurassic land.
▶ Epic Battles & Survival Combat
Lead your dinos into intense battle and fight dangerous enemies across the prehistoric world. Every decision matters—your strategy determines whether your team survives or falls.
▶ Collect, Hatch & Evolve
Explore the land to find hidden eggs and collect rare dinosaurs. Evolve and upgrade your heroes into powerful warriors ready to dominate any fight.

Use gathered resources to build, craft, and strengthen your team. Customize abilities, enhance your dinosaurs, and create the ultimate survival squad.

Venture across the Jurassic wilderness to mine, collect materials, and uncover hidden treasures. Expand your territory and turn it into a thriving survival base.
▶ Survival & Shelter System
Create your own shelter and grow your dino town. Protect your people, manage your land, and ensure your squad is always ready for the next battle.
▶ Idle Gameplay with Endless Progress
Your dinos continue to fight, gather resources, and grow stronger even when you're away. Enjoy a seamless idle game experience with constant upgrades and rewards.
▶ Explore a Living Prehistoric World
Discover a dynamic world filled with danger, adventure, and opportunity. Encounter new enemies, explore unknown lands, and become the ruler of the Jurassic era.

Play anytime, anywhere—online or offline. Build your survival strategy and lead your dinosaurs to victory.
Download Dino King: Jurassic Hunt now and conquer the ultimate survival adventure! Become the king, control the land, and rule the prehistoric world!

Jet off to join the Stick Tennis Tour! Create your player and tour the world in the "definitive virtual tennis experience" (The Sun).

Create and customise your character, before heading out on court.

bluejetty:00083059:ios.summary:
Introducing Strength+, Peloton’s new app designed to take the guesswork out of strength training. 
With two different ways to strength train and infinite ways to customize your workouts, you’ll never get stuck in the same gym workout routi
bluejetty:00083059:ios.description:
Introducing Strength+, Peloton’s new app designed to take the guesswork out of strength training. 
With two different ways to strength train and infinite ways to customize your workouts, you’ll never get stuck in the same gym workout routine again.
Transform Your Strength Training
Whether you aim to build muscle, increase strength, or improve overall fitness, our app provides the tools and support you need to excel in the gym.
Immerse yourself in self-paced, multi-week programs meticulously created by Peloton’s expert fitness coaches. Whether lifting weights, building endurance, or focusing on maximal strength, Peloton Strength+ offers a variety of strength training styles to challenge and elevate your fitness.
Personalized Workouts 
- Workout Generator: Never get bored of your workout—with Peloton Strength+'s Workout Generator, you can generate thousands of workouts tailored to your needs, including muscle focus, workout length, available equipment, and experience level.
- Expert-Led Programs: Join multi-week, self-paced programs led by Peloton’s top fitness instructors for expert guidance, motivation and results.
- Progress Tracking: Log your weights and reps to visualize your journey and celebrate your accomplishments.
- In-Ear Coaching: Receive form guidance and technique tips from Peloton’s expert coaches directly through your headphones via in-ear audio.
- Instructional Videos: Access a library of video clips covering exercise demonstrations and equipment setup to ensure you’re always prepared.
New to working out? Don’t worry — Strength+ offers coach-led plans and in-ear guidance, so you’ll know exactly how to execute each move. Coaches will also walk you through equipment setup and track all your vital stats with flexible guidance that personalizes your workout schedule.
Advanced Fitness Tracker
Monitor every aspect of your strength training and overall fitness journey. Track your workouts, visualize performance in real-time and never miss a calorie burn while leveling up your athletic performance.
Smart workouts mean smarter results — Take the guesswork out of your workouts with customizable programs designed to deliver results.
Apple Watch ® Connectivity
Stay on top of your strength training with seamless Apple Watch integration. Track your workouts, monitor your progress, and get real-time metrics like heart rate and calories burned directly from your wrist. Follow along with workout cues, and easily log your weights and reps, ensuring you stay connected and motivated during every session.
Level Up with Strength+
Enjoy workouts from your favorite Peloton instructors, now with additional strength styles to challenge and elevate your fitness. Discover programs tailored to your goals and take your strength training to the next level with Peloton Strength+.
- Endurance
- Hypertrophy
- Maximal Strength
- Strength & Conditioning
Already have the Peloton App? Strength+ is a brand-new experience tailored just for strength training. While the Peloton App continues to offer instructor-led classes across all modalities, Peloton Strength+ is designed for self-paced, strength-focused workouts. Peloton Strength+ is here to help you show up to the gym ready to crush your next workout with everything you need just a tap away.
Ready to Try Strength+?
Explore a comprehensive range of exercise routines designed to push your limits and maximize performance. Enjoy detailed gym workouts and personalized workout plans focused on building muscle, increasing strength, and progressing toward your goals.
Unlock the fitness level you’ve been aiming for with Strength+. 
Download Peloton Strength+ today.

bluejetty:00071068:ios.name: Wialon
bluejetty:00071068:ios.summary:
With the Wialon app, you can maintain access to the Wialon fleet management platform anytime and anywhere. The core features include:
- Unit list control. Monitor movement and ignition state, unit location, and other fleet data in real time
bluejetty:00071068:ios.description:
With the Wialon app, you can maintain access to the Wialon fleet management platform anytime and anywhere. The core features include:
- Unit list control. Monitor movement and ignition state, unit location, and other fleet data in real time.
- Commands. Send commands, such as messages, routes, configuration and photo requests for remote unit control.
- Tracks. Build tracks of vehicle movements, displaying speed, fuel fillings, drains, and other data over a specified period, visualized on the map.
- Geofences. Switch on/off the display of the unit location inside a geofence instead of address information.
- Informative reports. Use detailed data on trips, stops, fuel drains and fillings for instant decision-making.
- History. Control unit events (movement, stops, fuel fillings, fuel drains) in chronological order and display them on the map.
- Map mode. Access units, geofences, tracks, and event markers on the map, with the option to detect your own location.
The multilingual mobile application, available for smartphones and tablets, allows users to experience the power of Wialon on the go.

bluejetty:00170110:ios.name: FOX23 Weather
bluejetty:00170110:ios.summary: Take FOX23 Weather with you on the go! FOX23 provides Tulsa and the rest of Northeastern Oklahoma with the best coverage of Breaking News and Breaking Weather. Interactive radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check conditio
bluejetty:00170110:ios.description:
Take FOX23 Weather with you on the go! FOX23 provides Tulsa and the rest of Northeastern Oklahoma with the best coverage of Breaking News and Breaking Weather. Interactive radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check conditions anywhere in the country. Live video is available within the app any time FOX23 is broadcasting Breaking Weather Alerts on the air.
FOX23’s Weather App keeps you in touch with the FOX23 Weather team and the following information: 
Summary of Features:
- There is a new radar in the weather app that matches the radar found on other digital platforms and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250 meter resolution, the highest available.
- New tracks - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
- Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types. 
- Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab. 
- Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it. 
- The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
- Additional items added seasonally
The weather app also has these critical benefits and features:
- The radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check radar anywhere in the country.
- The app provides Location-Based alerts. While many other apps offer alerts based on your county, This app supports a more precise type of alert issued for the most dangerous types of weather threats. More precision means you get alerts that matter to you, not false alarms.
- Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts for any location you enter.
- High resolution satellite cloud imagery
- Ability to add and save locations
- A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
- Additional items added seasonally
*Data and alerting available for the United States only.

bluejetty:00068675:ios.description:
Pedometer - Simple Count Steps is a free and easy-to-use step counter app for iPhone.
Using your iPhone’s built-in motion sensor, it automatically tracks your daily steps, calories burned, distance, and active time. You can quickly check your progress in clear daily reports, without any complicated setup.
The app works in the background, so there’s no need to keep it open all day. It is designed to track your activity simply and reliably while keeping battery usage low.
In addition to step tracking, the app also helps with weight management. You can record your weight and body fat percentage, view changes in graphs, and stay motivated as you build healthier habits. There is even a fun challenge mode that lets you see how far you have walked toward circling the globe.
[Recommended for]
· Anyone who wants a simple, reliable pedometer
· Users who prefer large, easy-to-read step counts
· People who want to track steps, weight, and body fat in one app
· Those who like checking daily progress on a calendar or widget
· Anyone looking for a straightforward app for walking or diet habits
[Features]
· Automatic step tracking using your iPhone
· Daily reports for steps, calories, distance, and active time
· Calendar view for checking past records
· Daily step goals and progress tracking
· Weight and body fat logging with graph display
· Notes and diary entries for daily records
· Custom themes and app icons
· Passcode lock for privacy
· Weekly step report notifications
[FAQ]
· Why can I see past step data?
→ Your iPhone automatically records step data in the background. This app reads that data, so you may be able to view steps from before you installed the app.
· Can I use it for free?
→ Yes. Most features are available for free. Optional premium features, such as ad removal and special themes, are offered through in-app purchases.
[Note]
This app uses HealthKit and your iPhone’s Motion & Fitness sensor.

【Privacy Policy】

bluejetty:00128576:ios.description:
Use your device as a live microphone! Connect to any speaker and your voice comes out loud and clear.
HOW IT WORKS
Plug your device into a speaker (or connect via Bluetooth). Open the app and tap the screen. That's it! Your voice now plays through the speaker. Works even when your screen is locked.
EASY TO USE
• One tap to turn on or off
• Works in the background
• Runs even when screen is locked
• Connect via Bluetooth, AirPlay, or cable
• No complicated setup needed
MAKE YOUR VOICE SOUND BETTER
Add echo and reverb for fun effects. Adjust bass and treble. Make your voice louder or softer. Everything updates in real-time as you talk.
EVERYTHING GETS RECORDED
Every session is saved automatically. Listen back anytime. Edit and trim recordings. Share with friends. Export to your computer.
WORKS WITH ANY SPEAKER
• Bluetooth speakers and headphones
• AirPlay devices
• Wired speakers with audio cable
• Home stereo systems
• Car audio systems
PERFECT FOR
Live Streaming - Use as a wireless mic for YouTube, Twitch, or Facebook Live. No expensive equipment needed.
Video Calls - Better audio for Zoom, Teams, or Skype. Your voice sounds much clearer.
Podcasts - Record easily with automatic saving. Edit and share when done.
Karaoke - Turn any speaker into a karaoke machine. Add echo to sound professional.
Gaming - Clear voice chat for Discord, Xbox, PlayStation. Talk to your team instantly.
Music - Record singing or instruments. High-quality sound for practice or content creation.
Announcements - Make announcements at home or small events. Everyone can hear you clearly.
Hearing Assistance - Amplify voices in meetings or classes. Helpful for better hearing.
SAVE YOUR RECORDINGS
• Save to iCloud Drive
• Upload to Dropbox
• Backup to Google Drive
• Or keep everything on your phone
ADJUST EVERYTHING
• Control volume levels
• Choose sound quality
• Pick which microphone to use
• Select your audio format (MP3, WAV, M4A)
• Organize recordings by date
LOOKS GREAT
Dark mode for nighttime. Light mode for daytime. Or match your phone's theme automatically.
SAFETY TIPS
1. Start with low volume
2. Connect speakers before turning on
3. Gradually increase volume to comfortable level
4. Avoid feedback by keeping device away from speakers
YOUR PRIVACY
Your recordings stay on your phone or your personal cloud. We don't collect or share your data. You have full control.
WHAT YOU NEED
An iPhone or iPad with a microphone. A speaker or headphones. That's all!
Whether you stream, podcast, sing karaoke, or just want to be heard better, this app turns your iPhone into a wireless microphone in seconds. No expensive gear needed!
Download now and start using your phone as a microphone!

bluejetty:00162104:ios.description:
Realize consultas online por telemedicina e tire suas dúvidas diretamente com o médico especialista. 
Nav Dasa é a sua plataforma de saúde integral, para cuidar da sua saúde por inteiro, a todo momento, por toda a vida.
Com o Nav Dasa, você pode receber atendimento médico por consulta online agendada ou imediata, marcar exames e criar um histórico com seus resultados de exames realizados nos laboratórios da Dasa.
Confira tudo o que você consegue fazer com o aplicativo do Nav Dasa: 
Consulta online (telemedicina) 
Solicite uma consulta médica e seja atendido por um clínico geral no mesmo dia. Você não precisa sair de casa, com o atendimento médico online você ganha tempo. 
Marcar exames e vacinas:
Na hora de marcar exames e vacinas, a plataforma Nav Dasa te ajuda a localizar e agendar no laboratório mais próximo. Você escolhe o dia e o horário.
Resultados de exames:
Adicione os laboratórios onde realiza seus exames e comece a criar um histórico da sua saúde. 
Se quiser, ainda pode compartilhar os resultados de exames com médicos e familiares.
Com o Nav, seu cuidado com a saúde é completo.
Fazemos parte da Dasa, a maior rede de saúde integrada do Brasil. 
Conectamos você a laboratórios e hospitais de todo o país. 
Conheça nossas marcas através do site: https://nav.dasa.com.br/

bluejetty:00127156:ios.name: Period Tracker and Calendar
bluejetty:00127156:ios.summary: Period Tracker and Calendar is an easy-to-use application that helps you track your cycle, ovulation, and fertile days. Whether you're planning a pregnancy, managing birth control, or just getting to know your cycle better, Period Tracker &
bluejetty:00127156:ios.description:
Period Tracker and Calendar is an easy-to-use application that helps you track your cycle, ovulation, and fertile days. Whether you're planning a pregnancy, managing birth control, or just getting to know your cycle better, Period Tracker & Calendar is here to support you and take care of your needs along the way.
Period Tracker and Calendar is a CE Class I Medical Device (EU) intended to support tracking menstrual cycles and monitoring related symptoms. It processes user-entered data to generate predictions for upcoming periods and estimated fertile windows, so you can feel more prepared in your daily life with information tailored to your body.
→ Everything you need to track your period and health in one place:
Simple Period Tracker
• Log your cycle quickly with a clean, intuitive interface designed to make tracking effortless 
• Get predictions for upcoming periods based on your history and your unique cycle 
Comprehensive Health Tracking
• Track 100+ symptoms, moods, and activities
• See patterns and insights about your health over time, so you can better understand your body
Fertility & Ovulation Tracking
• Monitor your fertile window and ovulation days
• Helpful for planning or preventing pregnancy, depending on your needs
Pregnancy & Baby Growth
• Follow your baby’s development week by week, with guidance and tips along the way
• Track your body changes and pregnancy milestones
Perimenopause Support
• Track symptoms like hot flashes, mood changes, and irregular cycles
• Stay aware of your body during this transition
Personalization & Discreet Reminders
• Customize your app with color themes and Dark Mode that fit your style and feel comfortable to use every day
• Set subtle, customizable reminders for periods, ovulation, or medication that keep your personal life private
Privacy and Data Protection
• Lock your app with a password to keep your data private - your information stays yours
• Back up and restore your data easily on a new device, so nothing important is lost
Key features:
- Easy-to-read calendar to visualize non-fertile, fertile, ovulation, expected period and period day
- Daily tracking to log flow, symptoms, moods, temperature, weight, medicine, PMS, notes, and more
- Clear insights into your cycle and health patterns
- Timely reminders to stay on top of your periods, ovulation, fertile days, and medication
- Quick backup and restore to keep your data safe and pick up where you left off on any device.
Pregnancy Mode
Follow your baby’s growth and your body changes week by week
Get weekly insights and tips to support you throughout your pregnancy
Track symptoms and milestones in one place
Generate and share reports with your doctor easily
Perimenopause Mode
Track symptoms like hot flashes, sleep changes, mood shifts, and irregular cycles
See how your cycle and symptoms change
Gain clearer insight into your body during this transition
Flexible tracking options that adapt to your needs
- Adjust prediction intervals for irregular or changing cycles 
- Adjust luteal phase length if you track and log ovulation
- Log cervical observations for fertility tracking 
Simple Mode
- Hide ovulation, fertility and related data
- Ideal for teens and users who prefer simple tracking
! Important !
This application does not provide medical diagnosis or medical advice and is not intended as a substitute for consultation with a qualified healthcare professional. It should not be used as the sole method of contraception, for pregnancy prevention, fertility treatment management, or for diagnosing or treating any medical condition. Predictions and insights are estimates based on user-entered data and natural biological variability may affect accuracy.
Simple, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed, Period Tracker and Calendar supports you through every stage — from cycle tracking to pregnancy and perimenopause. Download today to stay informed and keep track of your health with confidence.

bluejetty:00186412:ios.description:
Ever wanted to know what really goes on at the Bank? Play My City : Bank and you'll get to play out your own stories and discover everything that goes own at the bank. My City : Bank is very similar to your local bank and its all yours to explore and play with your own way. My City Bank offers not only the Bank and it's different offices but also the rich bankers' house where he goes to meet his kids after the bank closes.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My City games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
EXPLORE
Create your own stories while playing out your adventures and exploring the bank. Discover the banks hidden safe and treasures. Operate the photocopy machine, help customers get what they need and if you are being robbed make sure to press the alarm, you must protect the banks money.
FEATURING 
- We many awesome locations such as the Bank tellers, bank manager, Secret Safe bo, Bankers house complete with a double-sized kids bedroom, living room and of course the bankers' bed and house office!
- New characters and clothing you can play with in other My City Games including Police man and Robber as many of you requested!
- Control weather just like god. let it rain or snow, day time or night time, it is all up to you, you can do anything you want in My City games
- Discover hidden locations, hideouts, and gifts. 
- Kids Safe - No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever
To Connect the game to other My City games you should:
1. Have your apps downloaded on the device
2. Update your My City games
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00066191:ios.name: Bomb Party: Who's Most Likely
bluejetty:00066191:ios.summary:
Bomb Party - Hot potato game! The perfect word guessing game for game nights! New game mode: Who's most likely to...?
Like 5 Second Rule, Never have I ever or Taboo - Bomb Party is the perfect game for your party and even gives you the opp
bluejetty:00066191:ios.description:
Bomb Party - Hot potato game! The perfect word guessing game for game nights! New game mode: Who's most likely to...?
Like 5 Second Rule, Never have I ever or Taboo - Bomb Party is the perfect game for your party and even gives you the opportunity to add your own cards for maximum fun. 
How to play?
Once you start a round, a bomb begins to tick for a random amount of time and the players have to solve a task. Once solved, the player needs to pass the bomb (phone) to the player next to him. It may sound easy to name some words or adjectives, but as soon as the Bomb is ticking, panic kicks in and very funny situations occur.
The player loses if the bomb explodes in his hands. Every bomb cycle has a random time to explode, which adds more adrenaline and pressure to the game. It may sound easy to name some words or adjectives starting with „B“, but as soon as the Bomb is ticking, things change very quickly. 
The player with the least explosions wins the game. You can also vary the number of players (from 2-12) and rounds (from 8-20) and add different game categories. Those categories include tasks that range from naming different animals to adjectives starting with „B“. Our latest update also allows you to add individual categories and tasks! 
New: Who's most likely to...?
Start the round and read the "Who's Most Likely to...?" question out loud.
Pass the phone to the person you think best fits the question. The following players must also quickly choose someone who fits the new questions after clicking the screen!
Example: Who's most likely to be arrested for theft? The person who would most likely be arrested gets the ticking bomb (the phone) and is up next.
The game is timed – no one knows exactly when the bomb will explode! So, decide quickly which player best matches the "Who's Most Likely To" question! If the bomb explodes in your hand, you've lost this round.
For in-app purchases and subscriptions Apple's standard Terms of Use (EULA) apply:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00022215:ios.description:
Print your mailing/cards address labels and envelopes in minutes.
Address Labels takes care of fitting the text/image to the label size. You just supply the contents and select label type - AddressLabels does the rest.
Compatible with the mac app via Cloud syncing.
Excellent for organising Christmas card or other mailing lists. No more forgetting to send a card – use your list year after year.
No. 1 iPad Utilities App last Christmas on USA and UK stores.
Most Avery label sheet types supported.
Supports Brother label printers (wifi).
Supports some Dymo LabelWriters though also requires 3rd party software (see website).
Prints to wide variety of envelopes - even custom sizes. Note: whilst working on most printers, it is not guaranteed to work on all printers.
Print USPS IM barcodes for USA addresses.
AddressLabels remembers the settings, making the next job even easier.
Import names from Contacts, spreadsheet csv files or type manually.
Personalize labels with image/photo e.g. Christmas icon
Create Return address labels.
Sort on First/Last Names, post/zip code, manually or Birthday (really handy for Birthday List)
The zip sort lets you target your mailings to specific neighbourhoods and can be especially helpful in the USA allowing you to get the lowest possible postal rates for bulk mail.
Create simple Custom labels e.g. for produce labels, storage boxes etc.
Record when cards have been written, mailed, hand-delivered or sent as eCards, and number of replies.
Number of stamps required displayed. 
Print directly from your device via Airprint-enabled printer.
Share - e.g. email or airdrop list.
Export to csv.
Store extra info e.g. children names etc.
Multiple uses - Christmas, Thanksgiving, Birthdays, Weddings, Baby Showers, storage jars, file labels etc. - use your imagination.
Lists sync with other iOS devices and Mac (iOS 13 or later). 
Check person’s history e.g. to see when they last sent you a card.
Use “alias” e.g. import “John Smith” from Contacts, but display and print “The Smiths” etc.
Use person's nickname/company for label/envelope
****************************************************************
Instructions on using the app at https://ios.addresslabels.app
Great support available - support@ios.addresslabels.app

bluejetty:00128421:ios.description:
L’Appli SG PRO « Professionnels » : c’est votre banque Pro sur mobile !
Conçue avec vous pour vous apporter la meilleure expérience : la vôtre !
Retrouvez les possibilités de Progéliance Net en mobilité ! Des services pour les professionnels disponibles partout. Gardez un œil sur vos comptes professionnels et opérations bancaires à tout moment.
Avec L’Appli SG PRO, vous pouvez :
- Visualiser l’ensemble des comptes de votre abonnement sur un écran unique et être averti des événements clé de votre activité grâce aux notifications et alertes, pour une vision à 360° de vos actifs et mouvements bancaires.
- Visualiser le détail de chaque compte présent dans votre abonnement :
• Soldes comptables et instantanés,
• Consultation et partage de RIB depuis le compte
• Nouveau virement depuis le compte
• Opérations du jour
• Encours cartes
• Détail des opérations
- Effectuer des virements ponctuels ordinaires ou différés unitaires en quelques gestes et ajouter des comptes bénéficiaires si besoin.
- Accéder au suivi de vos mouvements : historique de vos opérations et signatures de vos ordres en cours.
- Visualiser et configurer l’ensemble de vos cartes bancaires professionnelles de façon autonome :
• Encours mensuel pour les cartes à débit différé,
• Verrouillage,
• Opposition,
• Plafond des paiements,
• Plafond des retraits.
- Garder un œil depuis votre mobile sur l’état de l’ensemble de vos opérations et mouvements, et signer pour valider vos opérations sensibles.
• Virements internationaux
• Virements européens
• Prélèvements européens
• LCR/BOR
• Séquences téléchargées
• Séquences télétransmises
• Ordres agences...
ENCOURS CARTE :
Mis à jour quotidiennement, l’encours carte correspond au(x) solde(s) mensuel(s) débiteur(s) lié(s) à vos opérations effectuées avec carte(s) bancaires à débit différé, et vous permet d’être au plus juste dans l’appréciation du solde de vos comptes.
La liste et le détail des opérations de l’encours carte sont également consultables dans l’application.
AUTHENTIFICATION BIOMETRIQUE :
Pour accéder plus rapidement à votre espace, identifiez-vous grâce à la reconnaissance faciale ou votre empreinte digitale. Simplifiez-vous la vie et renforcez la sécurité de l’accès à vos comptes.
ASSISTANCE TECHNIQUE:
Pour bénéficier d'une assistance, contactez-nous via le formulaire d'assistance:
https://professionnels.sg.fr/aides-contact/probleme-technique
La qualité de votre application est notre priorité, n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos suggestions et idées d’amélioration depuis la rubrique “Contact - Donner mon avis” de l’application."

bluejetty:00072498:ios.description:
A New Era of Communication
Welcome to the frontier of AI character communication. Our app is here to redefine interaction, delivering an immersive experience directly to your device. Get ready to embark on an unprecedented journey into the realm of artificial intelligence.
Your AI Companion, Always Available
Say hello to your new AI companion, always ready to chat, discuss, and connect with you, anytime and anywhere. They’re more than just bots, they’re AI characters tailored to your preferences and style. Experience unbounded companionship at your fingertips.
Experience the Thrill of Role-Playing Adventures
Harness the power of our AI technology to embark on unique role-playing adventures. Travel through time, solve intricate mysteries, or engage in exciting games - the choice is yours. Our immersive role-playing feature lets you experience your own different narratives in real-time, offering an interactive adventure like no other, all within the palm of your hand.
Craft Unique AI Personalities
Unleash your creativity and mold your AI’s character to suit your needs. Whether you desire a witty conversationalist, a motivational guru, or a compassionate listener, the possibilities are endless with our wide array of customization options. Bring your AI to life like never before.
Personalized AI, infinite Possibilities
Our AI character adapts to you, offering personalized conversations that create unique and lifelike interactions. From intellectual discourse to casual chit-chat, our app pushes the boundaries of what’s possible, tailoring each interaction to your preferences. Experience a communication experience like no other.
Intelligent Chat, Realistic Calls
Go beyond text based chat and immerse yourself in realistic calls with your AI character. Hear your AI persona come to life with our realistic voice features, adding depth and engagement to your conversations. It’s as close as it gets to a real conversation, right in the palm of your hand.
Engage in Lifelike Conversations
Prepare to be astonished by our sophisticated natural language processing. Engage in conversations that feel natural, fulfilling, and astonishingly real. Your AI understands, responds, and improvises just like a human, taking your interactions to new heights.
Personas That Resonate with You
Every interaction with your AI companion is a shared journey. Create, chat, and call your AI companions to unlock limitless possibilities. Each persona is designed to reflect your desires, forging a deep connection that resonates with you. Dive in and experience the best of AI communication.
Our app is more than just a tool, it’s a platform for exploration, learning, and growth. Break free from the constraints of traditional communication and embrace the evolutionary leap offered by AI. With our app, you’re not just observing the future of AI interaction; you’re living it.
Step into the future of communication with our app, where the cutting edge of AI technology is at your fingertips. Download and redefine your communication experience. Your personalized AI adventure awaits.

RetroArch supports a broad range of features, including:
* Netplay
* Soft patching
* RetroAchievements
* Save states
* MFi controller support
* Key remapping per core or per game
* Gyro
* Cheats
* Custom overlays
* Shaders
* Fast forward and rewind
* Game artwork
* AI translations
* Advanced latency management

”Submit to me, mortal. And I shall grant you power beyond belief!”
The Demonized is an action adventure idle RPG where you play as a hero, who embraces the devil's power to fight the evil forces that are threatening the world. Journey into the vast world where you'll explore and battle through forests, abandoned cities, snowy fields, underground mines, and demonic fortresses rendered in captivating pixel art graphics.

Choose from over 30 skills and passive traits and trade with demons to obtain incredibly powerful Souls to create your own build that unleashes the full might of the devil.

Battle bosses in various challenge modes, ascend through Tower of Trials where formidable bosses await, and defeat bosses in the Battlefield with your Raid team to get items and rewards that will aid you in your journey.
■ No Rest for the Demonized
Your character will continue fighting even when you are away. You can log in whenever you want to get your AFK rewards and collect the items you need to continue with your journey.
The fate of humanity now rests on your shoulders.
Unleash the devil’s power to purge the demons in this daring quest to save the world.

- Check-Out Request: Send a check-out request directly from your mobile key screen. Simplify the check-out process and save valuable time.

bluejetty:00170778:ios.name: Picture Builder Pixel Puzzle
bluejetty:00170778:ios.summary: Introducing the most unique, engaging, and unparalleled gaming experience – Picture Builder. Picture Builder is a revolutionary addition to the world of puzzles, guaranteed to captivate every player. Waste no time and download our free game
bluejetty:00170778:ios.description:
Introducing the most unique, engaging, and unparalleled gaming experience – Picture Builder. Picture Builder is a revolutionary addition to the world of puzzles, guaranteed to captivate every player. Waste no time and download our free game now to start building your own cities.
Picture Builder is a delight for enthusiasts of pixel art, color by number, puzzles, object finding, hidden objects, and other logical games and brain teasers. Within Picture Builder, you'll discover various cityscapes initially devoid of life. It's up to you to assemble all the elements of the picture, with each object or character representing a distinct puzzle piece. Since all puzzles are entirely unique, playing Picture Builder is always a joyful and intriguing game experience.
Each location unfolds before you in parts, requiring you to collect all objects to fill the city with interesting situations and characters. Your task is to find the correct fragments for each picture, enlarge objects, and utilize hints. In Picture Builder, you independently craft the city and its inhabitants, piece by piece. Puzzle-solving has never been this enjoyable. Install the puzzle game now and receive countless urban locations with an endless array of pixel puzzles.
Picture Builder features puzzles in various themes, including Cars, Transportation, Buildings, Plants, Animals, People, Nature, Beach, Ships, and City Streets.
Key Features of Picture Builder:
• Unique gameplay mechanics
• Colorful game design
• Abundance of puzzles
• Numerous gaming locations
• Themes: Plants, People, Animals, Transportation, Buildings, etc.
• Hints
Why play Picture Builder?
• To have a fun and enjoyable time
• To assemble puzzles
• To search for hidden objects
• To construct your own cities
• To relish beautiful pixelated images
You can play Picture Builder puzzles anytime, anywhere. Decide whether to showcase patience and assemble as many puzzles as possible in one go or spread the enjoyment by returning to Picture Builder regularly.
If you love solving puzzles, searching for hidden objects, and adore pixel art and color by number activities, don't hesitate to download Picture Builder. Start assembling pixel puzzles and create your vibrant city!
Terms of Use: https://hitappsgames.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://hitappsgames.com/privacy-policy/
