bluejetty:00122884:ios.description:
Take Landmark Credit Union with you wherever you go to manage all of your accounts. The app is free for all members. Use the app to stay on top of your finances by viewing balances, paying bills, moving money, depositing checks and much more, conveniently and securely. Use your existing user name and password to log in, or just click ""Register"" to get started. Use these features to mange your money and live healthy financially:
MANAGE ACCOUNTS
+ View balances and recent transactions without logging in
+ View transaction details for pending and posted transactions
+ See all your Landmark accounts including Checking, Savings, Mortgages, Credit Cards, and loans
+ View all your account statements and notices
+ Add and view your other financial accounts so you can get a full view of all your money in one place
PAY & TRANSFER
+ Transfer money to your other Landmark accounts
+ Pay Landmark loans
+ Send and receive money with other people using Zelle®
+ Send and receive money with other Landmark members
+ Add and manage payees and pay all your bills
+ Deposit checks by just taking a picture of your check
+ Transfer money between your Landmark accounts and accounts at other financial institutions
MONEY MANAGEMENT
+ Enriched transaction detail makes it easier to understand your spending
+ Automatically categorized transactions makes it easy to track your spending
+ View spending categories and easily set budgets
+ Set saving and spending goals
+ Get your free credit score and report and use the credit simulator to learn how to boost your score
SECURITY FEATURES
+ Setup transaction and activity alerts and balance notifications to monitor your accounts 
+ Biometric authentication available with compatible devices
+ Additional two-factor authentication offers additional protection
ADDITIONAL CONVENIENCE
+ Find Landmark locations
+ Send secure messages to get support help when you need it
+ Open additional Landmark accounts or apply for a Landmark loan

bluejetty:00097351:ios.description:
Welcome to the new age of bird feeding. With Perky-Pet®, you’ll never miss a birding moment. Pair the app to your Perky-Pet® Smart Camera Bird Feeder to enjoy up-close sightings of your neighborhood birds. The feeder’s built-in camera automatically captures photos and videos when birds stop by, and the app allows you to save, download, and share your favorite sightings. With the live stream feed, you can keep an eye on your bird feeder's activity from anywhere in real time. In addition to automatic captures, you can manually snap and record your own photos and videos while enjoying the live feed. Easily share the joy of birdwatching by inviting friends and family to access your feeder. 
Key Features:

bluejetty:00015301:ios.name: Yard Planner
bluejetty:00015301:ios.summary:
YARD PLANNER is a simple drag-and-drop 2D landscape design app with all the tools you need to mock up your property, create new designs, and share them with friends and family.
YARD PLANNER is ideal for homeowners who want to try out fresh
bluejetty:00015301:ios.description:
YARD PLANNER is a simple drag-and-drop 2D landscape design app with all the tools you need to mock up your property, create new designs, and share them with friends and family.
YARD PLANNER is ideal for homeowners who want to try out fresh ideas for their yard. Useful for landscape professionals to share designs with clients and contractors. Also perfect for children and adults alike to exercise their imagination and creativity!
Use YARD PLANNER to select and place over 800 beautiful hand-drawn elements including trees, gardens, pools, patios, hammocks, driveways, houses and sheds, solar panels, and just about anything you might want for your property–even parties and weddings!
Features include:
• Sample designs to inspire or get you started
• Simple drag-and-drop functionality
• 34 palettes (800+ hand-drawn elements) to create your landscape design layout
• Resize, Rotate, Undo/Redo, Duplicate, Flip, Group
• Rotate elements with “Snap to 90” or turn off to rotate more precisely
• Snap to grid (elements stick to a re-sizeable grid of guidelines, turn on/off in Settings)
• Rulers (visible at edges of design; zoom in to the single unit; user selects feet/meters; can be turned on/off)
• Choose from 15 different background colors
• Sketch Tool (allows users to draw garden beds and other free-form shapes with an eraser and brushes of different colors, widths and opacity)
• Map Tool (This highly accurate mapping tool based on Google Maps allows you to drop pins at the corners of your property and import the map image with measurements into the app as a background.)
• North arrow (appears with Map Tool)
• Site Analysis palettes to mark the locations of your site’s utilities and light and moisture conditions
• Notes (allows users to tag elements in their designs with typed comments or descriptions)
• Light/Dark mode (changes Note tags and North arrow from white to black for visibility against light backgrounds.)
• Animated Figures (a palette of animated elements—a person, dog, cat, bird, and car—that move through your design on a looped or repeating path, adjustable speed, play and stop animation)
• Import a Photo as a background (useful for importing a digital image of your property plan)
• Create different Layers of elements in your design. Add, delete, rename layers, make each layer visible/invisible, lock/unlock for editing, and reorder layer position.
• In-app step-by-step guide to creating your Property Plan.
• Designs automatically save to the app’s Saved Designs gallery
• Share designs on social media
• Email an editable design so friends can edit one another’s designs and email them back and forth
***As featured in The New York Times, Fox News, USA Today, Gardenista, and more.
“Home Outside allows you to create intricate and varied landscapes…And when you’re finished designing your yard or indulging in a little dreamscaping, you can email results to friend.” –Kate Murphy, The New York Times
“The app gives you drag and drop tools to create a garden design idiosyncratic to your garden [and] allows you to choose hardscape materials, design paths and patios, and arrange furniture in your outdoor space.” –Dalilah Arja, Gardenista
“I can’t imagine a designer who wouldn’t want to have this on their phone or tablet. I’ve tried this app … it’s a great tool for a ‘quickie’ design that you can show clients … and then refine as you like.” –Jane Berger, Garden Design Online

100K+ psychic readings

DAILY HOROSCOPES AND TAROT

bluejetty:00029795:ios.description:
Verizon Call Filter takes the guesswork out of answering your phone, with features that screen and automatically block incoming spam calls.
With Call Filter, you can:
• Identify suspected spam calls with alerts. 
• Automatically block spam based on their risk level and send them to voicemail (Call Filter automatically blocks high-risk callers).
• Report phone numbers as spam.
• Use filters to block other unwanted callers, such as robocalls.
• Adjust spam filter settings any time.

Download Verizon Call Filter and start answering calls with confidence.

Accounts with 3 or more eligible lines can subscribe to Call Filter Plus (Multi-line) for $10.99/mo by logging in to My Verizon. The spam filter will be automatically set to block high-risk spam callers, but you can change your block settings at any time. Data charges apply.
Verizon's Call Filter App requires a Verizon standard monthly account on an eligible device.
Please reference https://www.vzw.com/support/how-to-use-call-filter/ and https://www.vzw.com/support/call-filter-faqs/ for step-by-step instructions on how to use the app

bluejetty:00146189:ios.summary:
The official app for The Hundred is here. With access to your tickets alongside the latest scores and highlights, it’s the best way to keep up to date this summer.
The Hundred will provide an unforgettable experience for the whole family,
bluejetty:00146189:ios.description:
The official app for The Hundred is here. With access to your tickets alongside the latest scores and highlights, it’s the best way to keep up to date this summer.
The Hundred will provide an unforgettable experience for the whole family, bringing world-class sporting action and excitement and the app gives you an opportunity to get involved. 
Whether you’re attending a match this summer or following along at home here are some of the great features you’ll have access to with The Hundred app:
As a ticket holder
* Access to your tickets – all your tickets are in the app! Simply sign in ahead of your match-day to access them.
* Quickly share tickets – Easily forward tickets to friends and family in your group ahead of match day. 
* Seat instructions – find your way to your seat by following the instructions in the app.
For everyone
* Buy tickets – book your place at upcoming games near you
* Bring the game to life – our incredible Augmented Reality feature brings your favourite players into your front room (or wherever you’re watching). 
* Choose your favourites – pick your team and players and get even quicker access to the latest scores and personalised push notifications
* Stay up to date - Get all the latest news and videos from The Hundred
* Unmissable highlights – watch all the biggest moments from every single match of the competition. 
* Be entertained – play mini-games in the app whether you’re at the game or watching at home. 
* Get involved – take part in polls and quizzes during the match and see what other people are saying
* Be heard – whether it’s deciding on the walk-out music or choosing the Match Hero, you can have your say. 
Get the app today and start the countdown!

bluejetty:00187640:ios.description:
Add watermarks to your photos and videos with the Add Watermark app! This is the fastest and simplest app for adding logos or text to images or videos. Protect your copyrights by adding your logo or name to your images and video clips so that no one can claim your photos as their own. This is a very important tool for graphic designers, photographers, or influencers who usually post interesting and engaging content on the internet.
The process of adding watermarks using our app is extremely easy and fast. This will give strong protection to your images, photos, and videos. There are so many irresponsible people who claim photos or videos that do not belong to them.
With Add Watermark, you can apply watermarks in batch to unlimited photos with a single click. In addition, we provide +40 ready to use watermark templates for photos and videos, Apply batch photo watermarks to unlimited Photos. You can also add text or logos as watermarks to your photos and videos, and customize the fonts, colors, sizes, and styles of your text.
You can add your own signature to the image, adjust the pen thickness and color for the signature, and add stickers, emojis, and other fun things to decorate your images. In addition, you can add frames and backgrounds to enhance your photos.
With Add Watermark, you can use the app in many ways to enhance your images and videos to get attention. The process of adding watermarks is very intuitive and simple. You don't have to deal with so many unused features that confuse you. We have made the process very simple and easy, whether it's to add watermarks or to decorate your photos with stickers and frames.
Features : 
● Ready to use watermark templates.
● Creative mode to create unique designs.
● +150 Fonts.
● +17000 Icons for all domains.
● Gradients colors.
● Batch Mark (Multiple photos at the same time).
● Video watermark animations.
● Import/Export design from phone library.
SUBSCRIPTIONS :
- Monthly Plan: 1.99$/week.
- Yearly Plan: 19.99$/year.
Pricing may vary depending on the country of residence.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Privacy Policy: https://nwlamll.github.io/apps/pp.html
Terms of Use : https://nwlamll.github.io/apps/termsofuse.html

With over 3,500 high quality questions with answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere and gives you a better chance of passing the SHRM-CP & SCP certification exams on the first try!
SHRM Test Prep 2027 now supports the SHRM Certified Professional (SHRM-CP) & the SHRM Senior Certified Professional (SHRM-SCP) exam preparation. Our exam experts will update and revise the content according to the latest syllabus provided by the Society for Human Resource Management.
SHRM Test Prep 2027 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have expertly categorized all subjects on the exam so you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 3,500 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the SHRM-CP & SCP exams can be difficult, but with the help of SHRM Test Prep 2027, if you are determined to pass your certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals!
Stop feeling confused or frustrated about preparing for the SHRM-CP & SCP exams, effective change takes time and effort, follow in the footsteps of SHRM Test Prep 2027 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Use: http://www.supertest.vip/Terms-of-Service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.

Come in. Stay for AGES and AGES …
Welcome to YESTERTIDE, another exciting mind-bender from the MysteryCaper team. Enjoy your visit. You're not going anywhere anytime soon.
–
You've been backpacking for days. You're tired; you're sore. You just want to SLEEP … You stumble upon a quaint old village. YESTERTIDE. Quiet, unassuming, cobblestoney. You'll rest here. It's funny, though. You've never heard of this place, and it's not on any maps. Oh well. It will do for now. But when is NOW exactly? And why do you feel like someone — or some-THING — is watching you?
–
FEATURES
• a thrilling array of hand-drawn art
• an endless supply of puzzles and riddles
• the occasional cryptic character interaction
• hilarious in-game comments
• a pigeon
• a cat
• time-travel
• aliens
• card tricks
• and YOU, the last hope for Yestertide — and beyond
–
MysteryCaper. It's COMEDY SOLVED.

bluejetty:00089660:ios.name: License Plates of Legend
bluejetty:00089660:ios.summary: Play a new take on the classic road trip license plate game, with scores for plate rarity! Have fun on long road trips by keeping track of which license plates you've seen, and Plates of Legend will tell you if you've found a rare one. Plat
bluejetty:00089660:ios.description:
Play a new take on the classic road trip license plate game, with scores for plate rarity! Have fun on long road trips by keeping track of which license plates you've seen, and Plates of Legend will tell you if you've found a rare one. Plates from far away may be rare, epic, or even legendary. Earn combo points for certain groups of plates: The 13 original colonies, all the states touching the Mississippi River, the states along the Appalachian Trail, and more.
• Privacy-first design: No ads. No tracking. No personal information is collected or shared.
• Based on your home state, license plates are more rare if they come from farther away.
• Plates from states with fewer people are more rare than plates from highly populated states (California vs. Wyoming).
• Keep track of your past games. See what you've found in the past, and which plates you've never seen before.
• Share your subscription or purchase using Family Sharing.
• Support for plates from Canada and Mexico.
We're the parents of a ten-year-old, and during long road trips to visit family we were playing the old-school license plate game, making notes on pieces of paper as we saw new license plates. At the end of the drive, we would count how many different plates we found and then start all over again on the drive home. We thought it would be fun to highlight plates that came from very far away, and started the first version of the app. Knowing how much my daughter enjoyed finding rare item drops in other games, we decided to use that language in the game, and she loved it. She always announces the plate rarity: “common” in a bored, flat tone; “rare” with more interest; and “epic” with real excitement. I added the explosions for fun and she enjoys clicking on those repeatedly just for the joy of seeing the effect.

bluejetty:00185334:ios.description:
From the creators of the award winner Kingdom Rush saga comes the most extraordinary rts offline game! 
Fight challenging real time strategy sci fi battles on amazing and unknown planets. Command brave soldiers, mighty mechas and powerful aliens against hordes of space monsters, swarms of insectoids and robot armies in a galaxy far far away.
PLAN, ATTACK AND BEAT ALL THE ENEMIES ADAPTING YOUR STRATEGY with fearless marines, powerful heroes, and alien allies against hordes of space monsters, insectoids, and robot armies.
ADAPT YOUR STRATEGY by changing the role of your troops even in the thick of battle, from ranger to sniper, from flamethrowers to missile launchers.
RECRUIT AND TRAIN THE GREATEST HEROES in the galaxy, lead them into dangerous territory against near-impossible odds and unleash their mighty powers and abilities.
TURN THE TIDE OF BATTLE with orbital strikes, intelligent mines, support troops, turrets and a wide array of special weapons.
Armies of robots, crushed starships, gigantic monsters, unknown races, brave assaults, desperate rescues, audacious sabotages... the galaxy needs your command.
The galaxy needs the Iron Marines
FEATURES
• 21 CAMPAIGN MISSIONS across three sci fi planets. Each action-packed challenge will have you improve your strategy to save the galaxy!
• 21 SPECIAL OPERATIONS that will test if you have what it takes to battle your way through space.
• 40+ UPGRADES to build the ultimate RTS army! Choose between Defense Drones, Napalm Rockets, Ricocheting Blasts, Lethal Weapons and many more.
• +7 UNITS to bring into battle and give your hero some extra firepower!
• 8 SPECIAL WEAPONS to unleash hell on your enemies and keep expanding your tactics like space itself! What’s better than a well-placed missile? An orbital strike of 50 high-explosive missiles!
• DEFEAT UNIQUE BOSSES in epic battles. They are green, mean, killing machines!!! Well… some are machines and these aliens aren’t green… but they’re all massive and determined to crush you. Suit up, Marines!
• 70+ ACHIEVEMENTS to complete and show everyone you’re the best RTS commander in the whole galaxy!
• NO WI-FI IN SPACE? No worries, offline play guaranteed!
• CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTY MODE: Casual, Normal or Veteran. Don’t get cocky! Or Do! Your choice!
• IMPOSSIBLE MODE. Only for the most daring, reckless, all-out-of-bubblegum marines in space. We dare you!

bluejetty:00077372:ios.name: Señales de Trafico de la DGT
bluejetty:00077372:ios.summary: Simulador de concurso para aprender la señalización vial del Reino de España. Esta aplicación ayudará a aprender o refrescar la memoria en los conocimientos de todos los señales viales en forma de juego y le habrá útil a gran cantidad de us
bluejetty:00077372:ios.description:
Simulador de concurso para aprender la señalización vial del Reino de España. Esta aplicación ayudará a aprender o refrescar la memoria en los conocimientos de todos los señales viales en forma de juego y le habrá útil a gran cantidad de usuarios, desde los pasantes de academias de conductores hasta los conductores con experiencia.
Lo especial de la aplicación "Señales de tráfico de España":
+ Dos modos de juego. El primero es el concurso con elegir una respuesta correcta de los que son ofrecidas. El segundo es el modo “Correcto / Incorrecto” donde se tiene que cotejar la figura del señal vial con su significado.
+ La elección del grupo de señales para entrenamiento. Se puede elegir un grupo determinado de señales viales cual sabe menos o cual desea entrenar en este momento.
+ El resumen de los resultados después de cada juego. El simulador muestra la cantidad de las respuestas que ha dado el usuario y la relación de las correctas.
+ Dos niveles de dificultad. En modo de concurso se puede fijar de cuantas respuestas el usuario va a elegir la respuesta correcta, de 4 o de 6. Así configuración le facilitará o, al contrario, le complicará el modo de juego y ayudará a ajustar el entrenamiento a su nivel del jugador.
+ Guía con todos los señales de OC y sus descripciones.
+ Juego de señales de tránsito de ultima redacción del año 2024.
+ Para el funcionamiento de aplicación no se necesita el acceso al Internet.
+ La aplicación esta disponible para los teléfonos y para las tabletas.
+ El interface sencillo, comprensible y fácil de usar.

bluejetty:00047678:ios.description:
The Ferry Port welcomes you and challenges you! Drive around realistic looking harbour, explore its nooks and crannies and most of all complete your job quickly and efficiently! You will be scored after each task and the better you do, the faster you progress!
You will have to complete multiple precision driving mission in diverse and unique vehicles. Each one handles differently and discovering their strong and weak points will be up to you! Park Cars, Trucks, Caravans and Busses on the Ferry deck, and take care of the important driving jobs
4 AWESOME VEHICLES TO DRIVE
You can choose between a pickup truck, a tourist coach, a freight truck and a SUV towing a caravan. Each one handles a bit differently. Learn to control all of them and be careful not to crash!
REALISTIC PHYSICS
Harnessing the power of our true physics engine, each car feels different to drive so you’ll need to adapt and learn “on the job” to park without causing any damage!
MANY FUN MISSIONS
A large number of increasingly challenging Precision Parking Missions to complete. Race against competitors from all over the world on the leaderboards!
FREE TO PLAY
The Main Game Mode is 100% FREE to play, all the way through, no strings attached! Extra Game Modes which alter the rules slightly to make the game easier are available through optional In-App Purchases. Each mode has separate leaderboards to make for totally fair competition!
GAME FEATURES
▶ 4 Unique Vehicles: Pickup Truck, SUV & Caravan, Tourist Bus & Freight Truck
▶ Realistic Ferry Harbor Map: with Awesome Detail & Graphics!
▶ A lot of Challenging Missions: 100% Free-to-Play!
▶ Customisable Controls: including buttons, steering wheel & tilt
▶ Multiple views: including Drivers Eye view

MERGE AND MATCH
bluejetty:00160427:ios.description:
MERGE STICKER PLAYBOOK 2D takes the classic sticker book experience to a whole new level! Dive into creativity, relaxation, and brain-teasing fun through a mix of color by number, paint by number, and puzzle-solving games.
MERGE AND MATCH
Combine vibrant stickers using color match and sorting mechanics to unlock each sticker coloring book page. Merge pieces to complete each puzzle in a fun and satisfying way.
COLORING ADVENTURE
Instead of traditional coloring, fill designs with colorful stickers in a unique paint by number style. It’s a fresh take on coloring books that lets your creativity shine.
ENDLESS THEMES AND CHALLENGES
Explore landscapes, animals, and iconic landmarks. Each page offers a new puzzle-solving challenge that engages your mind and unlocks stunning sticker art.
FUN FOR ALL AGES
Perfect for kids and adults alike. Enjoy relaxing gameplay or team up with friends and family to solve sticker puzzles, match colors, and sort your way to victory.
STICKER MASTERY
Earn rewards, unlock achievements, and grow your collection as you merge, match, and create beautiful art through color by number gameplay.
RELAXING GAMEPLAY
With calming ASMR-style visuals and gameplay, it’s the perfect blend of merging, coloring, and puzzle-solving in one relaxing experience.
Download Merge Sticker Playbook 2D now and discover a satisfying journey of creativity, color, and puzzle fun!

The Secret Order 2: Masked Intent is a suspenseful adventure with historical elements based on the theme of the conflict between good and evil.
The daughter of the Master of the Order of the Griffins receives an alarming call. She is the only person who can stop the new member of the high council – the Secret Five – from destroying the Order. The organisation has guarded the world for centuries, but recent events have brought it to the verge of ruin. Embark on an epic journey full of magical items, forbidden mysteries, and time travel. Restore the order of the world and make amends for the sins of the past. Learn the secrets of forgotten artefacts, travel to the 17th century, earn the trust of the spectres imprisoned on a mysterious island, and discover the seat of the Clan of the Dragon, whose only mission is to thwart the efforts of the Order and to spread chaos.
Will the two powerful artefacts be returned to their rightful places and will the world be saved from destruction? Will the Master's daughter live up to the task?

helloPOLY is an honest dating and community for people who love outside the mainstream — openly, and on their own terms.
Formerly PolyFinda — same community, new name.
How is helloPOLY different from regular dating apps?
Mainstream dating apps weren't built for the way you love. helloPOLY is purpose-built for people who are ethically non-monogamous (ENM), polyamorous, or seeking kink — so it's faster to find people who want the same thing, and you spend less time filtering out incompatible matches. Inclusive and supportive of diverse relationship styles, by design.
Looking for love? Friendship? Something kinky and fun? Someone to practice shibari or rope bondage with? There's room for all of it here — because there are more ways to love and connect in ethical non-monogamy. And you don't have to confine yourself to one identity: choose different styles of relating that interest you, so you find exactly what you're after and match with people looking for someone like you. New to the ENM or kink scenes, or experienced in both — helloPOLY helps you make real connections. Start meeting like-minded people near you today.
Who created helloPOLY, and why?
helloPOLY was founded by members of the ethical non-monogamy community to help people explore every form of ENM together. Its open-minded philosophy naturally draws people from the queer, BDSM, and kink communities too — but not everyone exploring ENM is into kink. So the app matches people on shared interests and keeps incompatible profiles out of your feed. It also has a particular focus on shibari, helping riggers and rope bottoms find each other to practice with.
For example, if you're after a kinky play partner or a shibari rope bottom, you can filter out every profile that doesn't list kink or shibari as an interest.
HOW IT WORKS
helloPOLY is free to join — find polyamorous, open, poly-curious, or kinky people near you in minutes.
APP FEATURES
- Inclusive profiles — choose from over 10 gender identities and relationship styles.
- Filter for exactly who you want — hide kinky profiles, or see only the kinksters. Same for shibari, and for monogamous or polyamorous. Your feed, your rules.- So much more than dating — helloPOLY is also where you'll find friendship, love, relationships, and marriage, shibari and kink events, local poly meetups, parties, education, and counselors and therapists who specialize in alternative relating.
helloPOLY PREMIUM
Go Premium to get the most from helloPOLY:
- Unlimited likes — like as many people as you want
- Unlimited messages and chat before matching
- See who's already liked you
- Boosted visibility — add your profile to the feature page for more likes
- Go incognito — only people you've liked can see your profile
- Superlikes to stand out
- Second Chance — revisit a profile you skipped too quickly
- Restore archived chats
helloPOLY Premium renews monthly unless you adjust or cancel it in your App Store settings.
FULL 1 month $29.99 (recurring)
FULL 3 month $39.99 (recurring)
FULL 6 month $59.99 (recurring)
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
Privacy Policy https://hellopoly.co/privacy/
Terms of Use https://hellopoly.co/terms/
Community Guidelines: https://hellopoly.co/community-guidelines/

bluejetty:00172512:ios.description:
TRANSACTION AND CHECKLIST MANAGEMENT
The SkySlope iOS app lets you manage transactions directly from your mobile device: view checklists, upload documents to them, and leave comments.
BETTER FORM-FILLING STARTS HERE
Start and edit transactions anywhere—on your couch, in your car, or while waiting in line at Starbucks (quad venti Latte, please). 
FILL FORMS FAST
Our libraries are filled with up-to-date forms and editable fields, making it feel like you have a personal assistant in your pocket
MLS SYNCED
Save time by letting us enter data for you. With information pulled directly from the MLS, you can focus on what you love while we handle the busy work
DIGITAL SIGNATURE
Just drag and drop signature and date blocks onto your forms, hit send, and your clients will sign them in no time. Email forms directly from the app and relax while the digital magic happens
VOICE ASSIST 
California agents can use the app’s voice assist feature to create offers or fill out Buyer and Broker Compensation Agreements hands-free. Just open the app, tap the mic icon, and say, 'Start a Buyer Agreement' or ‘Start an offer’ to begin.
An existing account is required to access the app.
Terms of Use: https://skyslope.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://skyslope.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00162103:ios.description:
In order to bring you a more comprehensive and professional user experience, inspire you to enjoy sports, live a more active and healthy life, and welcome a stronger and better self, we have upgraded Haylou Fun.
Haylou Fun can support connecting a variety of smart devices and integrate health and exercise data to comprehensively manage your health.
Key features of Haylou Fun:
【Record health data】
Record steps, consumption, heart rate, sleep, blood oxygen saturation, menstrual tracking and other data to pay attention to your own health.
【Multiple sports records】
Support 100+ exercise modes, record data such as duration, heart rate, consumption, distance, trajectory, pace, exercise target, etc. during exercise, and support voice broadcast of exercise status.
【Device Management】
Manage the device on the APP side, and enable settings such as message notification, call reminder, alarm clock, weather, etc.
【Rich dials】
There are a large number of watch faces to choose from. You can choose your favorite watch face to synchronize with the watch according to your mood, and you can set your favorite picture as your own watch face.
【Night sleep monitoring and analysis】
Record sleep information every night, analyze your sleep quality score by analyzing the proportion of different sleep in sleep, and provide corresponding sleep analysis and suggestions.
【Data Sharing]】This app supports Apple's "Health" app. After authorization, you can synchronize your steps and other health data to the "Health" app.
Haylou Fun will be connected to more smart devices in the future, adding more useful and fun functions, let us accompany you to live a healthy life together!
If you have any questions or suggestions, you can send feedback to:
service@haylou.com (or submit feedback in the app)

bluejetty:00165086:ios.description:
Looking for the perfect way to fight boredom? Shoot the Box is an action-packed casual game where your aim decides your score! Hit all the boxes, collect gold, unlock powerful weapons, and climb the global leaderboard.
---- Gameplay ----
Test your shooting skills in this fast-paced horizontal shooter! Hit all the boxes, but watch out — missing a box costs a life. Lose all three, and it’s Game Over!
• Wood boxes: Just normal boxes, keeps the action going.
• Score boxes Score lots of points quick.
• Gold boxes: Grab tons of gold to level up your weapons.
• Ammo boxes: Refill your ammo and stay in the game.
• Explosion boxes: Trigger crazy combos to boost your score.
• Black boxes: Dangerous! Hitting them costs a life.
• Powerup boxes: Unlock special weapons with powerful shooting mechanisms.
The simple yet action-packed gameplay makes Shoot the Box the perfect casual game to fight boredom!
---- Weapon Sandbox ----
In the sandbox mode you can explore over 45 unique weapons! From pistols, shotguns, and sniper rifles to crazy options like the laser gun or freezer gun — there’s a perfect weapon for every playstyle. Keep improving your aim and see how far you can go!
---- Why You’ll Love It ----
• Easy to pick up, hard to master — perfect for quick sessions or long play.
• Endless challenges to keep boredom away.
• Compete globally in the leaderboards and become a top shooter!
Fight your boredom and dive into the action-packed adventure now!
Grab your favorite gun, aim carefully, and destroy all the boxes in Shoot the Box!

bluejetty:00118867:ios.name: Chase Mobile Checkout
bluejetty:00118867:ios.summary:
Accept credit cards for your business with your iPhone.
With a merchant services account and card reader from Chase and an iPhone, use Chase Mobile Checkout to accept payments on-the-go, virtually anywhere in the U.S., at any time.
Exte
bluejetty:00118867:ios.description:
Accept credit cards for your business with your iPhone.
With a merchant services account and card reader from Chase and an iPhone, use Chase Mobile Checkout to accept payments on-the-go, virtually anywhere in the U.S., at any time.
Extend Your Business
• Be ready to take your customers’ payments when and where they are located.
• Take your business with you. Be able to process payments when you are away from your business, computer or credit card terminal.
• Allow additional employees to accept credit card payments on their iPhone.
Streamline Your Business
• Create a product catalog for easy checkout.
• Live, U.S. based, 24/7 telephone customer support.
• Have one payment processing relationship: Single statement, centralized reporting and one number to call for any issues. 
• Customize your employees’ access. 
Make It Easy For Your Customers 
• Conduct faster transactions. If your customers are waiting in line, add an additional payment acceptance terminal with your iPhone.
• Bring the transaction to your customer. Allow your customers to pay anywhere in your store. Allow customers to pay for deliveries at the time of receipt.
• Send customers’ electronic receipts via email or text.
Help Protect Your Customers and Your Business
• Credit card information is encrypted at the time of the card swipe or insertion and during transmission and processing.
• Geo-location features allow you to determine the location of the transaction, which helps with dispute settlement. Location map is printed on receipt.
Take Your Business With You
• Easier reconciliation. View information about your Chase merchant services account from your iPhone.
• Search for individual transactions and review account activity.
• Process refunds and voids.
To process transactions, you must have a merchant services account with Chase, install the Chase Mobile Checkout app on your mobile device and use a mobile card reader from Chase. In order to pair your mobile device with the reader, it must meet minimum requirements of iOS 10.0 and Bluetooth® 4.0. Businesses are required to complete an application and agree to terms and conditions at the time of enrollment. All businesses are subject to credit approval. Merchant services are provided by Paymentech, LLC (“Chase”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.
There is no charge to download this app, but depending on your merchant service account terms, there may be charges associated with the purchase and shipment of the card reader. When using the app, message and data rates may apply. Such charges include, but are not limited to, those from your communications service provider. In addition, all applicable processing fees outlined in the merchant services contract with Chase will be assessed for all transactions initiated through the app.
Transaction processing may be interrupted for various reasons, including service outages affecting your phone, wireless or Internet provider, technology failures, and system capacity limitations.
iPhone® is a registered trademarks of Apple Inc.

Book your ride in minutes with the Dart app using partnered drivers and local taxis. With more drivers joining, Dart provides transportation convenience for riders to travel anywhere within Brunei Darussalam. 
DART CAR
-Dart Car offers transport services at a discounted rate pre-agreed upon booking to find out more click here : https://www.dartbrunei.com/
- Dart Car uses trained and licensed individuals and private cars with appropriate insurances for a safe and reliable service.
DART TAXI
- Book your regular taxi with Dart. Dart Taxi relies on local registered taxis and uses the standard metered fare. Dart assists by giving a cost estimate based on a distance calculation without surcharges or time factor.
- Now with Dart you can pay with cash and receive an electronic receipt via email.
HOW TO USE DART 
- Download the App for free and register your account
- Register a phone number where the driver can contact you (you may update this at any time). 
- Our app uses your smartphone GPS and Geo-location function to help confirm your pick-up point. Tap on marker and type in a helpful note for our drivers to find you. Eg. I’m waiting upstairs or a detailed street name/number
- For your drop-off point just type the street address or closest landmark/street and accurately drag pointer on map. 
- An estimated fare will appear and you can request on demand pick-up.
DRIVE WITH DART
Sign up on www.dartbrunei.com to qualify drivers need to:
- Be Bruneian citizen or Permanent resident of Brunei
- Be 21-65yrs old with a valid Class-3 License
- Have a Car less than 10yrs from date of first registration
- Be Competent in conversational English and Malay
For more information refer to our website www.dartbrunei.com or get in touch support@dartbrunei.com

“The best Tor-related offering on iOS right now is Onio
bluejetty:00164075:ios.description:
Onion Browser is the original free and open-source Tor-powered web browser for iOS. Onion Browser helps you access the internet with more safety and privacy, and no extra cost to you.
“The best Tor-related offering on iOS right now is Onion Browser” - The Daily Dot, October 14, 2015.
Featured in: The New York Times, The Guardian, Salon, TechCrunch, Gizmodo, Boing Boing, Lifehacker, Macworld, The Daily Dot, & others.
FEATURES:
• Browse the internet over Tor:
- Protect your privacy from website tracking
- Secure your traffic from insecure wireless networks and ISPs
- Access .onion sites that are only accessible over Tor.
• Fight online tracking: block scripts and automatically clear cookies and tabs, based on your preferences.
• And more privacy-enhancing features!
DISCLAIMERS:
- Web browsing is much slower than through a normal web browser or a VPN because your traffic is encrypted and relayed through the Tor network.
- Onion Browser might not work on networks with advanced network restrictions. If the app does not connect, try using bridges (or a different type of bridge), force-quit, and then restart the app.
- Use of Onion Browser is at your own risk; remember that sensitive data does not always belong on a mobile device.
** Onion Browser is free and open-source software. You can read more about Onion Browser and how to support development of Tor on iOS by visiting onionbrowser.com **

bluejetty:00068206:ios.name: Valora: Anxiety Sleep Hypnosis
bluejetty:00068206:ios.developer: Hypnosis and Meditation for Success, LLC
bluejetty:00068206:ios.summary:
Valora is a sleep hypnosis app for an anxious mind: 20 Sleep Learning programs by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for fear, worry, stress and confidence, played whole while you sleep.
Joel Thielke is a certified clinical hypnotherapist, certified ins
bluejetty:00068206:ios.description:
Valora is a sleep hypnosis app for an anxious mind: 20 Sleep Learning programs by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for fear, worry, stress and confidence, played whole while you sleep.
Joel Thielke is a certified clinical hypnotherapist, certified instructor, and NLP coach and trainer. His voice is the one you hear, start to finish, on every hypnosis program here.
HOW SLEEP LEARNING WORKS
Each program plays in one piece, start to finish. Press play at bedtime, get comfortable, and let it carry you down. There is no wake-up inside the program, so you drift off while it plays and it keeps working through the night. Repeat it all night, give it a sleep timer, or let the built-in wake alarm bring you up gently in the morning.
ANXIETY & FEAR
• Face Your Fears — included with the app, plays in full from the first open
• No More Anxiety
• Stop Your Fear of Flying
• Stop Stage Fright
• Stop Obsessing
• Overcome Stress
CONFIDENCE & STRENGTH
• Total Confidence
• Inner Strength
• Empower Yourself
SLEEP & CALM
• Deep Sleep
• Pure Meditation
SLEEP STORIES
• Old World Essex, narrated by Rachael Meddows
• Travel to Maui, narrated by Catherine Perry
SLEEP SOUNDS
• Beach Campfire
• Rain on Umbrella
• Soothing Storm Sounds
SUBLIMINAL AFFIRMATIONS
Four tracks in a section of their own, made to repeat all night:
• Anxiety Relief Subliminal Affirmations — low cello-like drones and Tibetan bowls on one steady key
• Calm Sleep Subliminal Affirmations — a low drone under warm pads and resonant bowls
• Deep Rest Subliminal Affirmations — warm velvety pads, soft distant strings and a faint high shimmer
• Peaceful Dreams Subliminal Affirmations — a very low drone, shimmering pads and single distant piano notes
THE SOUND MIXER
Put a steady sound beneath the voice, at your own level: rain, a storm, ocean waves, a campfire, crickets, wind, chimes and more. One sound is included. Layer up to six, save your mixes, and let them keep playing after the program ends, with the Sound Mixer purchase or Unlock All. The mixer also plays on its own from Home, with no program at all.
TONIGHT
The Tonight card lines up your night in one tap: a program, a wind-down, a night sound, and the wake alarm. Build playlists, mark favorites, and search by what you feel ("worry", "plane", "can't sleep").
A FREE GUIDE
"The Quiet Hours" is the companion guide Joel wrote for this app: a seven-night calm plan, exercises you can do in the day, a worry log for the evening, and a 21-night log. Tap it in the app and this app's own page opens in Safari, where your email address gets you the PDF. Home then offers one item from it each day on the Today card.
UNLOCK ALL
One purchase opens every program, all four Subliminal Affirmations tracks and the Sound Mixer, for good. Unlock All includes everything we add to this app, now and later, and it is available through Family Sharing. Programs can also be bought one at a time. No subscription, nothing renews.
ABOUT JOEL THIELKE
Joel has worked with thousands of clients in his practice, from athletes and actors to parents and students, and millions of people have listened to his programs. His method is simple: relax the body, quiet the critical mind, and let the subconscious take in the words.
A NOTE ON SAFETY
These programs are for relaxation and personal growth. They are not a substitute for medical or psychological care. Listen only in bed or somewhere safe to rest, never while driving.
Questions? support@motivationalhypnotherapy.com

bluejetty:00017452:ios.description:
Ever wish for a game that not only works your mind but also helps calm it? Word Bliss is the ticket for your brain to go on a fun yet peaceful journey while getting better at your wordplay!
Ward off boredom and welcome tranquility playing this classic word link game that will test your puzzle solving skills, vocabulary, and spelling. And with serene backgrounds showcasing Planet Earth, your state of Zen will never be in jeopardy!
Starting with curiosity, play through these wonderful feelings, while also adding to your vocabulary word count. As you move up the levels, each picture path will match the emotion you are on.
Not as difficult as kakuro and much more interesting than any word link game out there, Word Bliss is the perfect game to put your mind at ease after a long day. Sit back, put your feet up and give your mind the refreshment it needs by forming word after word up and down the board.
How to Play:
As simple as it gets. Swipe the letters to find hidden words.
Game Features:
PLAY WHEREVER, WHENEVER - Why solve the words with your friends when you can do it all by yourself offline, without Wifi or the Internet!
FREE TO PLAY – Get this word link game for FREE and put your word game skills to the test
EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER – Starting with 2 letter words and going all the way to 7 letters, it gets your brain working hard
BOOST YOUR VOCABULARY – Go on a word finding spree and raise your vocabulary game
DAILY BONUS CALENDAR - Who doesn’t love a good mystery? Play and earn amazing rewards every day!
HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT - If you get stuck at any level, use Shuffle or Hints to help yourself out!
PLAY ACROSS DEVICES – Simply login using Facebook to sync your game progress and continue playing on any device
So, are you up for some awesome wordplay? Get it now!

bluejetty:00169530:ios.description:
Tap the tiles to the beat, hold the long notes and play your way through the piano music everyone knows.
Music Tiles 4 is a piano rhythm game: easy in a second, hard to master. Each song gets a little faster as you climb, so every run feels fresh.
HOW TO PLAY
• Tap each tile wherever it shows on screen, in order
• Press and hold long tiles until they are done
• Let a tile reach the bottom and the run ends: use a Revive to play on
• Clear the song for 3 stars, then go for the crowns
SONGS YOU KNOW, PLAYED NEW
• Beethoven: Für Elise, Moonlight Sonata, Ode to Joy
• Mozart: Turkish March, Eine kleine Nachtmusik
• Chopin, Bach, Debussy, Satie, Grieg, Tchaikovsky, Joplin and more
• EDM and pop remixes of the classics, made for this game
• Play your own music: import an MP3 and play it as tiles
POWER-UPS
• Revive: keep playing after a miss
• Slow-mo: the song plays 20% slower
• x2 Coins: double the coins of a run
• Autoplay: the game plays the first seconds for you
MAKE IT YOURS
• Unlock characters, tile skins and stages with coins
• Seasonal events: Halloween Night with spooky songs and pumpkin tiles
• Daily missions, stars and crowns to collect
VIP
• Ad-free play
• Play every song
• Import as many songs as you like
VIP is an auto-renewing subscription: weekly, monthly or yearly, with a free trial where offered. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation; it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings. We remind you a day before a free trial ends.
Headphones recommended. No account needed: open and play.

bluejetty:00136327:ios.description:
Re:END is a laid-back, top-down solo-mode RPG, that feels like those great MMOs from the good old days, RE:END features simple smartphone controls and an in-depth system with leveling, reincarnation, pets, equipment upgrades, an arena, ingredients, and more!
Experience an RPG with all the elements that made MMORPGs from the good old days (late 2000s) so great, right from your smartphone.
▼Leveling and Reincarnation
What would an MMO be without leveling! Nothing beats the feeling of overcoming adversity, discovering new and better ways to farm exp, and growing stronger with each level.
Assign stat points each time you level up, respec and reincarnate. Grow stronger, and build your character your way.
▼Collecting Ingredients and Upgrading Weapons
Collect ingredients to improve your equipment by defeating powerful monsters and fishing. Fight stronger monsters, face new challenges and prepare for the next power spike!
▼Pets
All enemies can join you, even bosses (some arena monsters are off limits)! There can be as little as a 0.3% chance that some enemies will join you when defeated. The odds may be slim, but that feeling of payoff when it happens is incredible!

bluejetty:00095242:ios.name: My Sticker Room - Decor Game
bluejetty:00095242:ios.summary:
THE ULTIMATE COZY STICKER GAME
Life can be stressful, so it’s important to make time for yourself to relax – and what better way to do that than with an adorable kawaii sticker game? A mixture of décor games and sticker books, come peel up
bluejetty:00095242:ios.description:
THE ULTIMATE COZY STICKER GAME
Life can be stressful, so it’s important to make time for yourself to relax – and what better way to do that than with an adorable kawaii sticker game? A mixture of décor games and sticker books, come peel up stickers and put them in their spots to finish each page, and feel your stress melt away. This is the ultimate chill home décor game with charming animal characters and room décor galore is the answer to all your worries!
STICK THE LANDING
Peel, stick, repeat – it really is that simple in this relaxing game filled with cute cats, diy home décor, and of course, stickers! Perfect for all ages and skill levels, this calm and easy sticker book game allows you to get your decorating groove on across all sorts of rooms and locations. The kawaii room décor and animations will help you relax, and the easy mechanics and calm gameplay mean you’ll be feeling cool as a cucumber even if you’ve only had time to play one level.
The best parts:
- Cute cats and more: Each level is essentially a sticker book page where you’ll need to place all the stickers in the right spots to help our little animal friends live their best lives, be it at the coffee shop or hanging with friends! Enjoy watching the room décor items fill out the space and bring it to life thanks to the home décor game aspect, but free yourself from the stress of having to choose it all yourself.
- Bye-bye stress: This relaxing sticker game is perfect for any amount of time – be it waiting before a meeting, just chilling at home, or in the elevator at work before a big presentation. Just open it and start sticking! Room décor items, kawaii animals, and more will fall into place thanks to your decorating skills, and before you know it you’ll be feeling ready to take on whatever is ahead!
- Chill gameplay: In our quest to make this a relaxing sticker game, we pulled out all the stops – the game mechanics are simple and straightforward, the graphics are cute and cozy, and the ambiance: adoring and amazing. Fun for both the young and young at heart, everyone will enjoy decorating various rooms with décor items and seeing the cute cats, bunnies, and more in their little spaces!
PEEL, STICK, REPEAT
Come try the most relaxing and kawaii sticker game in town: My Sticker Room! Here you’ll get to peel and stick diy home décor, cute animals, and more onto their spots and watch the pages come alive! This cute decorating game will leave you stress free thanks to the chill graphics and gameplay, and players of all ages will enjoy placing the stickers on each new page. Relax in style with My Sticker Room today!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00044954:ios.description:
What if travel insurance did more than wait for something to go wrong - what if it helped things go right?
Faye does just that, delivering person-first, proactive, industry-leading coverage and care that protects your entire trip. Get covered in as little as 60 seconds with a custom, comprehensive plan that covers your trip, your stuff, your health, and even your pet.
Named one of the best travel insurance companies by The Wall Street Journal, and a TIME Best Invention of 2025, the Faye travel insurance app goes the distance to redefine how you’re looked after when you’re on the road, providing:
The ability to insure your entire trip in as little as 60 seconds
Real-time trip flight alerts (on delays, cancellations and more) as well as complimentary lounge access on flight delays of 3 hours or more
Emergency medical help with quick access to a nearby ER or pharmacy, as well as the ability to book an appointment with a network of 20K telemedicine doctors in 21 languages when abroad
With Faye you can also:
Speak to customer experience specialists available 24/7 for proactive problem-solving and support when you need it most - anytime, anywhere, 365 days a year - even on weekends and holidays (yes, real humans!)
Easily file claims in minutes (just upload your documents to the app)
Receive quick reimbursements on approved claims and common travel snafus (even while you’re still in-trip) to your phone, done digitally thanks to Faye Wallet, a secure digital payments card given to every Faye user
Connect the moment you land abroad with eSIM – tap to activate travel data right from the app.
Store copies of your most precious travel docs securely with Safekeeping. Face ID protected, instantly accessible—even offline.
Use helpful widgets for local weather, currency conversions, local app recommendations and playlists to rock out to for every stage of your adventure
Built by avid travelers and insurance experts who believe that travel insurance can be more than a forgettable add-on but a must-have advantage, Faye helps keep you safe, informed and inspired to roam confidently.
We’re easy to get in touch with around the clock - chat with us in-app or email us at support@withfaye.com
What we cover
Pretty much everything and anything related to your travel well-being.
Your trip: If your trip gets delayed, interrupted or if you have to cancel, we'll be there to make it as stress-free as possible. You can even add on the ability to cancel for any reason.
Your health: We cover emergency medical expenses you have during your trip, including ones related to COVID-19. Even if it means flying you home.
Your stuff: Phone or laptop gets stolen? Bags are delayed or damaged? We’ll help ya' out. Even with that favorite t-shirt of yours.
We also provide valuable add-ons that may be relevant to your trip: Pet care, Rental car care, Vacation rental damage protection, Extreme sports and Cancel for any reason protection.

bluejetty:00089500:ios.name: The Mighty
bluejetty:00089500:ios.summary: We don’t just talk about health, we live it. From mental health to chronic illness, disability, rare disease, parenting, neurodiversity, caregiving, and so much more, you’ll find the resources you need and the peer support you want on The M
bluejetty:00089500:ios.description:
We don’t just talk about health, we live it. From mental health to chronic illness, disability, rare disease, parenting, neurodiversity, caregiving, and so much more, you’ll find the resources you need and the peer support you want on The Mighty, the world’s largest online health community. Health is hard, but it never has to be lonely.
- Read stories written by people with first-hand health experience, and discover resources curated specifically for the conditions you care about: ADHD, autism, bipolar disorder, suicide, chronic pain, anxiety, depression, and so much more
- Create a profile that allows you to keep track of your healthcare interests and community connections, and save the resources and posts that matter to you
- Start or end your day — or take a midday break! — with a fresh affirmation that changes based on what emotion you’re feeling
- Follow and search posts, stories, people, and topics to find the health content you want from 700+ health communities and support groups
- Join a Mighty group and connect with like-minded people around health, hobbies, and similar interests
- Make a post when you have something to share; or when you need advice, support, or encouragement from people who get it
- Scroll through your personalized home feed, based on the groups you're a part of and the people and topics you follow
- Ask and answer polls — the perfect, bite-sized way to engage on low-energy days, or during flares and depressive episodes
We're always looking for ways to improve The Mighty for our community. If you have any feedback about The Mighty app — good, bad or anything in between — please share it with us by emailing community@themighty.com.
We’re here for you, and we are #MightyTogether!
The Mighty Team

bluejetty:00027428:ios.description:
Predator Pro is a professional-grade predator hunting toolkit designed to specifically work with the Bullet HP electronic call. Coyote hunters, fox hunters, and really anyone hunting predators of any kind will see the effectiveness of predator hunting with the Predator Pro mobile app.
Predator Pro comes equipped with 50 sounds for FREE!
*New Predator Sound Pack available with more coyote, bobcat, and raccoon sounds in the latest version. 
Predator Pro by Convergent Hunting is designed to work in conjunction with the “Bullet HP” (special purpose Bluetooth controlled speaker/decoy) to help you get professional predator calling results. Together, the Convergent Hunting apps and Convergent Bullet HP, combine the latest in technology to provide you with a complete predator calling platform that is unique, versatile, all wrapped up in a high-performance package. 
All predator hunting sounds packaged in Convergent Hunting’s Mobile Predator Calling Apps have been recorded in High Definition and are digitally mastered to provide you with sounds that will elicit responses from even the most wary animals.
This app is designed to be easy-to-use and powerful with expansion options so that you can continue to grow your sound library with the latest and greatest sounds as they become available.
Large buttons for sound playback and decoy control make using the apps in the field very easy. 4 programmable preset call buttons allow you to keep your four favorite sounds “front and center” for quick use.
A decoy button lets you easily control the Bullet HP’s decoy motor to further entice game into close range.
Standard volume control and playback interface keep things simple and easy to use. Hunting hi-tech has never been so easy, or powerful!
Visit ConvergentHunting.com for more apps product information.

bluejetty:00062370:ios.description:
*** Medical Dictionary ***
It is for medical practitioners and students to look up the definitions and technical term in a second. Medical Terms and Dictionary with common and uncommon words, terms and phrases. Used by physicians, nurses, PAs, NPs, medical students, nursing students and more.
*** Drugs / Medicines Dictionary ***
Drug Dictionary is a medical drugs book that provides all information about drugs used for medication: usage, how to take, side effects, precautions, drug interactions, missed dose and storage.
*** Disease Dictionary ***
This app containing medical disorders & diseases with detailed definitions, symptoms, causes and treatment information. This medical disease hand book can act as a clinical advisor for self diagnosis and can also be used to look up symptoms, diseases and treatment.
Features:
——
1. 9879 Medical Dictionary Words (Word and Definition)
2. 1225 Drug Dictionary (Drug Name, About, Usage, How to use, Side effects, Precaution, interaction, Doss missed, Storage)
3. 2142 Disease Dictionary (Disease Name, Overview, Definition, Symptoms, Causes, Risk, Complications, Preparing, Tests, Treatment, Lifestyle, Alternative, Coping, Prevention)
4. Search and get information
5. Bookmark important word and get quick list
6. Share details to anyone
7. Speak option, To know word pronunciation
8. Previous / Next Button to learn words quickly
***Who can use this free disease dictionary ***
Healthcare professionals, pharmaceuticals, physicians, hospital nurses, medical students, nursing professionals, pharmacy, physician assistants and for students who work in clinical practice & dispensary.
*** DISCLAIMER ***
This application is not a substitute for consulting a pharmacist or a doctor. The content within the app is provided solely for pocket reference and educational purposes. It is essential to consult a doctor before relying on any information from this app. The developer does not assume responsibility for verifying the accuracy of the content added to the app. In medical terms, 'drug' refers to medicines.

bluejetty:00160937:android.description:
The internet loves the idea of being a "CHAD" (popular internet meme character), a symbol of confidence and self-improvement. We wanted to make this concept helpful by inspiring people to quit harmful habits like Pornography, M, Orgasm - PMO addiction. Our NO FAP app supports you on this journey by counting your no-fap days and awarding badges that help you stay motivated as you progress.
If you want to:
• Overcome addiction and regain control over your life
• Have an iron will to make yourself better
• Break the cycle of relapses and build a lasting streak
• Improve yourself across all aspects of life
• Do No Nut Challange all year!
Then NO FAP is the right app for you!
Key Features:
• Track Your Progress: Monitor your streaks with our easy-to-use counter
• Motivating Badges: Earn rewards at various milestones to keep pushing forward
• Community Support: Chat with others on the same path, share your achievements, and motivate each other in the no fap Community
• Detailed History: View your past streaks and relapses with insights to help you understand your journey better
• Personalised Stats: Check your progress and stay inspired to achieve your goals
• Goal Setting: Start from today or set a custom date for your no-fap journey
• Simple and Beautiful Interface: Navigate with ease, designed for both motivation and simplicity
How to Use It?
Start the timer, which will track your days without fapping. You can start counting from today or choose an earlier date. If you relapse, simply hit the Relapse button to reset your timer. Take a moment to write down why you relapsed to gain insight for the future. Check your badges and history by accessing the side drawer, where you can also chat with others by logging in and joining channels.
Why Choose NO FAP?
Unlike other apps, NO FAP combines self-improvement with a community focus, allowing you to work on life-changing goals in an encouraging environment. Set milestones, earn rewards, and build new habits for a healthier, balanced lifestyle.
To Support Us:
1. Rate our app in the app store
2. Share your feedback and suggestions
Thank you for choosing NO FAP to guide you on this path to self-improvement. Take pride in your journey and achieve the success you desire. We wish you the best on this path to becoming a CHAD!

* 2026, 2025 한경비즈니스 한국소비자만족지수 비대면진료 앱 2년 연속 1위

bluejetty:00038909:ios.description:

* 2026, 2025 한경비즈니스 한국소비자만족지수 비대면진료 앱 2년 연속 1위
* 2024 주간동아 한국고객만족도 비대면진료 앱 1위
■ 병원에서 전화가 온다, 닥터나우
- 감기, 소아과, 여성질환, 여드름, 탈모 등 병원이 필요한 모든 순간에 병원에서 전화가 와요.
- 늦은 밤, 주말, 연휴에도 병원 진료가 가능해요. 365일 24시간 내가 원할 때 언제, 어디서든 편하게 진료를 받아보세요.
- 이제 아플 때 참지 마세요. 이동 없이 진료받고, 내 근처 약국에서 약을 빠르게 받을 수 있어요.
■ 800만의 선택, 닥터나우
- 이미 수많은 사람들이 믿고 쓰고 있어요. 다운로드 수와 리뷰 수가 입증하는 대한민국 1위 서비스를 경험해보세요.
- 90만 개가 넘는 진료 후기와 전문의 여부를 확인해 내가 원하는 의사 선생님에게 진료를 신청할 수 있어요. 소아과부터 산부인과까지 안심하고 진료받아 보세요.
■ 비대면 진료 서비스
- 소아과 비대면 진료, 산부인과 비대면 진료, 비뇨기과 비대면 진료, 이비인후과 비대면 진료, 피부과 비대면 진료, 내과 비대면 진료, 정형외과 비대면 진료, 안과 비대면 진료, 신경과 비대면 진료, 치과 비대면 진료, 가정의학과 비대면 진료, 정신건강의학과 비대면 진료, 통증의학과 비대면 진료
- 소아청소년과약(소아과약) 처방, 산부인과약 처방, 정신과약 처방, 피부과약 처방, 내과약 처방, 이비인후과약 처방, 안과약 처방, 신경과약 처방, 가정의학과약 처방, 통증의학과약 처방, 정신건강의학과약(정신과약) 처방, 정형외과약 처방, 비뇨기과약 처방
■ 비대면 진료 가능한 질환/증상
1. 급여 질환 : 감기약 처방, 독감약 처방, 비염약 처방(항히스타민제, 나잘스프레이 등), 천식약 처방(천식 흡입기 처방), 질염약 처방(항생제, 질정, 질연고 등), 방광염약 처방, 입덧약 처방, 소아과약 처방, 불면증약/우울증약/불안증약/긴장완화약 처방(향정신성의약품 제외), 알러지/알레르기약 처방, 안구건조증 1회용 인공눈물 처방(히알루론산 인공눈물 등), 결막염약 처방(안약, 안연고 등), 다래끼약 처방, 고혈압약 처방, 고지혈증약 처방, 당뇨약 처방, 위장약 처방, 장염약 처방, 위염약 처방, 식도염약 처방, 소화불량약 처방, 변비약 처방, 발톱무좀약 처방, 헤르페스약 처방, 두드러기약 처방, 피부발진/습진약 처방, 아토피약 처방, 근육통약 처방, 통풍약 처방, 두통약 처방, 전립선약 처방, 생리통약 처방
2. 비급여 질환 : 먹는 탈모약 처방(피나스테리드 - 프로페시아, 피나온 등 / 두타스테리드 - 아보다트, 두타온 등), 바르는 탈모약 처방(미녹시딜 - 로게인폼, 미녹시폼, 마이녹실), 먹는 여드름약 처방(이소트레티노인 - 이소티논, 트레인 / 독시사이클린 - 미노씬, 모노신정), 바르는 여드름약 처방(클린다마이신 - 크레오신티, 아다팔렌 - 디페린겔, 트리파로텐 - 아크리프)
 - 365일 24시간 언제 어디서든 전화로 빠르게 닥터나우에서 진료 받을 수 있어요. 25만 개가 넘는 후기를 보고 나만의닥터를 찾아보세요. 좋은 선생님 굿닥부터 모두에게 필요한 모두닥 똑닥 병원에 비대면진료 예약까지 가능해요. 삐약 하며 얻는 정보 닥터나우에서 다 얻을 수 있어요. 내가 있는 곳 어디든 전국에 있는 병원에서 대기 없이 비대면진료 받아 보세요.
■ 진료비 최저가 비교
- 진료받기 전에 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등)의 최저가 진료비 병원을 찾아보세요.
- 모아둔 포인트로 진료비 할인도 받을 수 있으니 병원비를 절약해보세요. (*다이어트는 최저가로 병원 예약 기능도 편하게 이용할 수 있어요.)
■ 최저가 약국 지도
- 전국의 약국 가격과 약국 정보를 지도를 통해 한 눈에 확인할 수 있어요.
- 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 가격을 비교해보고 나에게 딱 맞는 최저가 약국에서 약을 받아보세요.
- 온누리상품권 가맹 약국을 필터로 한 번에 찾고, 추가 할인 받아 약값 부담도 줄여보세요.
■ 다이어트 병원 방문 예약
- 다어어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 진료와 처방이 가능한 병원을 방문하기 전에 미리 예약할 수 있어요.
- 다이어트 진료 최저가 병원과 최저가 약국을 확인하여 편하게 병원 예약해보세요.
■ 실시간 상담
- 감기, 장염, 탈모 초기 증상, 여드름과 같은 피부 고민, 다이어트, 여성 질환, 아이 감기, 수족구 등 건강에 관련된 궁금한 내용을 물어보면 AI가 실시간으로 빠르게 답변해 드려요.
■ 건강 정보 - 건강 매거진, 1분 FAQ, 의약품 사전, 질환백과
- 건강 매거진 : 소아과, 여성질환, 피부, 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트 등 다양한 건강 정보를 전문 에디터가 제공해드려요. 건강검진과 예방접종, 피부 시술까지 다양한 정보를 확인할 수 있어요.
- 1분 FAQ : 다이어트, BMI, 당뇨, 고혈압, 고지혈증, 혈압, 혈당 등 다양한 건강 정보를 빠르게 제공해요. 원하는 내용을 간편하게 확인해 보세요.
- 의약품 사전 : 많이 찾는 일반의약품과 전문의약품의 자세한 정보를 확인할 수 있어요. 처방받은 약의 효능/효과부터 부작용, 주의사항까지 꼼꼼하게 확인해 보세요.
- 질환백과 : 내과, 산부인과, 소아청소년과, 피부과, 비뇨기과, 이비인후과 비대면 진료, 정형외과, 안과, 신경과, 치과, 가정의학과, 정신건강의학과, 통증의학과 등 다양한 질환에 대한 정보를 제공해요. 원인부터 증상, 치료 등 원하는 정보를 빠르게 찾을 수 있어요.
● 앱 사용 중 문제가 있다면 망설이지 말고 연락해 주세요.
● 이메일 : [contact@doctornow.co.kr](mailto:contact@doctornow.co.kr)
(주)닥터나우
서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 625 덕명빌딩 16층
비대면진료는 보건의료기본법 제44조에 근거한 보건복지부 시범사업에 맞춰 운영되고 있습니다.
[선택적 접근 권한]
- 위치 : 현재 위치 자동 수신 및 근처 병원 찾기 서비스 제공 목적으로 사용됩니다.
- 카메라 : 진료 요청 시 사진 촬영 및 첨부를 위해 사용됩니다.
- 알림 : 마케팅 정보 푸시알림 전송을 위해 사용됩니다.
- 전화 : 병원/약국 전화번호를 통한 통화 기능 제공을 위해 사용됩니다.
- 신체활동 : 실시간 걸음 수를 측정하기 위해 사용됩니다.
- 근처기기 : 블루투스 기기 페어링 및 정확한 위치 검색 기능 제공을 위해 사용됩니다.
- 마이크 : 화상 전화를 통한 비대면 진료 서비스 제공을 위해 사용됩니다.
선택 권한을 동의하지 않으셔도 서비스 이용이 가능하며 선택 권한은 필요한 시점에 동의 받고 있습니다.

2. 비급여 질환 : 먹는 탈모약 처방(피나스테리드 - 프로페시아, 피나온 등 / 두타스테리드 - 아보다트, 두타온 등), 바르는 탈모약 처방(미녹시딜 - 로게인폼, 미녹시폼, 마이녹실), 먹는 여드름약 처방(이소트레티노인 - 이소티논, 트레인 / 독시사이클린 - 미노씬, 모노신정), 바르는 여드름약 처방(클린다마이신 - 크레오신티, 아다팔렌 - 디페린겔, 트리파로텐 - 아크리프)
    
    - 365일 24시간 언제 어디서든 전화로 빠르게 닥터나우에서 진료 받을 수 있어요. 25만 개가 넘는 후기를 보고 나만의닥터를 찾아보세요. 좋은 선생님 굿닥부터 모두에게 필요한 모두닥 똑닥 병원에 비대면진료 예약까지 가능해요. 삐약 하며 얻는 정보 닥터나우에서 다 얻을 수 있어요. 내가 있는 곳 어디든 전국에 있는 병원에서 대기 없이 비대면진료 받아 보세요.
    

■ 진료비 최저가 비교

- 진료받기 전에 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등)의 최저가 진료비 병원을 찾아보세요.
- 모아둔 포인트로 진료비 할인도 받을 수 있으니 병원비를 절약해보세요. (*다이어트는 최저가로 병원 예약 기능도 편하게 이용할 수 있어요.)

■ 최저가 약국 지도

- 전국의 약국 가격과 약국 정보를 지도를 통해 한 눈에 확인할 수 있어요.
- 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 가격을 비교해보고 나에게 딱 맞는 최저가 약국에서 약을 받아보세요.
- 온누리상품권 가맹 약국을 필터로 한 번에 찾고, 추가 할인 받아 약값 부담도 줄여보세요.

■ 다이어트 병원 방문 예약

- 다어어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 진료와 처방이 가능한 병원을 방문하기 전에 미리 예약할 수 있어요.
- 다이어트 진료 최저가 병원과 최저가 약국을 확인하여 편하게 병원 예약해보세요.

■ 실시간 상담

- 감기, 장염, 탈모 초기 증상, 여드름과 같은 피부 고민, 다이어트, 여성 질환, 아이 감기, 수족구 등 건강에 관련된 궁금한 내용을 물어보면 AI가 실시간으로 빠르게 답변해 드려요.

■ 건강 정보 - 건강 매거진, 1분 FAQ, 의약품 사전, 질환백과

- 건강 매거진 : 소아과, 여성질환, 피부, 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트 등 다양한 건강 정보를 전문 에디터가 제공해드려요. 건강검진과 예방접종, 피부 시술까지 다양한 정보를 확인할 수 있어요.

bluejetty:00138970:ios.summary:
Jenny LeClue is a thrilling story of mystery, adventure and growing up. Set in the sleepy town of Arthurton, the game is filled with memorable, complex characters and rendered in a unique aesthetic.
Embrace the choosiness and shape the met
bluejetty:00138970:ios.description:
Jenny LeClue is a thrilling story of mystery, adventure and growing up. Set in the sleepy town of Arthurton, the game is filled with memorable, complex characters and rendered in a unique aesthetic.
Embrace the choosiness and shape the metanarrative. You are not the only guiding hand shaping Jenny’s destiny, but your choices will help her unravel the tangled mystery and become the detective she was born to be. 
Jenny gets more than she bargains for when her mother is accused of murder, and begins an unexpected journey to find the truth.
She soon discovers the idyllic town of Arthurton is not what it seems, and unseen forces will stop at nothing to keep Jenny from the truth. She will need all her skills of deduction to find the real killer and clear her mother’s name.
A pocket-sized heroine on a big quest for justice:
Jenny is a brilliant young detective, sharp eyed, intuitive and a ruthless pursuer of the truth. She is able to look around during dialogue scenes, observing the subject for visible clues that might reveal their guilt or innocence that would otherwise go undetected.
A beautiful handmade world, packed with secrets:
A sleek, gorgeous hand drawn world with vintage mid-20th century aesthetics and mystery squished into every corner. There's so much to interact with, and players who poke and prod at every last thing are rewarded with insight, secrets, and humor.
A story within a story, where your choosiness matters:
Jenny LeClue weaves a rich metanarrative around a rich story exploring themes of family, loss, and identity. The "author" of Jenny's adventures, Arthur K Finklestein, acts as narrator and guide, but his presence also allows you to make choices that change the way Jenny's story is written. These choices may even affect Finklestein's own story.
A Fully Voiced Cast Of Characters & Locations:
Explore Arthurton's expansive world including the abandoned mines, the forgotten graveyard, Lake Noware, and Gumboldt's Library. Jenny will meet an array of intriguing and suspicious characters who could help or hinder her on her quest for the truth.

bluejetty:00017793:ios.description:
Rated 5 stars and loved by thousands of users!
Unlike traditional complicated budgeting apps, Daily Budget Original focuses on being simple, easy and actually fun to use.
-- SAFE & PRIVATE –-
The app does not connect to bank accounts, so there is no need to enter your online banking log in data.
Also, we do not sell user data. The data stays on your device only. If you want to sync your data, you can encrypt it before uploading it to the cloud.
-- KEY FEATURES ARE FREE, FOREVER --
Many users are happy and saving a lot of money with the free version, without any additional paid features. 
Free features: Daily Budget calculation, planning & saving for big spending, basic categories for expenses, backup.
Paid features: More and customizable categories, data encryption, PIN protection, Multi users via Dropbox, Remove ads, CSV file export, analysis graphs.
-- USER REVIEWS –-
Beyond spectacular! - This app is so fantastic- as with many other reviewers, I've tried other budgeting apps like Mint. But this is the only app that actually works. It incentives me to spend less money on some days, have extra to spend on the weekends. Thank you for not adding too many bells and whistles!
Life Changing - I am the WORST with finances and I've tried other apps, including Mint, which I used for a week and quit. But this app?? It's amazing. I can't speak highly enough of how much this app is getting my life together. I'm aggressively saving, paying off all of my bills and I know exactly what I get to spend a day. I will never NOT use this. I hope it's here forever.
Helps you be Accountable - This app turns my financial life into a game that I feel I can win. Daily Budget really works and it's core design sets it apart from other apps.
-- IN MEDIA –-
“Take the blah out of budgeting” – Seventeen Magazine
 “An utterly fantastic approach to saving” – Apppicker
“Super-quick, easy way to show how well we're doing” - Appadvice
-- HOW IT WORKS --
1. Enter your regular income, like salary or monthly allowance.
2. Enter your recurring expenses, like rent or gym.
3. Enter your savings goal, like 10%.
4. Watch your Daily Budget gets calculated and know how much you can spend every day!
*Daily Budget is calculated simply as (Income – Expenses – Saving)/Number of days in a month. 
Watch your budget grow as you stay below your daily budget. Now, saving money is suddenly a fun game!

bluejetty:00044575:ios.summary:
Nutiliti is the utility app for residents whose property manager uses Nutiliti. If your property manager has invited you, sign in with the email address they have on file to see and pay your home's utility bills in one place.
No more chasi
bluejetty:00044575:ios.description:
Nutiliti is the utility app for residents whose property manager uses Nutiliti. If your property manager has invited you, sign in with the email address they have on file to see and pay your home's utility bills in one place.
No more chasing bills across provider portals or splitting them by hand. Your property manager sets up your home's utilities with Nutiliti, we collect every bill, and you see exactly what you owe and why.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See your bills
Upcoming and paid bills for electricity, gas, water, trash and internet, each with its amount, due date and billing period.
• Know your share
Each bill shows how it was split between you and your roommates, so everyone pays only their part.
• Pay in a few taps
Pay by card or bank account from a secure, full-screen payment page. Payments are processed by Stripe.
• Stay on top of it
Get a notification when a bill is ready or a roommate joins, and turn push notifications on or off anytime.
• Manage your account
Update your phone number and contact details, see who shares your home, and delete your account from Profile whenever you choose.
NEED ACCESS?
Nutiliti accounts are created by invitation from your property manager. If you think your home uses Nutiliti but you haven't received an invite, contact your property manager or email support@nutiliti.com.
Privacy Policy: https://www.nutiliti.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.nutiliti.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00160142:ios.description:
Improve your sexual performance with the Forti Kegel: Men’s Health app, which provides daily 7 minutes routines for strengthening pelvic muscles. Tailored by experts, these exercises help alleviate common sexual health issues and enhance pelvic floor strength. Our app is based on the proven principles of Dr. Arnold Kegel, focusing on crucial muscle groups for sexual and urinary functionality.
- Personalized Plans -
Start your health transformation with a customized plan that adapts to your individual goals and fitness levels, ensuring every workout is tailored and effective.
- Diverse Workout Options -
Forti Kegel: Men’s Health provides a wide range of workouts, from intensive core strength sessions to quick daily routines, keeping your training engaging and effective.
- Extra Workouts for Peak Performance -
Push your limits with our advanced extra load exercises designed to boost endurance and accelerate progress, giving you tangible results.
- One Day Challenge -
Test your strength with our "One Day Challenge" and gauge your progress in a single day, motivating you to continue improving.
- Regular PF Tests -
Monitor your fitness journey with regular tests that provide insights into your progress, helping to refine your workouts and keep you on track.
- Comprehensive Testing -
Stay informed with regular tests that measure your progress in areas like stress levels, libido, and overall physical health. These assessments help fine-tune your workouts and ensure that you are always moving towards your health goals.
- Training Reminder -
Receive timely reminders to ensure you stay on track with your exercise regimen.
Download now and start your journey to a healthier, stronger you!
