bluejetty:00100766:ios.name: Nextory: Audiobooks & E-books
bluejetty:00100766:ios.summary: Step into the wonderful world of books with Nextory. Now you can listen to audiobooks and read eBooks without any limit. It’s very simple to stream books in the app directly on your iPhone or iPad. Nextory is always available. At any time -
bluejetty:00100766:ios.description:
Step into the wonderful world of books with Nextory. Now you can listen to audiobooks and read eBooks without any limit. It’s very simple to stream books in the app directly on your iPhone or iPad. Nextory is always available. At any time - online and offline - as long and as often as you want.
Sign up today and enjoy 14 days or even more of free unlimited reading and listening with Nextory. You will get access to over 1.4 million books right away. No matter what kind of books you are looking for - bestsellers, crime novels, thrillers, non-fiction, or feelgood. You will always find the stories that you like in our huge library.
Your advantages with Nextory:
Read eBooks comfortably and anywhere - at home or on the road.
Listen to audiobooks anytime you want: on vacation, while commuting, to relax and in between.
Read and listen online or offline by downloading audiobooks and eBooks directly to your iPhone or iPad.
Huge library of excellent audiobooks and eBooks with over 1 million titles in total from the genres such as non-fiction, novels, thrillers, children's books, fantasy, and many other categories.
Discover new audiobooks and eBooks that you like. Based on your reading history, we create individual reading and listening tips tailored to your needs.
With our eBook reader it is possible to...
... place an automatic bookmark. You can mark a place in a book and easily go back or start in the exact same place where you paused before.
… adjust the font size, screen brightness and background color individually to your liking or depending on your reading environment.
… turn pages or jump back and forth between chapters and books in a trouble-free and easy way.
… get an even better reading experience with the double-page view in iPad, which delivers a feeling close to a physical book.
… save your favorite locations using markers and bookmarks.
With our audiobook player it is possible to:
...increase or decrease the reading speed in different steps to individually choose your desired speed.
… simply use our navigation bar to fast-forward or rewind if you want to go back to a specific place in the book you would like to listen to.
… set a sleep timer that will automatically stop the player after a specific amount of time.
… use the bookmark function to mark out a good part of the book or to continue to listen exactly where you last stopped or paused.
... keep track of how much of you have left of the book you are listening to.
… continue to listen even in energy-saving mode and enjoy your favorite audiobooks anytime you want.
Sign up today and enjoy the benefits with Nextory! 
With Nextory you can enjoy unlimited reading and listening anytime, anywhere. You will always have your favorite audiobooks and eBooks with you no matter where you are - in your smartphone or iPad. You can easily access them online or download books in advance to read and listen offline. Even audiobooks for the little ones. 
Read and listen for free for 14 days and up - start your trial today!
Benefit from the eBook reader developed specifically for Nextory, which will take your reading experience to a whole new level. Even reading PDF files run flawlessly. It has numerous settings so that you can customize your reading experience to suit your every need.
In-App Subscription Unlimited - price- and payment terms:
A subscription gives you access to our growing library, consisting of tens of thousands of books at a fixed monthly cost.
The amount will be charged automatically each month via your iTunes account. The subscription is automatically renewed each month,
as long sd the feature "automatic renewal" is not deactivated via the iTunes settings on your device, no later than 24 hours before your subscription period runs out. You can read more about our terms and conditions on our website.
Our terms and conditions can be found here: https://www.nextory.se/medlemsvillkor

bluejetty:00023493:ios.description:
Create pixel art, animated sprites and game assets on iPhone and iPad. Draw with layers, animate frame by frame, and export your work as images, GIFs or sprite sheets.
Start with a small character or build a detailed scene. Pixel Studio PRO brings drawing, animation and color tools together, with Apple Pencil support and a customizable workspace. Get PRO features with a one-time purchase, including an ad-free workspace, Google Drive sync and advanced creative tools.
DRAW PIXEL ART
• Work with layers, built-in and custom brushes, shapes and gradients
• Draw symmetrically and add shading with the Dithering Pen
• Use Dot Pen for precise drawing with a cursor
• Customize your grid, background and toolbar
• Resize and rotate your canvas, with pixel art scaling and rotation tools
• Create seamless textures with Tile Mode
ANIMATE YOUR SPRITES
• Create frame-by-frame animations with Onion Skin
• Export animations as GIFs or sprite sheets
• Add music and export videos to MP4 without limits
WORK WITH COLOR
• Create your own palettes with up to 256 colors or use built-in palettes and palettes from Lospec
• Pick colors with RGBA and HSV controls
• Extract palettes from images and apply palettes to your artwork
• Adjust hue, saturation and lightness without limits
SAVE AND SHARE
• Use autosave and backups to help protect your projects
• Sync your work between supported devices and platforms with Google Drive
• Work with PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TGA and Pixel Studio Project files
• Import Aseprite files
• Share your artwork with the Pixel Network community
PRO FEATURES INCLUDED
• No ads
• Google Drive sync across supported platforms
• Dark theme
• 256-color palettes
• Tile Mode for seamless textures
• Extended maximum project size
• Unlimited color adjustments and MP4 exports
• Additional format support
• Extended Pixel Network storage
Sample images by lorddkno, Redshrike, Calciumtrice, Buch and Tomoe Mami are used under CC BY 3.0.
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/hippogamesunity/PixelStudioHub/wiki/Privacy-Policy
Terms of Use: https://github.com/hippogamesunity/PixelStudioHub/wiki/EULA

bluejetty:00154206:ios.summary: Get ready to play Rumble Rush, the fast and action-packed multiplayer runner game full of fun! Every match is an exciting run where you stumble, jump, and dash through obstacle courses. With unique power-ups, playful modes, and nonstop mult
bluejetty:00154206:ios.description:
Get ready to play Rumble Rush, the fast and action-packed multiplayer runner game full of fun! Every match is an exciting run where you stumble, jump, and dash through obstacle courses. With unique power-ups, playful modes, and nonstop multiplayer runs, Rumble Rush delivers the ultimate endless runner game experience on mobile and browser.
RUN, JUMP, DASH, AND STUMBLE TO WIN
Play with friends and other players in multiplayer runs where every step counts. Each course in Rumble Rush is built with fun obstacles, surprising turns, and exciting gameplay. It’s one of the most engaging runner games for fans and action games.
POWER-UPS THAT BRING FUN TO EVERY RUN
Collect coins and gems to unlock power-ups inspired by classic arcade racers - speed boosts, quick recoveries, and more. Upgrade them to run faster, recover from a stumble, or make a quick comeback. Power-ups keep every runner game fresh, playful, and full of multiplayer action.
FUN MODES FOR EVERY PLAYER
Play tournaments, challenge runs, and event modes. The legendary Block Survival map is a favorite - one stumble can change everything. Earn trophies, climb ranks, and enjoy friendly competition in Rumble Rush multiplayer game.
LEADERBOARDS AND TIME RECORDS
It’s not only about reaching the finish line - it’s about running faster than ever. Beat maps, chase world records, and climb the leaderboards. Rumble Rush is perfect for players who love runner games, fun games, and multiplayer action.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER
Unlock colorful skins, animations, and rare effects. Collect them all and make your character unique as you stumble, dash, and jump through every run in this free endless runner game.
FEATURES
 - Multiplayer runner gameplay with nonstop action and fun
 - Unlock and upgrade power-ups to brighten every run
 - Play tournaments, challenges, and event modes
 - Legendary Block Survival map for experienced players
 - Leaderboards and time record competitions
 - Collect skins, animations, and legendary effects
 - Easy-to-learn controls, fun to master gameplay
 - Play Rumble Rush on mobile or browser
Join the stumble, master the run, and see why Rumble Rush is the ultimate rumble game for fans of multiplayer action games!
Play Rumble Rush FREE today and join players worldwide in this casual action game!

bluejetty:00121959:ios.name: RPG Master Sounds Mixer
bluejetty:00121959:ios.summary: Get ready to take your role-playing games to an unprecedented dimension of sound! RPG Master Sounds was already the essential tool for bringing your stories to life, and now we've created the ultimate level of customization and immersion.
bluejetty:00121959:ios.description:
Get ready to take your role-playing games to an unprecedented dimension of sound! RPG Master Sounds was already the essential tool for bringing your stories to life, and now we've created the ultimate level of customization and immersion.
Immerse yourself in a world of unlimited creativity and unparalleled excitement. With RPG Master Sounds Mixer, you have the power to create unforgettable moments, effortlessly mixing hundreds of sound effects, music tracks, and immersive soundscapes.
* Key Features: Your Adventure, Your Sound
The only limit is your imagination:
1. Total Control with Custom Audios
Now you can expand your library and completely customize your listening experience by adding your own audio files.
- Add your favorites: Upload your own sound effects, music, or ambient tracks directly from your device.
- Seamless Integration: Once imported, your files behave exactly like the official sounds, ready to be used in your custom Sequences, Environments, and Sets.
- Easy Management: Organize and find your audio files easily by assigning them a unique title and keywords.
Compatibility: Compatible with WAV, MP3, and OGG formats (OGG being the most recommended).
2. Peace of Mind with Backup & Restore
Never lose your creations again. This feature allows you to save a backup copy of all your customizations on our server to restore them when you need them, ideal if you change devices or reinstall the app.
- Customizations: The backup covers your custom Sequences, Environments, and Sets. It also saves any custom titles and keywords you have defined, your custom audio file data (sound type, title, and keywords), and information about your purchased audio packs.
- Security and Portability: The backup is linked to a unique, anonymous User ID that you must save in order to restore your data.
* Continue Creating Immersive Audio Experiences
Continue to enjoy the powerful features that have made RPG Master Sounds the ultimate mixer for your sessions:
- Mix and Match: Create captivating audio sequences and immersive environments with effortless mixing.
Custom Sets: Design custom sets of sounds, music, and environments for specific scenarios, ensuring quick access and total control of the atmosphere.
- Dynamic Sequences: Chain sounds together in Sequences to create complete sounds that will help you add impact to key moments in the scene.
Amazing Soundtracks: Thanks to Sequences, you can create the perfect soundtrack for each scene, achieving hours of playback and smooth, natural transitions between different audio tracks.
- Immersive Environments: Play multiple audio tracks simultaneously in your custom environments, layering sounds, music, and ambience to create a symphony of sensations.
- Intuitive Organization: Bookmark your favorite tracks for quick access, customize track keywords to create categories, and use our filtering and search system to find the perfect sound at the right moment.
RPG Master Sounds is an extraordinary addition to your games and adventures, breathing life into your stories like never before.
Download RPG Master Sounds now and make your next adventure legendary!

bluejetty:00141282:ios.description:
Are you a fan of match-three & matching games? Tile Garden: Match 3 Puzzle will fulfil your need for matching fun with new puzzle challenges every day! Simply match three tiles to reveal more tiles underneath and continue matching until you clear everything, but beware, If you select too many tiles without at least matching three you will have to begin your journey over again.

With 50+ styles of tiles, there’s no limit to the number of matches you can make. Match Flowers, Leaves, Animals
2. Beautiful Scenery
Take in the scene as you match in beautiful and relaxing landscapes. From Gardens to Mountains and more.
3. Relaxing in your Tile Garden

Test and improve your memory, and your pattern recognition skills with this fun and relaxing puzzle game!

bluejetty:00174831:ios.name: 2112TD: Tower Defense Survival
bluejetty:00174831:ios.summary:
"This is solid, old-school tower defence design where every map makes you stop and think about the best strategy." – Touch Arcade (App of the Week)
"2112TD takes the classic Westwood RTS art style and blends it with tower defence — and it
bluejetty:00174831:ios.description:
"This is solid, old-school tower defence design where every map makes you stop and think about the best strategy." – Touch Arcade (App of the Week)
"2112TD takes the classic Westwood RTS art style and blends it with tower defence — and it works brilliantly." – Pocket Gamer (Game of the Week)
Set 100 years in the future, battle inter-dimensional flesh spawn across the solar system and defend Earth's colonies from complete annihilation. 
The pace is steady, but the stakes are high as the relentless hordes amass in an effort to overrun your mobile command center. 
Unlike traditional TD games, you will be relying heavily on micro-managing dynamic action-based abilities. As you progress deeper into the campaign airstrikes, charged attacks, fortification walls and the tactical drone will become increasingly vital and deploying them strategically will be paramount. 
Mistakes won’t go unpunished so stay frosty, learn from your blunders and endure to fight another day. Without pain there can be no gain!
**FEATURES**
BEAUTIFULLY ILLUSTRATED ENVIRONMENTS AND GRAPHICS
2112TD’s artistic style is founded on the nostalgia of the RTS golden era, paying homage to games like Command and Conquer and StarCraft.
A CAMPAIGN TO TEST YOUR SKILLS
The battlefield is an unforgiving landscape and every second counts. Beginners will find forgiveness on normal mode while veterans will be drawn to the challenge of hard. When you’re ready it’s time to put your skills to the test in nightmare and survival. How long can you hold back the hordes?
BURN, BLAST AND OBLITERATE
Deploy the machine gun, flame thrower, artillery and plasma turrets to destroy your foes. Upgrade your towers to their experimental stages packing serious firepower and charged attacks.
DEATH FROM ABOVE
When the situation gets too hairy you’ll be relying on air support. The airstrike and tactical drone deliver the big BOOM as well as defensive abilities. 
RESEARCH TO VICTORY
Earth’s egg heads are working tirelessly to gain the upper hand against the new enemy. Unlock new abilities and weapons as you progress.
DISCOVER AND DOMINATE 
They call it the soldier’s dictionary. The tactical database gathers data on the battlefield about your arsenal and enemies alike. Be sure to check it often as it will be critical to your triumph against the hordes.
ACHIEVEMENTS & COMBAT STATISTICS
Commanders that excel on the battlefield will unlock achievements as a reward for their contributions in the struggle against the invaders.
What are you waiting for commander? The flesh spawn must be eradicated!
---
2112TD contains no in-game advertisements or micro-transactions.
Got feedback? Leave a review or get in touch: https://refinerygames.com/contact

bluejetty:00146908:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Arabian Night. 
Solve the mystery and use items to escape from the world of Arabian Night!
After escaping, restart the game and look for all the magic lamps! 
Can you find them all? 
【Features】
・Adorable characters enjoyable for children of young ages.
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】
programmer：Asahi Hirata
Designer：Naruma Saito
Produced by two of us.
Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.
If you like this game, please play other games!

Music is VFR：http://musicisvfr.com
Pocket Sound : http://pocket-se.info/
icons8：https://icons8.com/

bluejetty:00061056:ios.name: Darwinbox
bluejetty:00061056:ios.summary: Darwinbox brings your complete employee lifecycle to your fingertips, transforming how you manage work, connect with colleagues, and grow your career. From daily tasks to long-term goals, manage your entire work life in one intuitive, secur
bluejetty:00061056:ios.description:
Darwinbox brings your complete employee lifecycle to your fingertips, transforming how you manage work, connect with colleagues, and grow your career. From daily tasks to long-term goals, manage your entire work life in one intuitive, secure app.
Why Employees Love Darwinbox:
• Instant Payslips: View and download your payslips and tax forms anytime, anywhere.
• Travel & Expenses: Easily raise travel requests and claim expense reimbursements in just a few clicks.
• Seamless Leave Management: Check balances, apply for leave, and view holiday calendars with ease.
• Grow Your Career: Track your goals, manage performance reviews, and access learning modules on the go.
• Engage & Celebrate: Connect with peers, share updates, and recognize achievements on an internal social feed.
• Stay Connected: Find colleagues in the directory, view the org chart, and reach out to team members instantly.
• Voice Your Feedback: Participate in surveys and polls to share your views and make your workplace better.
• AI Super Agent: Your personal workplace assistant. Handle tasks across HR, IT, and Finance, from raising tickets to finding answers - just by asking.
For Managers & HR Admins: Empower Your Team, On the Go.
• Darwinbox Sense: Work smarter with AI. Leverage GenAI to get instant answers, actionable insights, and predictive analytics just by asking.
• Approve & Act: View and approve leave requests, attendance, and requisitions in real-time - Convenience at your fingertips.
• Team Management: A complete toolkit to track progress, manage shifts, create rosters, and provide instant feedback.
• Recruitment & Onboarding: Streamline hiring by managing candidates and tracking the recruitment and onboarding processes directly from mobile.
• Real-Time Alerts: Never miss a beat. Get instant push notifications for approvals, shift changes, and critical updates to keep operations running smoothly.
Simple, Secure, and Always Up to Date:
Darwinbox combines robust functionality with a sleek, user-friendly interface. Your data is protected with enterprise-grade security, and continuous updates ensure you always have the best experience.
Important Note: Your organization must authorize access to the Darwinbox mobile app to use this app. Access to specific features depends on what your organization has enabled.

bluejetty:00041396:ios.description:
When the Only Job of a Mileage Tracker is to Track EVERY mile, Then GOFAR Provides 100% Accuracy the Easy Way.
Trusted by happy drivers across 72 countries.
 • Say goodbye to manually tracking trips
 • Tag business trips in one swipe
 • Easily export IRS ready reports (PDF/Excel)
 • Increase your mileage tax claims by tracking every mile
 • 60 day free returns policy
→ GOFAR MAKES TRACKING BUSINESS TRIPS EASY
GOFAR is not your ordinary mileage tracker. Your subscription plan comes with a smart plug-n-play device that understands your car at a deeper level.
→ THAT’S WHY GOFAR IS BETTER
Our plug-n-play device pairs with your phone for greater reliability to automatically capture EVERY MI you do to ensure you will claim the maximum at tax time.
→ WHO IS GOFAR FOR?
• Business owners
• Sales people
• Delivery driver, van removalist or courier
• Tradies & construction workers
• Creatives (photographers, designers, architects etc)
• Real estate agents
• Health care professionals
• Aged care quality assessors
• IT network & security consultants
• Lawyers
→ SAVE MORE WITH GOFAR
Because GOFAR tracks every mile here is what you can claim back automatically (Based on IRS 2026 mileage rates):
5,000mi = $3,625
6,000mi = $4,350
10,000mi = $7,250
15,000mi = $10,875
25,000mi = $18,125
→ WHAT YOU GET WITH YOUR UNLIMITED PLAN
1. World Class Mileage Tracking Combo
Take it easy all year round with GOFAR’s App + Plug’n’Play device as they work together to claim every cent you deserve from the taxman.
2. Precision Car Health Tracker
Detect car issues before they become a problem. GOFAR monitors your engine for 7000+ issues, notifying you the second a problem is detected and explaining what it means and what you can do about it in plain english. GOFAR keeps your car on the road and out of the workshop potentially saving you thousands.
3. Fuel Performance Tracker
Capture your fuel receipts, track your fuel spend and even learn how to cut fuel costs. Pair GOFAR with our award winning eco device, the Ray, for real time eco driving guidance to save big on fuel..
→ YES, IT DOES WORKS WITH ALL MODERN CARS & TRUCKS (Except EV’s)
GOFAR plugs into your OBD2 diagnostics port under your steering wheel.
It’s simple and takes just seconds. Used in 20,000+ vehicles worldwide.
Our app gives you an easy step guide on how to get setup. No tools required.
→ NO PHONE? NO WORRIES.
Unlike all other App-only alternatives, GOFAR captures EVERY trip accurately. Our device “talks to your car’s computer” to capture and store ALL trip data then shares it with your phone. This means if you forget your phone, your battery is dead or you just forget to open the app, you never miss a trip. Your app will fully update when it next pairs with the device. Your trip data is then stored securely on your device and in the cloud. Double the protection! 
→ FULL FEATURES ON GOFAR UNLIMITED PLAN:
• Track every mile with 100% accuracy
• Automatic mileage tracking
• See your trips on the map
• Classify trips with a swipe
• IRA mileage report
• Unlimited miles
• Company car allowance and expense reports
• Track fuel costs + capture receipts (iOS)
• Your data securely backed up to the cloud
• Automatic trip categorisation
Warranty & Support
• Lifetime replacement warranty
• Same day customer support
Save $1000s on Repairs
• Fault error IQ - Continuously monitors your car for faults
• Explains your ‘Check Engine Light’ in plain English!
• Alerts you of 7,000+ potential problems
• Severity warnings, know if it’s safe to keep driving
• Lets you clear your own 'Check Engine Light'
• Reminders for servicing, insurance, registration and more
Helpful and Insightful
• Track your fuel economy, trip log costs & CO2 emissions
• Note drivers scores and leaderboard, compete with others for fun
• View your driving trends and charts
• Never forget where you parked, GOFAR remembers
• Automatic parking timer
• Multi car support - see all your cars in the app

bluejetty:00048540:android.description:
Download now and try to survive!
Survive inside a house with a scary killer! HeadHorse is your captor and you have a single mission, escape. He is a very intelligent killer with an unmatchable desire for blood is following every single one of your moves, every step, every glimpse of hope you have of escaping, every instant getting closer to his objective, you!
Horror will occupy your body as you try to escape him on this survival horror game! Explore a dark and scary house full of unsolved mysteries as you try your best to survive, beware! traps are around awaiting for HeadHorse's prey to step on them.
You'll never forget this adventure, it's horror and puzzles.
Spend Five nights at Headhorse's house! Keep in mind, solving his puzzles is no easy task, but if you do, survival can almost be assured! Use objects strategically to attract HeadHorse, but avoid making too much noise, otherwise be prepared to run for your life. A horror game like no other, having amazing puzzles and challenges for you to test your survival skills!
It'll be a challenge like no other, the horror HeadHorse is preparing is something never seen before, This game is not for those who are scared easily, I guarantee you! There is no horror game like this.
☆Includes a practice mode in case you don't the courage to face HeadHorse's killing intent! Explore the house while he has left to search for new victims.
☆Unlock two harder and deadlier difficulties as you finish the game, can you face HeadHorse's maximum strength and horror?
☆The Gameplay is full of puzzles and challenges, the perfect adventure for those who like one!
☆Our horror game is being constantly updated, help its development by sending us new ideas of puzzles and ways to test your survival skills.
Are you ready for HeadHorse: Horror Game and its puzzles?
Horror has just begun...

Upcoming Matches & Results:
Never miss a game again! Match Score provides a comprehensive schedule of all upcoming matches, allowing you to plan your viewing in advance. Additionally, you can easily check the results of past matches, keeping you up to date with the latest developments in the football world.
Favorites:
Track your favorite teams and matches with ease. Match Score's Favorites feature lets you select the teams and matches that matter most to you. Receive real-time notifications when these matches are about to start, ensuring you never miss a moment of the action.
Predictions:
Enhance your game-day experience with expert insights and predictions. Match Score offers detailed analysis and predictions for today's matches, helping you stay informed and engaged. Whether you're a casual fan or a seasoned follower, these predictions add an extra layer of excitement to your football experience.
Stay effortlessly connected to the football world with Match Score. Download the app today and make it your go-to source for all football updates and information.

bluejetty:00159153:ios.name: Family Gift
bluejetty:00159153:ios.summary:
Christmas is coming, so is Uncle Bob's birthday, and you still have no idea what to get? With Family Gift, everyone writes down what they want, the whole family can see it, and no more three toasters unwrapped on the same night!
-- Your li
bluejetty:00159153:ios.description:
Christmas is coming, so is Uncle Bob's birthday, and you still have no idea what to get? With Family Gift, everyone writes down what they want, the whole family can see it, and no more three toasters unwrapped on the same night!
-- Your list, and the whole family's --
Fill in your gift wish list, create a group or join your loved ones' group, and you instantly see the lists of all its members. Family, friends, coworkers… create as many groups as you need!
-- No more duplicate gifts --
Mark the gift you plan to give and the other group members are notified. Then track it from reserved to purchased, wrapped and finally given. And of course, the lucky recipient sees nothing!
-- A big gift? Chip in together --
Join in on a gift with other group members, and find everything you're planning to give in "My Participations".
-- Your kids' lists, managed by you --
Kids too young to have a phone? Add them from your profile and fill in their list as easily as your own. They then follow you into every group you join.
-- Secret ideas for your loved ones --
Grandma dreams of the latest trendy game console but doesn't dare put it on her list? Add the idea to her list yourself. She'll never know!
-- An app that keeps you in the loop --
Your little sister wanted a pony, you were planning to get it for her, and now she's changed her mind? Family Gift lets you know so you can bounce back.
Always a bit behind and doing everything at the last minute? Get a notification as soon as a loved one adds an idea to their list.
-- Add a gift in a snap --
Paste a product link and the app fetches the name, picture and price for you, on most online stores. You can also share a page from your browser to Family Gift to add it straight to your list, or to a loved one's.
-- Secret Santa: the hassle-free draw --
A huge family, a group of friends or coworkers? Run a draw in your group: everyone gives a gift to one single person, and the app keeps the secret right to the end!
With Family Gift, making your loved ones happy has never been easier. No more gift-giving block, only gifts that hit the mark!

Join the Thrilling World of Raidfield 2: Play, Earn, and Conquer!
Step into the heart of WW2 action with Raidfield 2, where strategy meets intense combat. Immerse yourself in the role of a valiant soldier and team up with friends for an unparalleled third-person shooter experience. With Raidfield 2, not only do you get the adrenaline-pumping thrill of battle, but you also have the unique opportunity to earn real money while you play.
Exciting Features of Raidfield 2:
Play to Earn: win battles and earn gems to exchange for real money.
Team Play: Join forces with friends for cooperative missions and strategies.
Upgrades: Upgrade your weapons, tanks and airplanes to become unstoppable.
Diverse Vehicles: Master control of tanks, planes, and turret vehicles for strategic advantage.
Character Customization: Tailor your soldier with an array of options for a unique battlefield presence.

Diffrent Gameplays: Play in deffrent gameplay modes and enjoy amazing experience of third person shooter.
Stylized Battlegrounds: Engage in combat across polygon-styled WW2 landscapes.
Progression and Rewards: Develop your soldiers, tanks, and planes, and ascend the ranks from Private to General.
Immersive WW2 Experience: Authentic atmosphere that transports you straight into the heart of World War II.

Exchange these Gems for Unipoly Coin, our exclusive cryptocurrency, to enjoy real-world rewards. Your skills on the battlefield translate into valuable digital assets, making every victory more rewarding.
Achievements and Levels:
Earn more than 16 diffrent medals.
Unlock 42 unique achievements.
Rise through all the military ranks.
Upgrade 10 levels of Weapons, Tanks and Planes.
Gain extra points and rewards for completing achievements.
Your troops are eagerly awaiting your command. Download Raidfield 2 now and embark on an epic journey of combat, strategy, and earnings!

bluejetty:00082068:ios.description:

Create original music from your ideas, then turn it into an AI-generated music video.

bluejetty:00070157:ios.description:
With our app, you will find more than 1000+ minecraft texture packs absolutely compatible with minecraft 1.26 minecraft 1.21 Tiny Takeover (Support Minecraft Patched / BETA / Preview) We will give all Minecraft PE fans out there a little fairy dust without paying any fee!
Because the Master Minecraft Pocket Edition had updates (from 1.20+) that inserted Render Dragon - it is the new rendering engine that does not support shader among other things.
So we were really sorry to say that it affected all shaders for minecraft or addons players added to their MCPE world. Many shaders now support the latest update through Render Dragon or deferred rendering in the Minecraft Preview, but check the creator's community for compatibility.
• Odysius Deferred Shader: Provides vibrant, bright lighting and realistic water with sun reflections and an impressive underwater view.
• Complementary Re-Imagined: Praised for exceptional quality, detail, and performance, this is a highly-regarded option for users with capable devices.
• Harmony Voxil: A high-end shader with many features, though it may require a powerful device (doesn't work on iOS). 
• BSL Shaders - Complementary Shaders - RTX Realistic (Ray tracing) - Derivative shader: These shaders include realtime shadows, fresh animation, volumetric light, ambient occlusion, bloom, customizable clouds and water. (Sadly it only works for Java Edition)
TOP 10 Shaders for minecraft 1.21 suggestions that you could try:
- Solar Shader for lower-end devices
- NRRDS Shaders
- YSSBE Shader
- NewB X Legacy
- R-Drag Shader
- Bumbli Graphics
- Universal Pack
- Omega Fancy Shader
- Bicubic Shader (BSBE)
- SEUS PE Shader
- TTW Shader
Features:
- Over 1000+ shaders and texture packs: Choose from a wide variety of shaders and texture packs to create the perfect seasonal atmosphere.
- Easy to use: Simply download the shader or texture pack you want and our app will automatically import it into your game.
- Compatible with all devices: You can enjoy the realistic shaders and texture packs on your iPhone or iPad.
- Texture Maker: Custom your own blocks and import into Minecraft! You also can importing it into Crafting and Building, Eerskraft, Craftsman or some other games which allows third-party tools to edit behavior or resource packs.
*This tool requires the official MCPE game.
NAME, LENGTH AND PRICES OF OUR PUBLICATIONS/SERVICES:
- Premium Monthly - first 3 days for free, then you will be charged for $3.99/Month.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription via: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Privacy policy: https://www.pamobile.co/privacy-policy.html
- Term of use: https://www.pamobile.co/terms-conditions.html

bluejetty:00044519:ios.description:
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said. Eligible users can also pay using pre-tax transit dollars through approved commuter benefit debit cards. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at support-stl@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00148211:ios.description:
Blink 3.0 — now with non-custodial accounts. Hold your own keys with the same simple experience Blink is known for.
Blink is the Bitcoin wallet trusted across the Bitcoin ecosystem for ease of use, accessibility, and exceptional payment reliability. With version 3.0, you can now create a non-custodial account — your Bitcoin, secured by your own recovery phrase, with no one else able to touch your funds. Not even us.
Non-Custodial / Self-Custody:
- Your keys, your Bitcoin. Secured by a 12-word recovery phrase that only you hold.
- Built on the Spark protocol with a unilateral exit path to the Bitcoin main chain.
- Portable — access your funds in any Spark-compatible wallet with your recovery phrase.
- iCloud backup so self-custody fits your life.
- Non-custodial Dollar Balance — hold USD-equivalent value alongside your Bitcoin, all under your control.
The Same Blink Experience:
- Instant Bitcoin payments over Lightning or on-chain, powered by highly reliable infrastructure.
- Keep your existing username@blink.sv Lightning address — nothing changes for the people paying you.
- Low fees, with zero fees for Blink-to-Blink transfers.
- Receive Bitcoin via QR codes, NFC, LNURL, Lightning addresses, and vouchers (Azteco, Lightsats).
- Available in 20+ languages worldwide.
Choose What Works for You:
- Create a non-custodial account for full self-custody, or keep using your existing custodial account — it's your choice.
- Switch between accounts seamlessly within the app.
- Migration path from custodial to non-custodial coming soon.
For Merchants & Developers:
- Web-based Point of Sale system to accept Bitcoin payments.
- Blink Dashboard & API for integrations with BTCPay Server, LNBits, Alby, WooCommerce, and more.
- Local Bitcoin merchant map to discover businesses accepting Lightning payments nearby.
Built for Trust:
- Open source (FOSS). Verify the code yourself.
- Battle-tested Lightning infrastructure with exceptionally high payment success rates.
- Built-in Bitcoin education tools for new users.
Download Blink and take full control of your Bitcoin — with the simplest wallet experience in the ecosystem.

• Transfer funds between your accounts or to another member’s account.

bluejetty:00075527:ios.description:
《新笑傲江湖》手游是由完美世界研发的新生代国风武侠MMORPG，以金庸经典武侠IP《笑傲江湖》为蓝本，融合传统文化底蕴与现代艺术表达，打造了一个兼具诗意与策略的沉浸式江湖世界。游戏以“清韵国风”为核心理念，通过独创的手绘次世代美术风格、高自由度玩法设计及动态叙事体验，被称为“可游历的武侠画卷”。
《新笑傲江湖》手游以“清韵国风”破局传统武侠赛道，通过艺术表达与玩法创新的双重突破，重新定义了移动端武侠沉浸体验。正如玩家所言：“这里不止有刀光剑影，更是鲜活人间。”
-----------------------------------------------
“江湖夜雨十年灯，一剑霜寒十四州。”
仲夏之时，《新笑傲江湖》手游携江湖新篇章浩荡而来！此间既有刀光剑影淬炼武学极境，亦有奇谋诡术颠覆战局乾坤，更将宿命对决推至寰宇之巅——此非寻常江湖，乃侠者证道之地。
【年度冠军赛·破界之战】
“此剑出鞘日，群雄噤声时。”
破界之战，热血重燃！少侠们所熟知的年度终极赛事再度升级！124级以上侠士皆可参战，从海选突围至双败淘汰制巅峰战，胜者独揽现金大奖及限定外观！本年度更是对规则做出重大革新，打破壁垒：在“线上独立服赛”数据拷贝阶段，将少侠们角色数据完整迁移至独立赛事服务器后，同组内所有战队在比赛前可自由调整战队成员，让策略与默契成为制胜关键，让每一支队伍都能以“完全体”迎战！
【面谱化形·诡道奇谋】
“移魂化相，借势伐谋。”

bluejetty:00157917:ios.description:
Who is actually paying attention to you?
InStalker turns the engagement signals around your account into a clear
picture of who keeps showing up. Every like, comment, story reaction and
repeat interaction gets scored, ranked and tracked over time, so the
people circling your profile stop being a guess.
RECENTLY ON YOUR PROFILE
The accounts with the freshest activity around you, ordered by how
strong and how recent their engagement is. Refresh and watch the list
change. This feature does not identify profile viewers.
YOUR TOP FANS
A ranked list of who interacts with your content most. Watch the order
shift week by week, and share your number one fan straight to your
story.
UNFOLLOWER ALERTS
Know the moment someone leaves. Full history of who unfollowed you and
when, plus everyone who never followed back in the first place.
BLOCK DETECTION
A profile disappeared. Find out whether they deactivated, deleted, or
blocked you.
GHOST FOLLOWERS
Find the accounts padding your follower count without ever liking or
commenting. Clear them out and watch your engagement rate climb.
STORY INSIGHTS
See who watches your stories, who reacts, who replies, and who never
misses one.
STORY VIEWER
Search any public username and watch their latest stories from inside
InStalker.
INSTA BOOST
Post ideas for when the feed goes quiet, hooks that stop the scroll,
captions written in seconds, and a full size profile picture viewer.
HOW IT WORKS
InStalker analyzes public engagement data from your own account.
Instagram does not hand out a list of who opened your profile, to us or
to anyone else. What we can measure is attention: who engages, how
often, how recently, and how that pattern shifts. In practice that is
the answer most people are looking for.
SUBSCRIPTION
Full access requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple
Account once you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews
automatically unless renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the
current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account
settings.
––
Disclaimer: This app is not sponsored, endorsed, or administered by, or associated with, Instagram. Instagram is a trademark of Instagram, LLC.
Terms of Use: https://www.unfollower.app/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.unfollower.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00062363:ios.name: Keto Kit - Keto Diet Tracker
bluejetty:00062363:ios.summary: Welcome to Keto Kit, formerly Lazy Keto. Everything you loved about Lazy Keto, rebuilt. After six years and more than a million downloads, we kept the trusted keto diet tracker at the core and added the smartest tools we have ever shipped.
bluejetty:00062363:ios.description:
Welcome to Keto Kit, formerly Lazy Keto. Everything you loved about Lazy Keto, rebuilt. After six years and more than a million downloads, we kept the trusted keto diet tracker at the core and added the smartest tools we have ever shipped.
Keto Kit makes the ketogenic diet feel easy. Track net carbs and macros in real time, scan packaged foods against a 500,000+ item food database, log a meal by voice, snap a photo of your plate, and watch your weight, ketones, and progress come together in one place. Whether you follow strict keto, lazy keto, dirty keto, low carb high fat, or carnivore, your numbers stay clear and your goals stay close.
WHAT YOU CAN DO IN KETO KIT
- Track keto macros and net carbs in real time
- Use the built in carb counter and macro calculator
- Scan barcodes against a 500,000+ food database
- Snap a photo of any meal and let AI estimate the macros
- Log foods hands free with voice
- Browse 1,000+ keto recipes with verified macros and prep times
- Cook hands free with step by step Cooking Mode
- Plan a week of keto meals with the drag and drop meal planner
- Generate a smart shopping list from any meal plan
- Find keto friendly menu items at 50,000+ restaurant locations
- Time intermittent fasts through five live metabolic stages
- Run 30, 60, and 90 day keto challenges with the community
- Log weight, body fat, and progress photos for clear weight loss
- Sync with Apple Health and earn streaks, quests, and XP
- Chat with the AI keto coach for personal answers and meal ideas
THE DAILY KETO SCORE
Every morning Keto Kit grades your day with a single 0 to 100 number. The Keto Score combines net carbs, macro ratios, hydration, and consistency, so you always know where you stand without doing the math.
SCAN, SNAP, OR SAY IT
Tracking should not slow you down. Scan a barcode in seconds. Take a photo and let AI sort the macros for you. Or speak the meal out loud. Three ways to log a meal, all built for real life.
1,000+ KETO RECIPES, UPDATED WEEKLY
Filter by net carbs, prep time, calorie counts, or cuisine. Every recipe ships with verified net carbs, protein, fat, and calories, plus a one tap shopping list and hands free Cooking Mode.
INTERMITTENT FASTING, BUILT IN
Set a 16:8, 20:4, OMAD, or custom window and watch the timer roll through Fed, Transition, Fat Burn, Ketosis, and Autophagy. No second app, no extra subscription. See how many other Keto Kit members are fasting alongside you right now.
LEARN AS YOU GO
The Keto Compass walks you through your first seven days. The Keto Academy adds 30+ illustrated lessons covering ketosis, electrolytes, hidden carbs, label reading, fat adaptation, and plateaus.
KETO KIT PREMIUM
Premium unlocks AI meal scan, voice logging, the AI keto coach, the full meal planner, smart shopping lists, batch barcode scanning, deep analytics, an ad free experience, and the full premium recipe library.
FREE TO START
The core keto tracker, fasting timer, food search, barcode scanner, and macro calculator are free forever. No credit card to begin.
About auto renewing subscriptions
Keto Kit Premium is offered as a monthly or yearly auto renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews within 24 hours before the end of the current period unless auto renew is turned off in your account settings. Renewal is charged at the same price as the original subscription. Manage or turn off auto renew any time in your Apple ID account settings.
Privacy Policy at https://www.ketokit.app/privacy
Terms of Use at https://www.ketokit.app/terms
Questions or feedback at support@ketokit.app

bluejetty:00025734:android.description:
Looking for a game that's both challenging and relaxing? Look no further than "Clothes Sort Puzzle" - the ultimate brain-teasing challenge that doubles as a stress-relieving escape.
In this game, your objective is to sort clothes by color. It's a simple gameplay mechanic, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty ramps up, and you'll need to rely on your brainly abilities to remember which colors belong together.
With beautiful graphics, soothing sound effects, and ASMR elements, "Clothes Sort Puzzle" is a game that will keep you engaged and relaxed for hours on end. And if you're looking for a way to unwind after a stressful day, this game is the perfect way to do it.
Research shows that puzzle games like "Clothes Sort Puzzle" can help reduce stress and improve your overall mood, making it an ideal addition to your daily routine. So why not take a break from the daily grind and give this game a try?
Whether you're a fan of other sorting games like Puzzledom and Filler, or simply looking for a fun way to unwind, "Clothes Sort Puzzle" is the game for you. Download it today and see how far you can go. And don't forget to stay hydrated with plenty of water - your brain and body will thank you!

Whether you’re going on a ski trip or just enjoying the snowfall, there are so many gorgeous winter outfits to choose from. Let’s go shopping and enjoy this festive season at an ultra-modern mountain ski resort. It’s gonna be the best Christmas ever!
The winter season is the perfect time for fashionistas to make a statement with their new winter wardrobe! Whether you’re going on a ski trip or just enjoying the snowfall, there are so many gorgeous winter outfits to choose from. Let’s go shopping and enjoy this festive season at an ultra-modern mountain ski resort. It’s gonna be the best christmas ever!
It’s winter! Time to shake your wardrobe for warm clothes. Sevelina knows the proper way to get dressed for this cold time. Here you have two friends in various locations during the winter. First they got to the ski resort, the marvelous place for two ladies to spend the time with pleasure. The dress up should be appropriate and here is what was prepared for you: fur hats, fur coats, hats-ears, warm leggings and jeans, skis and snowboards, gloves and mittens, winter boots and hi-tech coats, ski goggles and many more. But before you put all this on, you should select your hair style and underwear.
Another lady simply loves winter. She was waiting for snow all year and her time has come.
She should complete a proper make up before starting her proper dress up. Try some lashes, a gorgeous hairstyle and all cosmetics selected by Sevelina are at your service. Change her eyes color with varieties of contact lenses which perfectly suit her lipstick. More of red will look perfect as a contrast to snow, cause it is winter time, time to play dressup game.

Play this winter dress up game even offline, no internet connection needed. Save your screenshots directly to your gallery and share it with the friends so they can play winter dress up games.

> Impressive winter clothes.
> Stylish fur items.
> Dress up during cold weather.
> Varieties of accessories for winter time;
> Boot with fur.
> Ability to change eye color.
> Sevelina's dress up with hair style selections.

bluejetty:00065977:ios.name: Energy: Anti-Stress Loops
bluejetty:00065977:ios.summary:
A calming and anxiety-relieving puzzle game. An addictive journey and a great time killer. Solve the puzzles and pass the lines of energy.
Playing this amazing game with energy can increase your mental focus and relax you at the same tim
bluejetty:00065977:ios.description:
A calming and anxiety-relieving puzzle game. An addictive journey and a great time killer. Solve the puzzles and pass the lines of energy.
Playing this amazing game with energy can increase your mental focus and relax you at the same time.
Features:
- Simple gameplay: Just tap the lines to rotate and create connected loops. The wires will shine when at least one bolt and a lamp are connected through a line. 
- Relaxing: People with OCD issues mention this game as a great way to get better. Energy gameplay is very calm – “just tap the line” – and a couple of levels per day are enough to fight OCD and anxiety issues. It’s like practicing yoga with your smartphone.
- Smart brain-teasers: Energy features endless minimalist brain-teasers that will boost your logic skills, relax your soul and improve your concentration. It will make you bright!
- Classic game: Highly compared with other logic games due to its simplicity, Energy is very satisfying and will illuminate the creative side of your brain. 
- Play everywhere: You will take less than 20 seconds to illuminate a circuit. That’s perfect to play on the bus or while you wait for your flight at the airport. Start playing and relax wherever you are!
- Recharge your battery: If your body battery is very low, Energy is the way to recharge it. Wherever you are at the airport, on the train, or on the bus, boost your concentration and make your brain shine with the brain-teasers reminiscent of Infinity Loop.
Better than a yoga session, Energy will relax your soul!
Play the king of logic games now!
If your body battery is fading, Energy is the perfect boost to recharge it! Featuring a minimalist style, a transmission circuit, and smart brain-teasers, this bright game will help you to calm your anxiety and get your concentration in line!
Energy is reminiscent of the classic Loop by its simplicity and satisfaction provided. You just need to tap the wire to rotate it and manage to connect all the lines. Make sure the transmission includes at least a lamp circle, a wire, and a lightning bolt circle to illuminate the light circuit. The wire loops will shine when everything is connected! 
Part of the famous Infinity Loop franchise, this calm, minimalist, and smart game will help you dealing with anxiety and OCD. Instead of closing endless loops, you must tap to connect every wire to the lamp and create a closed light transmission. Once you tap the first line, you will boost your concentration and reduce any symptoms of anxiety or OCD. Try to illuminate the circuit as many times as you can and recharge your soul with positive ideas. 
In calm brain-teasers like this, you don’t need to be super smart or fast as a lightning bolt to succeed. Creating a functional light circle using every wire, bolt, and lamp is more important than delivering a bright performance. ENERGY environment is satisfying and minimalist, featuring a calm soundtrack and endless light loops. The positive energy provided by this game will recharge your smartphone battery or make your brain shine like a star.
If you are looking for a minimalist tap game to boost your concentration, ENERGY is the right choice. Like other easy-to-learn logic games, this smart game features endless brain-teasers and its structure works as a circle: since you can’t finish it, your progress is like an endless circle. 
Working as a concentration boost and a great way of fighting anxiety and OCD issues, Energy is also a fun way of improving creativity while you relax your soul. By connecting every wire, lamp, and bolt, you will illuminate the transmission and create bright light shapes.
We associate ENERGY with yoga because this game is an excellent way to purify your mind and soul When you complete a dozen levels, your heart rate slows down. Just like in a yoga exercise.
Terms of Use: https://infinitygames.io/tos/

bluejetty:00077140:ios.name: Morse Chat: Chat in Morse Code
bluejetty:00077140:ios.summary:
Features:
- Communicate with fellow Morse enthusiasts from far and near simply by tapping dots and dashes.
- Meet new friends in a number of public rooms (10 WPM or less, 15 WPM, 20 WPM or more, Test room and so on).
- Share and exchange id
bluejetty:00077140:ios.description:
Features:
- Communicate with fellow Morse enthusiasts from far and near simply by tapping dots and dashes.
- Meet new friends in a number of public rooms (10 WPM or less, 15 WPM, 20 WPM or more, Test room and so on).
- Share and exchange ideas with your Inner Circle by creating private rooms.
- In private rooms, the owner can modify room details (room ID & name) and remove members.
- Text your friends privately with direct messages.
- 7 types of Morse keys to choose from (e.g. iambic).
- NEW! “Playground” to test and train your Morse code sending skills.
- Support for external keyboard.
- Easily subscribe and unsubscribe to notifications by clicking the bell icon at the upper right corner.
- Learn and practice Morse code in real conversations (click on the question mark icon in any chat screen to see Morse representations and the most common Morse abbreviations).
- Auto-translate between Morse code, Morse representation and text while receiving or sending messages. You decide what to show and in which order in Settings.
- Option to show live translation while typing the Morse code.
- Try the app out as a guest or sign in with your Apple ID, Google account or Facebook account.
- Completely adjust the app according to your preferences:
 1. Choose the frequency and output mode of the Morse messages (audio, blinking light, flashlight, vibration or audio + blinking light).
 2. Adjust the transmission speed when using auto-translate.
 3. Change the theme (Cyan, Bright, Dark, Black).
 4. Enable/disable auto-send, auto-translation and more.
- Absolutely no ads.
- Easily block annoying users.
- Blog posts and the info screen provide detailed instructions on how to use the app.
Morse Code
Morse code is a communication system that uses a series of short signals (also known as dots or dits) and long signals (also known as dashes or dahs) to transmit characters. The initial version of it was developed by Samuel F. B. Morse as a method to transmit natural language through the telegraph in the mid-19th century.
Morse Chat
Morse Chat is an app that allows users to communicate with others using Morse code. Once you sign in, you’ll see 3 big buttons which correspond to 3 main ways of chatting.
- Public Rooms. A number of rooms (10 WPM or less, 15 WPM, 20 WPM or more, Test room and so on) has been created to allow chatting with fellow Morse code enthusiasts. These rooms are open to everyone. Contact us if you have an idea for a new public room.
- Private Rooms. These can be created by premium users, and joined by any user (premium or not) who gets the room ID and password (case sensitive) or is invited by an existing room member.
- Direct Messages (DMs). These are private messages between two participants. Simply create a DM by searching the other user’s display name or call sign.
Download Morse Chat now and say “Hello” to the world in Morse code!
Privacy Policy: https://www.dong.digital/morsechat/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.dong.digital/morsechat/tos/

  1. Choose the frequency and output mode of the Morse messages (audio, blinking light, flashlight, vibration or audio + blinking light).
  2. Adjust the transmission speed when using auto-translate.
  3. Change the theme (Cyan, Bright, Dark, Black).
  4. Enable/disable auto-send, auto-translation and more.
- Absolutely no ads.
- Easily block annoying users.
- Blog posts and the info screen provide detailed instructions on how to use the app.

Morse Code
Morse code is a communication system that uses a series of short signals (also known as dots or dits) and long signals (also known as dashes or dahs) to transmit characters. The initial version of it was developed by Samuel F. B. Morse as a method to transmit natural language through the telegraph in the mid-19th century.

Morse Chat
Morse Chat is an app that allows users to communicate with others using Morse code. Once you sign in, you’ll see 3 big buttons which correspond to 3 main ways of chatting.
- Public Rooms. A number of rooms (10 WPM or less, 15 WPM, 20 WPM or more, Test room and so on) has been created to allow chatting with fellow Morse code enthusiasts. These rooms are open to everyone. Contact us if you have an idea for a new public room.
- Private Rooms. These can be created by premium users, and joined by any user (premium or not) who gets the room ID and password (case sensitive) or is invited by an existing room member.
- Direct Messages (DMs). These are private messages between two participants. Simply create a DM by searching the other user’s display name or call sign.

bluejetty:00024698:ios.description: LA Wallet will allow you to keep a digital representation of your current Louisiana-issued state ID or driver's license. The app will generate a unique image that is 100% Legal for driving purposes per Louisiana law of Act 625 of the 2016 session and approved by the Louisiana ATC for age-restricted purchases at various local restaurants, bars, and retail outlets. Once a user activates their current, valid license in LA Wallet, the digital driver’s license is valid for the life of the user’s current identity credential issuance. bluejetty:00121760:ios.description:
The seventh Evolution game comes with eight arms! Are you ready for the greatest breakthrough in the Evolution game series? Neglected for centuries, feared by many and portrayed as monsters, these creatures are here to prove, once and for all, just how funny and clumsy they really are. 
Give them a chance and they will happily take you with open arms. In fact, with four pairs of them. Combine octopuses to evolve them and discover their most curious, exotic and bizarre forms!
The Evolution series by Tapps Games continues! Had enough from Cow, Platypus, Goat, Giraffe, Zebra and Chicken Evolution? Octopus Evolution is here with the first-ever submarine mutant adventure. Ready for a splash?
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar octopuses to combine them and create new mysterious creatures
• Use octopus poop coins to buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap the octopuses to make coins pop from pooping
HIGHLIGHTS
• Many stages and octopus species to discover
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution, 2048 and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Many possible endings: find your own destiny
• Upgrades, upgrades, upgrades…! More than ever!
• No octopuses were harmed in the making of this game, only developers (again and again)
Discover what the future has in store for octopuses besides becoming delicious seafood dishes. Yummy. Download Octopus Evolution and have fun!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00152659:ios.description:

Key Capabilities:
► Advanced Text Generation: Write emails, essays, and creative stories with ease.
► Intelligent Coding Support: Get help with debugging, snippet generation, and learning new programming languages.
► Multilingual Conversations: Communicate naturally and fluently across dozens of languages.
► AI-Powered Visuals: Create unique artwork, posters, and design concepts from simple text prompts.

Why Choose ChatPrime?
Our platform is built for productivity and creative exploration. From brainstorming business ideas to planning your day, ChatPrime adapts to your needs, providing reliable and safe responses. Experience the power of multiple cutting-edge AI models in one place, optimized for your mobile workflow.
Visual Creation and Media Exploration
Move beyond basic text prompts and explore visual creativity directly within your workflow. With integrated image generation and media description tools, you can transform simple ideas into high-resolution illustrations, concept art, interior design layouts, and video storyboard prompts. Whether you need social media assets, graphic concepts, or custom digital art, the assistant translates your descriptive text into striking visual outputs in seconds. Refine styles, adjust composition, and explore fresh aesthetic variations seamlessly.
Elevate Professional and Academic Work
Transform how you handle writing, research, and technical tasks. ChatPrime acts as your dedicated co-pilot for drafting polished business proposals, structured reports, blog articles, and clear email campaigns. When tackling complex studies, use the assistant to summarize dense documents, explain advanced topics step by step, or generate practice questions. For developers, the coding companion assists with debugging errors, explaining algorithms, and generating clean code snippets across multiple programming languages.
Everyday Organization and Practical Guidance
ChatPrime adapts to your personal routine with practical assistance. Plan balanced weekly meal schedules, discover recipes from ingredients in your kitchen, build workout routines, and map out detailed travel itineraries with local recommendations. From organizing daily checklists and brainstorming party themes to managing personal goals, the conversational interface delivers thoughtful, context-aware answers to keep your day structured and productive.
Experience the convenience of intelligent chat, dynamic image generation, and versatile day-to-day assistance in a single app. Start exploring with ChatPrime today and discover a smarter way to communicate, work, and create.

bluejetty:00125958:ios.name: SP Camera
bluejetty:00125958:ios.summary:
Want to secretly capture photos and videos without anyone notices, here is the app that you need: SP Camera.
With SP Camera, you can record video, or take pictures without being seen while the device shows one of fake backgrounds.
Simulate
bluejetty:00125958:ios.description:
Want to secretly capture photos and videos without anyone notices, here is the app that you need: SP Camera.
With SP Camera, you can record video, or take pictures without being seen while the device shows one of fake backgrounds.
Simulate that you are browsing the web, a blog or leave the device on a table showing a still image or a time clock while recording.
Automatically record and save video if any motion occurs on the scene with Motion Detector Sensor.
With built-in Photo Timer, this app automatically captures photos every few seconds without touching the capture button again.
Save your photos and videos in the password protected private folder.
Moreover, you can hide all the UI control buttons to simulate a real spy experience.
MODE
* Photo: automatically capture photo without tap any buttons with Photo Timer up to 48MP
* Video: record video and capture still photo at the same time (snap 8MP photo while recording 4K video)
* Motion Detector: automatically record only if any motion occurs on the scene
* Slow Motion: support high frame rate or slow motion video recording on both front and rear camera
* Timelapse: record video in fast motion action up to 32x
* Horizontal: always record video in landscape even the device is held in portrait orientation
* Double Cameras: simultaneously record video with two different camera lens
CAMERA
• Manual camera control with focus, exposure, ISO, and white balance adjustment
• Ability for photo capturing & video recording at the same time for all video modes
• Save more storage with changeable video recording resolution between QVGA 240p, VGA 480p, HD 720p, FullHD 1080p or 4K 2160p
• Ability to zoom in & zoom out up to 10x
• Support dual and triple rear camera lens devices
• Automatically boost low light photo & video visibility and quality
• Limitable video recording duration and numbers of Photo Timer photos
• Cinematic video stabilization support for shake-free video recording
• Tap on camera view area to focus and adjust exposure
• Adjustable auto or manual focus and exposure
• Ability to record silent video (without sound)
• Support volume buttons actions for photo capturing and video recording
• Save photo and video in passcode protected private app folder or save to camera roll
• Ability to add date and time stamp when capturing photo or recording motion detector video
• Choose different styles of Double Cameras mode recording including Picture-in-Picture, Split View, and Dual Files
INTERFACE
• Automatic Mode: auto perform record action and other actions when app launch
• Easy Mode: easily tap any area to take photo and double tap to start/stop video recording
• Screen is completely black simulate the device is turned off
• No camera flash or on-screen flash is appeared
• Fake other people that you're on other activities by using fake backgrounds
• Alternative image slideshow or animated clock or reactive web browsing fake backgrounds
• Ability to your own image fake backgrounds
• Dimmed screen with zero brightness in black background
• Adjustable the visibilty of the UI transparency
• Movable and resizable camera preview
• Clarify the actions correctly with Text, Voice, and Haptic Feedback
PASSCODE
• No one can stop your recording by secure the recording and lock UI buttons with passcode
• Advanced passcode system can lock app startup, lock camera UI buttons, or lock gallery viewing
• Hide App Folder private photos and videos with failed passcode input
GALLERY
• Built-in gallery for viewing photos and videos and easy sharing
• Recover deleted photos and videos within 7 days with Trash Folder
REMOTE
• Wireless Apple Watch Remote supported for recording control
NOTES:
• Built-in Gallery Viewer unable to play slow-mo video in slow motion action.
• Double Cameras mode required iPhone or iPad with A12 or A12X chipset or later.
• 48MP photos capturing required iPhone 14 Pro series or iPhone 15 series or later.
• 4K 120fps recording required iPhone 16 Pro series or later.

bluejetty:00014572:ios.description:
Photo Retouch is a photo and video editing tool for removing visual distractions, refining portraits, and creating polished edits.
Key features:
• Object Removal: Brush over distracting objects or background passersby and apply the edit.
• Photo and Video Retouching: Make local corrections, blur selected areas, and track moving subjects in videos.
• Portrait Tools: Adjust facial proportions, eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, texture, and the appearance of fine lines.
• Makeup, Hairstyle, Hair Color and Virtual Try-On: Preview different makeup styles, hairstyles, hair colors, nail designs, and predefined virtual try-on options.
• Background Editing: Automatically separate subjects and replace or blur backgrounds.
• Photo Editing Tools: Crop, blur, adjust light and color, apply filters and effects, add text, create collages, and use other creative editing tools.
• AI-Assisted Tools: Expand images, restore older photos, add color, preview hairstyles.
• AI Photo Enhancement: Improve photo clarity, details, lighting, and overall quality.
• Future Baby: Create simulated baby appearances from selected photos using AI-assisted generation for entertainment and creative purposes.
• Photo Repair: Improve the perceived clarity and color of older or blurry photos.
• Live Photo & Beauty Camera: Apply supported edits to Live Photos and use built-in beauty camera features.
• Video Retouching: Apply supported retouching, blur, tracking, and editing tools to videos.
• Cloud Backup: Save edited results through the app’s cloud storage feature.
Portrait adjustments are creative visual effects and are not medical treatments. Results may vary depending on the source image.

- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package (weekly, monthly or yearly package)
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period

聯名特區：春麗、隆、孫小美、吉宗將軍，陪你一起爆大獎！

每日登入送遊戲幣，定時獎勵拿不停。
豐富的任務系統，挑戰成就領取高額遊戲幣。

bluejetty:00036520:ios.description:
The enjoyable hidden object games that have become a favorite among many is now available online! Dive into Magic Find: Hidden Object Game and embark on an exciting adventure where every level is a new challenge. Whether you love hidden object games, puzzle games, or brain games, this game offers a perfect blend of fun, challenge, and relaxation.
In this thrilling hide and seek experience, your mission is simple: find all the hidden objects scattered across beautifully crafted scenes. But don’t be fooled by the simplicity—each level gets progressively more challenging, making it a true test of your observational skills. Are you ready to prove your hunting prowess?
Key Features
• Free to Play: Enjoy one of the most relaxing hidden object games for free, with no hidden costs.

bluejetty:00169274:ios.summary: Embark on a heartwarming journey in Capybara Simulator, a charming game that invites you into the enchanting world of virtual pets. This captivating simulation offers a unique perspective on the pet care genre, allowing players to adopt and
bluejetty:00169274:ios.description:
Embark on a heartwarming journey in Capybara Simulator, a charming game that invites you into the enchanting world of virtual pets. This captivating simulation offers a unique perspective on the pet care genre, allowing players to adopt and care for capybaras, the world's largest and most adorable rodents, transforming their virtual homes into sanctuaries for these gentle creatures.
In Capybara Simulator, players are tasked with rescuing capybaras from the hustle and bustle of the streets and bringing them to the warmth and safety of their own virtual space. Once these adorable furry friends become part of your household, the real adventure begins. As a capybara caretaker, your daily tasks include feeding them, ensuring they have fresh water, bathing them to keep them clean, and giving them the love and attention they deserve. Every action is designed to strengthen the bond between you and your virtual pets, making every moment of the game a truly rewarding experience.
Capybara Simulator's interactive elements set it apart from other virtual pet games. Players can take their capybaras for walks in a beautifully designed virtual world.
With its engaging gameplay, charming graphics, and relaxing soundtrack, Capybara Simulator offers an escape to a world where caring for and keeping your virtual pets happy are your top priorities. Whether you're a seasoned gamer looking for a new challenge or a virtual pet enthusiast eager to explore the world of capybaras, Capybara Simulator delivers a rewarding and fun experience that celebrates the simple pleasures of pet care and the beauty of the animal kingdom.
In conclusion, Capybara Simulator stands out as a unique and immersive game in the virtual pet genre. It combines the joy of pet care with the creativity of wildlife crafting, offering players a complete and engaging virtual pet experience. Join the community of capybara caretakers and immerse yourself in the captivating world of Capybara Simulator.

bluejetty:00176874:android.description:
Tired of searching for your TV remote or dealing with buttons that don’t respond? This app turns your phone into a simple and reliable way to control your TV — faster, smoother, and always within reach.
TV Remote Control for Smart TV lets you navigate menus, type text, launch channels, and share media directly from your phone. It’s designed for everyday use, whether your physical remote is lost, broken, or simply inconvenient.
If you use a TV from TCL, Hisense, Sharp, Philips, Insignia, or other supported brands, this app helps you control your TV without extra hardware or complicated setup.
🚀 A Practical Remote for Everyday TV Use:
Instead of slow input and missing buttons, you get smooth navigation, quick response, and features that make controlling your TV feel effortless. This app works as a reliable TV remote replacement that stays stable during daily use.
⚡ Connect in Seconds:
Once your phone and TV are on the same Wi-Fi network, the app automatically finds your device and connects instantly. No pairing codes, no manual setup — just open the app and start controlling your TV.
🎮 Easy Navigation with Touch Controls:
Browse channels and apps using natural swipe gestures that feel precise and responsive. Scrolling, selecting content, and switching apps becomes easier than using a standard physical remote.
🎥 Cast Photos, Videos, and Music:
Share content from your phone to your TV in just a few taps. Stream videos, display photos, or play music on the big screen and enjoy a more connected home entertainment experience.
🔍 Faster Typing with a Smart Keyboard:
Typing with a traditional remote can be frustrating. This TV remote app includes a full keyboard on your phone, making it easy to search for movies, enter passwords, or type usernames quickly.
🌟 Quick Access to Your Favorite Channels:
Launch Netflix, YouTube, Hulu, Disney+, Max, Prime Video, and other installed apps with a single tap. Create shortcuts so the channels you use most are always easy to reach.
🔧 Compatible with TVs and Devices:
Works as a universal remote for smart TVs and supported devices, including models from TCL, Hisense, Sharp, Philips, and Insignia.
💡 Designed for Daily Life:
- People choose TV Remote Control for Smart TV because it:
- Replaces a lost remote instantly
- Reconnects automatically when opened
- Offers a clean, easy-to-use interface
- Responds quickly with minimal delay
- Combines control, typing, searching, and casting in one app
📱 How to Get Started:
Step 1: Connect your phone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network
Step 2: Open the app and select your device
Step 3:Tap to connect and start controlling your TV
📌 Disclaimer:
This app is not affiliated with any TV brands. All smart TVs and related trademarks belong to their respective owners.
Download TV Remote Control for Smart TV and enjoy a simpler, more convenient way to control your TV from your phone.

bluejetty:00070705:ios.description:
RAMAYAN - Ram Charit Manas, Musical Ramayan By Shree Ravindra jain Ji
Sampurna Musical Ramayan Hindi
-By Shree Ravindra jain Ji, Sadhna Sargam, Suresh Vadekar, Tripti Shakya
 Srimad Valmiki Ramayana is an epic poem of India which narrates the journey of Virtue to annihilate vice. Sri Rama is the Hero and aayana His journey. We in India believe that Sri Rama lived in Treta Yug, millennia BC and we are presently concerned with what Srimad Valmiki Ramayana tells us, rather than when it was told.
 Ramayana is one of the largest ancient epics in world literature. It consists of nearly 24,000 verses , divided into seven Kands (books) and about 500 sargas (chapters). In Hindu tradition, it is considered to be the adi-kavya (first poem). It depicts the duties of relationships, portraying ideal characters like the ideal father, the ideal servant, the ideal brother, the ideal wife and the ideal king. 
App Features :-
- The structure of Srimad Valmiki Ramayana is arranged into eight Kands or chepters
 1)Bal Kand
 2)Ayodhya Kand
 3)Aranya Kand
 4)Kishkindha Kand
 5)Sundara Kand
 6)Lanka Kand
 7)Uttar Kand
 8)Luv - Kush Kand
- Each Chapter further divided into numbers of different parts , select and listen desired part from list. 
- continue playing in background.
- User Friendly Music Player Interface.
- Audio streaming from server so need internet connection to play online.

bluejetty:00121011:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
