bluejetty:00124049:ios.description:
Tee off into a world of adventure with our immersive and action packed mini golf game 2k26.
Welcome to the ultimate putting experience Mini Golf 2026: Club Match PRO, where arcade style fun meets golfing skill. Tee off on a thrilling journey across over 35 handcrafted levels in 3 episodes, packed with unique obstacles, trick shots, and epic golf battles.
Whether you're a seasoned swinger or a casual player, this game brings the joy of putting, swinging, and scoring straight to your fingertips. It's fun for all ages and completely FREE to play!
This realistic 3D golf simulation puts your accuracy and timing to the test. Each shot is powered by smooth golf physics, responsive controls, and immersive visuals. From short softball-like taps to high stakes power swings, this is mini golf like you've never played before.
Mini Golf Game 2k26 Key Features:
-One-finger or dual controls to easily putt the ball
-Customizable direction and power for perfect shots
-Realistic landscape gameplay & golf course design
-Over 35 levels across 3 challenging episodes
-Simple to play, hard to master golf mechanics
-Bet and clash with friends in multiplayer-style matches
-Quick, satisfying sessions great for coffee golf fans
-Smooth arcade golf gameplay with relaxing background music
-Unlock new levels and become a pro putter
Built for fans of disc golf valley, flick golf, and trick shots
Includes challenges inspired by golf battle, clash, orbit shots, and more
Play solo or challenge your friends to see who has the better swing. Compete for bragging rights in local challenges or just chill and putt through mini golf paradise.
Whether you're in the mood for a casual putting session, testing your trick shot skills, or looking to unwind with quick golf fun, this game hits the sweet spot between arcade fun and realistic physics.
Take your best shot and swing for the win it's time to dominate the mini golf 2k26 world!

bluejetty:00023619:ios.description:
One-week free trial.
TslaMirror is an app designed to mirror your iPhone/iPad apps to your Tesla’s built-in browser.
- Supported apps include Waze, Google Maps, Apple Maps, YouTube, TikTok, Plex, and more.
- DRM-protected apps, including but not limited to Netflix, Apple TV, YouTube TV, Amazon Prime Video, and Hulu, are not supported. Some DRM-protected apps may block video mirroring, resulting in a black screen in the Tesla browser.
Instructions for the Tesla built-in browser:
1. If possible, update your Tesla’s infotainment system to the most recent version.
2. Make sure the vehicle is PARKED (0 mph / 0 km/h).
3. Connect your Tesla to your iPhone Personal Hotspot (cellular data required). MCU2 or MCU3 hardware is required: available on Model 3 and Model Y, Cybertruck, Model S built after March 2018, Model X built after March 2018, or vehicles upgraded from MCU1 to MCU2/3.
4. Ensure the iPhone is not in Low Power Mode. Launch the TslaMirror app and toggle on “Proxy.”
5. Tap “Start,” then select “Start Broadcast” to begin screen broadcast.
6. In your Tesla’s built-in browser, go to https://TslaMirror.com
7. Lossless audio playback is supported in the browser.
8. Keep your iPhone unlocked; due to Screen Broadcast API limitations, locking the screen stops casting and requires restarting the broadcast.
Key Features
1. No additional internet traffic is used for mirroring; traffic stays on the iPhone’s Personal Hotspot. However, while the Tesla is connected to the hotspot, the vehicle may use your cellular data for its own internet access.
2. Private: the screencast is only available to devices connected to the iPhone Personal Hotspot Wi-Fi network.
3. A 5 GHz Personal Hotspot (supported from the iPhone 12 series) is highly recommended. Do not enable “Maximize Compatibility” on iPhone 12 models; enabling it forces a 2.4 GHz hotspot.
4. H.264/H.265 mirroring recommendations:
 - MCU3 (AMD Ryzen): H.265 mode with 720p@60 fps recommended, as 1080p requires higher bandwidth. MCU3 supports up to 1080p@60fps (H.264 and H.265).
 - For Tesla in-car system software version 2025.38.11 and later, H.265 mirroring is now recommended for both MCU2 and MCU3.
 - MCU2 (Intel Atom): H.264 mode with 540p@30fps recommended only for very old Tesla in-car system.
FAQ
1. This is not CarPlay.
2. iOS apps that use the AVPlayer framework (e.g., Apple Music, Netflix) are not supported.
3. Netflix is not supported.
Privacy/Security Notice: This app does not collect usage statistics, personal information, or analytics. On iOS 13 and later, it uses Location Services only to read the Wi-Fi network name (SSID). Location data is never stored or collected. No information is stored by us.
Disclaimer: This software and documentation are not affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla, Inc. Use at your own risk. We do not guarantee proper functioning. Some features require specific vehicle options (e.g., MCU2 or newer). The app uses interfaces similar to those used by official Tesla apps, but you are responsible for any changes to your car resulting from use. Use requires the vehicle’s built-in browser. We are not liable for any damages to you, your car, or any other property in conjunction with the use of this app.
Warning and Legal Disclaimer: Use only while PARKED (0 mph / 0 km/h). Local laws may restrict the use of a built-in web browser in a vehicle.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://teslamirror.com/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://teslamirror.com/privacy

bluejetty:00187409:ios.description:
Welcome to Nordea! 
The app puts the entire bank in the palm of your hand, enabling you to do most of your banking swiftly, smoothly and securely. 
You can test the demo version of the app without logging in. You can access it through Menu before logging in. All information in the demo version is fictitious. 
Examples of what you can do in the app: 
YOUR OVERVIEW 
In the Overview tab, you can view and manage all your finances in one place. You can add, hide or rearrange the order of your content to personalise your experience. Quick actions take you straight to several functions, such as Search, helping you find what you need. Under the Profile tab you can, for example, find Documents, consents and Log out. If you have other banks, you can also add them to get a better overview of your finances. 
PAYMENTS AND TRANSFERS 
Pay your bills and transfer money, both between your own accounts or to a friend. Here, you can also add and manage direct debits, simplifying your everyday life. 
MANAGE YOUR CARDS 
Connect cards and wearables to Apple Pay for contactless payments. If you forgot your PIN code, you could view it here. You can also block your card if needed, and we’ll send you a new one automatically. Choose the geographic areas where your credit card can be used and by restricting use for online shopping so you can feel safer and better control of your payments. 
SAVE AND INVEST
It’s easy to keep track of your savings and see how they are performing. Start saving monthly, trade in funds and stocks, or set a goal for your savings. Get suggestions and ideas for new investments through Find Investments.
DISCOVER NEW PRODUCTS AND SERVICES 
In the Services tab, you can open different accounts, apply for credit cards or loans, get digital advice for long-term savings, and much more. 
WE'RE HERE FOR YOU 
The Help tab contains all the information you need to get help with your banking. Use the Search function, see frequently asked questions and answer, or chat with us directly. If you call us through the app, you’ve already identified yourself, so we can help you faster. 
We want to know what you think, so feel free to leave a review or send your feedback directly in the app. 
Download the app today and get access to all the functions that simplify your banking!

bluejetty:00161991:ios.summary:

HelloMind helps you take back control from negative emotions, cravings, fears and bad
bluejetty:00161991:ios.description:
HelloMind helps you battle problems like stress, bad sleep, weight gain and low self-esteem. Choose a treatment, then relax and listen to the sessions. 
HelloMind helps you take back control from negative emotions, cravings, fears and bad habits and it can improve your motivation and enjoyment of life. 
Try the Sleep Boosters:
- Have a good night’s sleep
- Sleep more peacefully
Or boost your confidence with the sessions:
- Have more confidence
- Improve your self-worth
- Become self-confident
Or kick that anxiety for good with sessions like:
- Be more calm
- Get rid of your fear of panicking
- My ability to de-stress
Or get rid of your phobia eg.:
- Spiders
- Dentists
- Enclosed spaces
MORE
Low self-esteem, stress, fear, bad sleep and unhealthy habits sometimes hold us back in life and prevent us from enjoying things to the fullest. 
The good news is these negative patterns can be broken or eliminated. 
We created the HelloMind app to help you make a change. We want you to be able to think better and feel stronger. Anywhere, any time without having to spend a lot of time and money on treatment. 
The key to happiness lies within you. And HelloMind works because you are making the change yourself. 
Choose a treatment with 10 sessions if you want help to remove or change something like a craving, a habit or a fear. Each session takes about 30 minutes, and your series of 10 sessions should be completed within about 30 days.
Choose a Booster if you’d like to reinforce good emotions boost motivation or strengthen a certain area of yourself.
HelloMind uses a method called RDH - Result Driven Hypnosis, a form of guided hypnosis.
RDH is especially effective because it helps you go to the root cause of your problem. The theory behind it says that when you’re consciously able to define the problem, your subconscious can find the solution. That’s why you’re gently guided into your subconscious towards the root of your problem then given the tool to fix it.
The ten sessions in a treatment or the sessions in a Booster are variations on the same theme, so you’ll hear something different every time you listen. But listening to all 10 sessions in treatment is the only way to ensure that you go deep enough into your subconscious to discover the root of the problem. Every time you listen, you’ll feel a little more safe, because the process is underway and you’ve become accustomed to it. That’s why you relax more as the hypnosis stages become more profound.
When choosing a hypnotherapy treatment, you should always begin with your main problem. The app will guide you to the right treatment or Booster with simple questions. Choosing the right treatment is actually an important part of the process. When you can consciously define the problem, your subconscious will know the solution.
HelloMind integrates with the Apple Health app counting mindfullness minutes.
RECENT AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS
** Finalist (Mental Health category) ** — UCSF Digital Health awards 2019

listings.description:
HelloMind helps you battle problems like stress, bad sleep, weight gain and low self-esteem. Choose a treatment, then relax and listen to the sessions. 

HelloMind helps you take back control from negative emotions, cravings, fears and bad habits and it can improve your motivation and enjoyment of life. 

Try the Sleep Boosters:
- Have a good night’s sleep
- Sleep more peacefully

Or boost your confidence with the sessions:
- Have more confidence
- Improve your self-worth
- Become self-confident

Or kick that anxiety for good with sessions like:
- Be more calm
- Get rid of your fear of panicking
- My ability to de-stress

Or get rid of your phobia eg.:
- Spiders
- Dentists
- Enclosed spaces


MORE

Low self-esteem, stress, fear, bad sleep and unhealthy habits sometimes hold us back in life and prevent us from enjoying things to the fullest. 
The good news is these negative patterns can be broken or eliminated. 

We created the HelloMind app to help you make a change. We want you to be able to think better and feel stronger. Anywhere, any time without having to spend a lot of time and money on treatment. 

The key to happiness lies within you. And HelloMind works because you are making the change yourself. 

Choose a treatment with 10 sessions if you want help to remove or change something like a craving, a habit or a fear. Each session takes about 30 minutes, and your series of 10 sessions should be completed within about 30 days.

Choose a Booster if you’d like to reinforce good emotions boost motivation or strengthen a certain area of yourself.

HelloMind uses a method called RDH - Result Driven Hypnosis, a form of guided hypnosis.

RDH is especially effective because it helps you go to the root cause of your problem. The theory behind it says that when you’re consciously able to define the problem, your subconscious can find the solution. That’s why you’re gently guided into your subconscious towards the root of your problem then given the tool to fix it.

The ten sessions in a treatment or the sessions in a Booster are variations on the same theme, so you’ll hear something different every time you listen. But listening to all 10 sessions in treatment is the only way to ensure that you go deep enough into your subconscious to discover the root of the problem. Every time you listen, you’ll feel a little more safe, because the process is underway and you’ve become accustomed to it. That’s why you relax more as the hypnosis stages become more profound.

When choosing a hypnotherapy treatment, you should always begin with your main problem. The app will guide you to the right treatment or Booster with simple questions. Choosing the right treatment is actually an important part of the process. When you can consciously define the problem, your subconscious will know the solution.

HelloMind integrates with the Apple Health app counting mindfullness minutes.

bluejetty:00087886:ios.description:
DISCOVER & STAY CONNECTED
Experience the free WHYY Listen App — your connection to local news, live radio, and podcasts from across public media.
Create a free WHYY account to unlock a more seamless listening experience. Save what matters, download audio for offline listening, and pick up where you left off. Use the same account to login to NPR and PBS to
ONE ACCOUNT ACROSS PUBLIC MEDIA
Create a WHYY Account and sign in across:
-WHYY Listen
-WHYY Watch (Passport)
-NPR
-PBS
Use your account to access a more seamless experience, and manage your WHYY Membership in one place.
MANAGE YOUR WHYY MEMBERSHIP
Access and manage your WHYY membership directly in the app:
-View your digital WHYY MemberCard
-Update your payment method (for Sustainers)
-Manage your newsletter subscriptions
-Update your personal information
Whether you’re a member or have a free account, you can stay connected and keep your information up to date.
FIND EXACTLY WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR
Whether you're searching for a story you heard on the radio, a favorite podcast episode, or the latest news on a topic, the WHYY Listen App makes it easy. Search across articles and audio from WHYY, NPR, and Billy Penn to quickly get back to the content that matters to you.

Pause and rewind live radio anytime, or replay shows from the past week. Whether you’re catching up or tuning in live, you’re always in control.

Listen to WHYY favorites like Studio 2, The Connection, and The Pulse, plus top NPR shows — all in one place.
IN-DEPTH LOCAL NEWS
Stay informed with award-winning journalism from WHYY News and Billy Penn, covering the issues that matter most in your community.

-Search Stories & Podcasts: Quickly find articles and audio from WHYY, NPR, and Billy Penn.

bluejetty:00068899:ios.description:
Air Codes keeps you up to date with what’s happening in aviation – in a fast, clean app made for pilots, spotters, frequent flyers and anyone who loves planes.
AVIATION NEWS
A hand-picked feed of aviation news from around the world, updated throughout the day
Crashes, incidents and industry news clearly labelled
Aviation videos right in the feed
Every story links to its original source
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Get notified when major aviation news breaks
Tap a notification to jump straight to the story
AIRPORTS
The world’s busiest airports with IATA and ICAO codes, city, country, elevation, map and live weather
Filter by type – airports, heliports, seaplane bases and more, several types at once
Up to six runways per airport with length, surface and a runway layout drawing – parallel runways shown side by side with L / C / R
Airport photos from Wikipedia
Nearby airports and other airports in the same country

Search by name, code or registration prefix
Other airlines from the same country and airlines with the nearest headquarters
ACCIDENTS
Aviation accidents with date, aircraft type, operator, location and what happened
Search by year – type “1977” to see that year’s accidents
Accidents that happened on the same day in history
FAVOURITES
Star airports, airlines and accidents to keep them in your own list
Synced with your aircodes.sk account
FLIGHTS
Flight status for accounts with flight status on aircodes.sk
Follow a flight on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
MADE FOR iPHONE
Native, fast and lightweight
Light and dark mode, with a modern glass design
Free account – sign in with Apple, Google or email to read the full news archive, and use the same account on aircodes.sk

数感星球，专为孩子打造的“数感培养专家”，采用“CPA教学法+教具”模式，将新加坡CPA教学法与动手实践结合，紧扣新课改核心考点。通过线上300+教具互动，搭配16级进阶体系及三大升级——开口讲算理、AI智能伴学、高效多维练，帮助孩子高效理解数学原理，让孩子真正爱上数感，实现数学轻松领先！

（1）CPA教学法+开口讲——动手又动口，理解才算透

（3）可视化+多维练——紧扣新课标，稳步进阶
• 数轴、十格阵等可视化教具，还原新课标核心考点，科学培养数感
• 新增160+训练课次，从基础到巧算全面覆盖计算能力
（4）16级数感进阶+家长减负——进步看得见，督学更轻松
• 科学系统的学习路径，因材施教，实时数据报告同步家长，进度一目了然

bluejetty:00078083:ios.name: Gratitude Journal & Self Care
bluejetty:00078083:ios.summary:
More than a journal, Gratefully helps you build a daily gratitude practice, notice small moments, and find more to be thankful for.
Explore a more grateful mindset at your own pace. Bring journaling, a mood tracker, daily affirmations, and
bluejetty:00078083:ios.description:
More than a journal, Gratefully helps you build a daily gratitude practice, notice small moments, and find more to be thankful for.
Explore a more grateful mindset at your own pace. Bring journaling, a mood tracker, daily affirmations, and guided breathing into a simple self care routine. A positive attitude can leave room for mixed feelings and difficult days, too.
YOUR DAILY GRATITUDE JOURNAL
Write about something you are grateful for: a kind message, a quiet coffee, someone you appreciate, or a small win. Add a photo and revisit meaningful moments in a personal diary that brings your days together.
FIND WORDS WITH JOURNAL PROMPTS
Not sure what to write? Thoughtful journal prompts offer a starting point for gratitude and self reflection. On compatible devices, Apple Intelligence can suggest questions inspired by your mood and the personal context you choose to share.
BUILD A GRATEFUL ATTITUDE
Practice noticing the good around you with Spot the Good. Small daily invitations encourage you to appreciate everyday details, people, and experiences. Find your own reasons to feel thankful and turn gratitude into a daily habit.
TRACK YOUR MOOD
Check in with 22 illustrated moods, keep your favorites close, and see how each day felt on your calendar. Use your mood tracker alongside your journal to record both the good moments and the harder ones.
DAILY POSITIVE AFFIRMATIONS
Explore daily affirmations and encouraging quotes as part of your self care practice. Take a moment to reflect on words that bring kindness, encouragement, or a fresh perspective to your day.
GUIDED BREATHING AND MINDFUL PAUSES
Follow guided breathing exercises for moments of calm, focus, or winding down before sleep. Start with a quiet breath and take a short pause whenever you need one.
UNDERSTAND YOUR DAYS
Explore patterns in your mood, compare days with different practices, and notice the people, moments, and themes you give thanks for most. Your progress insights are calculated on your device.
GRATITUDE WIDGETS AND ICLOUD SYNC
Keep gratitude and affirmations close with widgets. Sync your journal across your compatible Apple devices with iCloud, so you can return to your moments wherever you prefer to write.
PERSONAL PROMPTS, GENERATED ON YOUR DEVICE
Apple Intelligence prompts are generated on your iPhone or iPad. Your writing and personal context are not sent to an AI server to create them. Once Apple's model is downloaded, generation works offline, with no Premium required.
Personalized prompts require iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later, a compatible device, and Apple Intelligence enabled in a supported language and region. The hand-written prompt collection remains available on other devices.
Start your gratitude practice with one sentence, one feeling, or one thing you are thankful for.
Privacy policy: https://me.dmansodev.com/gratefully-privacy
Terms: https://me.dmansodev.com/gratefully-terms
Questions or feedback: gv.gratitude.journal.app@gmail.com

bluejetty:00026987:ios.summary:
Get dressed for the weather, not just told about it.
Weather Fit turns the forecast into something you can see. A character that looks like you puts on clothes that match the conditions outside, so before you even read the temperature, you
bluejetty:00026987:ios.description:
Get dressed for the weather, not just told about it.
Weather Fit turns the forecast into something you can see. A character that looks like you puts on clothes that match the conditions outside, so before you even read the temperature, you already know if it's a sweater day, a raincoat day, or a sunglasses day.
Hourly, daily, and minute by minute forecasts powered by Apple Weather. Made for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
A character that dresses for the day. Morning, afternoon, evening, and night, your character changes clothes as the weather changes. It's the fastest way to know what to wear before you walk out the door.
Dressed like you. Pick a character, choose a hairstyle, skin tone, and hair color, then pick their clothes: jackets, sweaters, shirts, dresses, shoes, and accessories. Only what you'd actually wear.
Outfits tuned to you. A comfort slider tells the app whether you run hot or cold, and the suggestions adjust. No more being told to wear a coat when you're already sweating.
Forecasts that cover everything. Next hour precipitation, weather alerts, and a stats grid for UV, wind, air quality, humidity, pressure, visibility, sunrise and sunset, and moon phase.
Beautiful to look at. Animated landscapes, dynamic skies, and weather effects that shift with the time of day. Pick from City, Mountains, Beach, or Village.
NOTIFICATIONS
Wake up knowing what to wear. Your character gets dressed for the day and arrives in a morning notification, with an evening one to plan tomorrow. And when rain or strong sun is coming, a reminder tells you to grab an umbrella or sunscreen.
WIDGETS
Home Screen widgets in every size, with or without your character on them. Lock Screen widgets too, inline above the clock and circular or rectangular below it, so the forecast and your outfit are one glance away.
APPLE WATCH
A full Weather Fit app on the wrist, plus complications for your favorite watch face. Your character, the temperature, and what's coming next, right where you'll see it.
WEATHER MAPS
Animated precipitation radar from Rainbow.ai. Watch rain and snow move across the map for the next hour, frame by frame.
ICLOUD SYNC
Your character, wardrobe, saved locations, and settings stay in sync across all your devices and back up to iCloud automatically. Switch phones without losing a thing.
WEATHER FIT PREMIUM
A subscription unlocks the full experience:
- Unlimited wardrobe items and outfit combinations
- All four landscapes (City, Mountains, Beach, Village)
- Weather report and reminder notifications
- Every Home Screen and Lock Screen widget
- The Apple Watch app and complications
- Weather Maps with precipitation radar
Choose monthly, yearly, or a one time lifetime purchase. Free trial available for new subscribers.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime from your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://weatherfit.com/terms-and-conditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://weatherfit.com/privacy-policy.html
---

The Ailo app was designed to help property i
bluejetty:00068214:ios.description:
You deserve a great property manager. And great property managers use the Ailo platform to give their property investors and renters unprecedented transparency, more control, and better choices.
The Ailo app was designed to help property investors and renters stay even more connected with their rental property – and their property manager!
**WHY PROPERTY INVESTORS LOVE AILO**
PAY OFF YOUR MORTGAGE SOONER
* Direct access to your funds 24/7
* See the moment rent is paid, even before it’s cleared by the banks
* Instantly transfer available funds to your bank account, instead of waiting until end-of-month (using New Payments Platform technology) so you can pay off your mortgage sooner
24/7 VISIBILITY, ON-DEMAND ACCESS
* Instant access to all of your real-time balances, statements, bills, and inspection reports
* See upcoming bills and expenses, so there's no end-of-month surprises
* A direct line to your property manager via Messages, so you can collaborate and problem solve faster and minimise vacancy rates
MORE & BETTER INVESTOR CHOICES
* Set your cash flow preferences, including when and where your funds are deposited, and how bills are paid
* Nominate how you want to balance income, expenses and reporting across your property portfolio
* Choose to pay your bills via credit card, debit card, direct debit or with rental income, and it will all appear on your EOFY statement at tax time
**WHY RENTERS LOVE AILO**
REPORT & RESOLVE REPAIRS FASTER
* Get a direct line to your property manager via Messages
* We measure your property manager’s response times to your messages to help them improve their service
UNLOCK MORE FAST, SECURE PAYMENT OPTIONS
* Unlock more payment methods in addition to other options offered by your property manager, including direct debit, debit card, credit card, and Centrepay.
* Easily split rent with housemates
SEAMLESS, PAPERLESS INSPECTIONS
* Collaborate with your housemates and share the load on the inspection
* Add your own time-stamped photos, notes and electronic signature directly in your app 
MORE VISIBILITY INTO WHAT’S GOING ON 
* Always know when your next rent payment is due and how much you owe
* See a log of all your past rent payments, bills, and messages to your property manager

bluejetty:00093321:ios.description:
We are a coffee company, located in Fort Smith, AR. Our dream was birthed over a decade ago, but we started grassroots, by roasting coffee beans and selling at the local farmer's market. We opened the doors to our first brick & mortar location in May 2017. We now have 2 locations in historic downtown & we're working on a 3rd in historic Chaffee Crossing. We roast all of our coffee on-site, employ skilled baristas and do pretty much everything from scratch - from our house made syrups, to our fresh assortment of pastries. 
Use this app to: 
-Order your favorite hand-crafted drinks, pastries or food
-Choose to pickup in-store or opt for delivery from Door Dash
-Track your order progress
-View order history
-Keep track of loyalty points

bluejetty:00065360:ios.summary: Telpark allows you to pay and manage your parking in regulated areas such as the blue and green zones on public streets, just using your smartphone. There's no need to carry cash in your pockets, nor to search for a parking meter. You can m
bluejetty:00065360:ios.description:
Telpark allows you to pay and manage your parking in regulated areas such as the blue and green zones on public streets, just using your smartphone. There's no need to carry cash in your pockets, nor to search for a parking meter. You can make your payments, receive parking expiration alerts and cancel fine tickets without going to the parking meter.
Soon with Telpark you can also use many of the public parkings in the Empark universe (largest parking operator company in Spain), in a completely paperless way: access is made via license plate optical recognition at the parking entrance and exit points and payment is automatic with your Telpark account.
You can manage different vehicles and pay for them without stopping your business meeting, getting out of the cinema, nor interfering with your activity. Moreover, you don’t have to pay beforehand.
These are the main advantages of using Telpark:
- Pay safely in city council regulated areas without going to the parking meter and without using any paper.
- Extend your parking time allowance without getting back to the car.
- With one app, you can pay in the city council regulated areas and soon also at Empark car parks in Spain and Portugal.
- Get notifications in your mobile when your parking time is about to expire.
- Find your car thanks to the GPS position 
- Secure payments with credit card or Paypal
- Manage all the vehicles from one single account
- Without pre-payments
- You can use it in more than 50 cities in Spain and 11 in Portugal
- Cancel parking ticket fines directly from your mobile (in cities where local regulations allow it)

bluejetty:00147235:ios.name: WoFit
bluejetty:00147235:ios.summary: WoFit is one application for fitness activity, providing data record, track, statistics etc, could work with WoFit smart fitness bracelet and watch, users will enjoy more complete & uniform experience, to inspire people to have exercise hab
bluejetty:00147235:ios.description:
WoFit is one application for fitness activity, providing data record, track, statistics etc, could work with WoFit smart fitness bracelet and watch, users will enjoy more complete & uniform experience, to inspire people to have exercise habit and healthy life style, and meet the better yourself.
# WoFit could do for you : 
- Record daily exercise data: steps, distance, burnt calories.
- Show 24-hour exercise data, and total data by week and month, and trend statistics graph accordingly.
- Record daily sleep status, illustration with character shows deep sleep time, light sleep time and wake-up times. And summarize the sleep trend by week and month.
- Record daily actual data and scope about heart rate, list the top heart rate value, the lowest value, average data by day, week, month respectively.
- Record daily actual blood pressure data and variability trend, and list Blood pressure data on average and variability trend by week, month respectively.
- Record the exercise time in modes run, ride, plank, speed, heart rate, trajectory and burnt calories.
- Record daily weight data and variability curve.
- Could set exercise goal, and statistic daily complete percentage and achievement days, to encourage yourself to workout every day.
- Support to share data to WeChat, Moments, Weibo, facebook, twitter and other SNS APP. 
- Health fitness data in registered Account syncs to Ali cloud server, no worry to lost data even use one new cellphone.
- Support to add your family, friends as caring people, and get their fitness data about exercise, heart rate, blood pressure and health trend.
- Could set alarm clocks of smart fitness watch and bracelet, stopwatch, countdown, event reminder, call reminder, mute, hang-up functions etc.
# Sweet tips :
- WoFit APP supports OS: iOS 9.0 above. After getting permission, excercise data (steps, sleep, heart rate etc) syncs to iHealth APP, and steps data syncs to WeRun APP. 
- WoFit APP needs working with WoFit smart watch and bracelet, can’t perform all functions if use individually.
# Suggestion feedback to wofitservice@gmail.com

bluejetty:00032885:ios.name: Palo Alto Link
bluejetty:00032885:ios.summary: Palo Alto Link is the city’s easy, affordable, and eco-friendly service. We are a rideshare service that comes when you want, where you want — give us your pickup and dropoff addresses, and we’ll provide a few ride options. Choose the ride
bluejetty:00032885:ios.description:
Palo Alto Link is the city’s easy, affordable, and eco-friendly service. We are a rideshare service that comes when you want, where you want — give us your pickup and dropoff addresses, and we’ll provide a few ride options. Choose the ride option that works best for you and get directions to a nearby intersection where a driver will pick you up.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices and lowers CO2 emissions. Enough said. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. On top of this, our vehicle fleet is a mix of hybrid and fully electric vehicles. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride. 
Questions? Reach out at support-pal@ridewithvia.com. Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00126748:ios.description:
Are you worried about losing your phone or tablet? Anti-Theft & Full Battery Alarm will help you to protect your phone from being stolen.
The main use of this mobile anti theft app is to prevent unauthorized access to your phone or tablet while you are charging your device. This will be very useful if you leave your phone charging in a public place because if someone other than you disconnects the phone from the charger, the anti theft security alarm you have chosen will start to sound to avoid that someone steals your phone.
The burglar won't be able to stop the full battery & theft alarm since you will have to enter a PIN you will have chosen previously to be able to deactivate it.
This app offers 2 types of anti burglar alarms:
- Anti theft system: Plug your anti theft device into a charger and activate the burglar alarm. If someone tries to take your phone while it is charging, the charging alarm will start to sound with maximum volume.
- Activate the full charge alarm: This alarm will allow you to charge your phone and know when the battery is charged at 100%. This way, you can remove the battery from the charger at the right time and extend the battery of your phone.
Main characteristics of the app Anti-Theft & Full Battery Alarm:
- Motion sensor. When someone disconnects the phone from the charging plug the app will detect it and the battery charger alarm will sound.
- Protect your phone with the PIN code you choose. The best mobile security alarm.
- Customize the sound of the battery full charge alarm.
- Intelligent alarm to know whether your phone has been fully charged.
- The anti theft app works in the background, even though you don't have it open.
- Alarm system that is easy to use and to set up.
Premium features:
- No Ads: Access the App without advertising interruptions.
- Unlimited Use: Use the App without the limitations that may apply in the free version.
Privacy Policy: https://smikoapps.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms: https://smikoapps.com/terms/battery-alarm-terms.html

apple-itunes:6621272550.description:
Alice AI: texts, neural network, fresh ideas, knowledge, Russian-language AI chat.
Powerful Yandex AI on your phone helps with everyday chores and tackles tasks for study, work, and creativity.
Explore what the neural network can do with Alice—everything you expect from a smart chat in Russian.
Alice AI is Yandex’s family of generative models that power Alice. It includes:
- Alice AI LLM — a language model for answering questions and generating text;
- Alice AI ART — an image model for creating visuals;
- Alice AI VLM — a multimodal vision-language model for analyzing images, answering questions, and solving image-related tasks.
Ask questions, write and edit text—the Alice AI neural network responds accurately and comprehensively, and can enrich answers with images and source links. Speak by voice or type in chat.
Work with files (DOC, DOCX, PDF, TXT), structure information, and turn it into clear, usable reports. The Alice AI assistant quickly extracts key insights.
Work with photos—recognize text in images, identify objects, and get fast visual analysis. The AI chat assistant can pull data from a receipt photo, explain what’s in a shot, and convert it into an editable text format for further use.
Solve complex problems—reasoning mode produces not just quick and detailed answers, but thoughtful conclusions. You get well-founded solutions with expert-level analysis.
Create compelling English-language copy, ask questions, translate, and edit. Yandex Alice’s AI assistant helps draft anything—from personal emails and school assignments to business proposals.
Find inspiration: generate new project ideas, run brainstorms, craft descriptions and messages, and build your own text templates. Let Alice handle the routine. The AI assistant can write a letter, a script for an event or talk, suggest a post title, or even a name for your pet.
Create images and AI video—Yandex ART generates visuals or animates photos on request. Alice helps you produce striking social posts, a logo, or a birthday card.
Use AI chat for professional work. The assistant helps with programming and code, offering multiple solution approaches. Alice AI teaches logic, explains logical problems clearly, and shares interesting facts. Get advice and recommendations on any topic—Alice answers in detail, suggests step-by-step actions, and helps you plan.
Ask questions, type text, attach photos, videos, and files—or talk through the camera in real time. With the Pro option, show Alice what you see and get instant answers and ideas. Just open the Alice AI app and point your phone’s camera at whatever you want to learn about.
Alice AI can be your guide to landmarks, your kitchen co-pilot for “what can I cook with this?”, or your stylist for picking shoes to match your trousers. Ask anything and switch topics as needed. The neural network keeps context, recognizes objects in the frame, and delivers fast, in-depth answers.

Less guesswork = less stress, especially with our new Animated Steps, which show you the exact progression of a particular step. Get basic step-by-step explanations at no charge when you download Photomath.
Expert-developed methods: Photomath’s educational content is centered around the learner’s experience, driven by the expertise of our own team of mathematicians and former math teachers. 
Self-paced learning: Photomath’s instant support is like having a 24/7 virtual tutor. Checking your homework before dinner? Stuck on a problem at 2am? We can help. Follow our detailed steps, taking whatever time you need to review definitions, rationale, and more – all within the explanation.
Want to dive deeper and explore more ways to learn? Photomath Plus can get you there with custom Animated Tutorials, detailed Textbook Solutions, and more!

apple-macos:972696951.name: Origami Art Studio
apple-macos:972696951.description:
Origami Art Studio is a calm, beautifully simple companion for learning the ancient craft of paper folding. Browse a growing catalog of 30+ models — from a classic paper crane, heart, and boat to more ambitious stars, dragons, and dragonflies — and follow a clear, photographed guide through every single fold. There is no clutter, no timer, and no pressure: just you, a square of paper, and one gentle step at a time.
Every model opens into a fullscreen step viewer. Each step is shown as a real photo, so you can see exactly where the paper bends, which corner meets which edge, and how the shape slowly comes to life in your hands. A progress bar and a clear "Step X of Y" label always tell you how far along you are, so it is easy to pause, set the device down to make a fold, and pick up right where you left off.
Moving through a guide feels natural. Swipe left or right to go forward and back, tap the on-screen arrows, or use the keyboard arrow keys on iPad and Mac. When you reach the final step a friendly "Done" button brings you home to choose your next project. The home screen is a tidy, paginated catalog with thumbnail previews and a step count on every card, so you always know how involved a model will be before you begin.
Origami Art Studio is built to feel good on any device. The washi-paper interface — soft cream tones, warm ink lettering, and a single terracotta accent — was designed to be quiet and relaxing rather than loud and gamified. The responsive layout automatically shows one, two, three, or four columns depending on your screen, filling iPhone and iPad edge to edge without awkward borders. Gentle tap sounds give the pages a paper-like feel, and a single tap on the sound icon mutes them whenever you want silence.
The whole app speaks your language. A built-in language menu offers eight fully translated interfaces — English, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Hindi, and French — so menus, buttons, and labels always feel like home. Switching is instant and remembered for next time.
Whether you are folding with a child on a rainy afternoon, calming your mind after a long day, or picking up a mindful new hobby, Origami Art Studio keeps everything you need in one uncluttered place. Start with a simple crane today, then work your way up to a many-step dragon when you are ready. Grab a square of paper and begin folding.
Origami Art Studio never asks you to rush. There are no lives to lose, no daily streaks to maintain, and no ad ever interrupts a delicate fold mid-crease — an occasional short ad appears only when you open a new guide. Sit with one photograph as long as you need, then glide to the next when your hands are ready. The catalog grows with classic and creative shapes, so there is always a new project waiting — whether you have five minutes for a heart or a quiet evening for a many-step dragon.
Highlights you will notice right away:
• 30+ origami models with a clear photo for every fold
• Fullscreen step viewer with progress and Step X of Y
• Swipe, tap, or keyboard navigation on every device
• Paginated catalog with thumbnails and step counts
• Calm washi-paper design that fills the screen
• Eight fully translated languages
• Optional tap sounds with a one-tap mute
Fold slowly. Fold carefully. Fold for the joy of watching flat paper become something alive.
